label: 肆季鬼志 Season of Ghosts

Hu Ban-Niang.name: 胡板娘 Hu Ban-Niang
Hu Ban-Niang.allSaves: 对抗恐惧效果时获得 +1 状态加值，钢铁意志
Hu Ban-Niang.blurb: 女性 人类 卫队长

So Have You Heard?.name: 你听说了没？ So Have You Heard?
So Have You Heard?.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 胡太婆可以花费两个小时来玷污一名PC在柳岸镇的声誉。她尝试一次欺骗检定来对抗玷污目标的@Check[deception|defense:deception]{欺骗}、@Check[deception|defense:diplomacy]{交涉}或@Check[deception|defense:intimidation]{威吓} DC 中的最高者。若目标在柳岸镇某一派系中声望为钦佩或尊敬，那么胡太婆的该检定将会受到 -1 状态减值；若全部两个派系均钦佩或尊敬目标，那么该检定将会受到 -2 状态减值。此后，目标对“你听说了没”能力临时免疫 1 周。

大成功 在接下来的 1 周，当目标与柳岸镇居民进行互动时，其基于魅力的技能检定将会受到 -2 环境减值。

成功 同大成功，但仅受 -1 环境减值，且只持续 1 天。

失败 目标不受影响。

大失败 事与愿违，诡计反而引火上身，不仅目标不受影响，而且胡太婆将会在接下来 1 个月无法使用“你听说了吗”能力。

Are You Sure About That?.name: 你确定要这样？ Are You Sure About That?
Are You Sure About That?.description:
触发 胡太婆30尺范围内一个可见并且在过去一周受到了“真要试试看”能力影响的生物，试图说或做一些有悖胡太婆利益的事情

效果 胡太婆比出一个难以察觉的手势，提醒触发该反应的生物，他们还有把柄在自己手里。该生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免，否则触发该反应的动作将会被打断。无论结果如何，该生物将会临时免疫该能力 24 小时。

Nerves of Steel.name: 钢铁意志 Nerves of Steel
Nerves of Steel.description: 当胡太婆在对抗恐惧效果的豁免上得到成功时，其改为获得大成功。

Want to Try Me?.name: 真要试试看？ Want to Try Me?
Want to Try Me?.description:
触发 胡太婆30尺范围内的一个生物尝试对另一个生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]

效果 胡太婆威胁道将会曝光该触发反应生物的一个秘密。她尝试一次@Check[intimidation|defense:will]检定对砍该触发生物的意志DC。鉴于她的赫赫威名，这意味着她甚至可以在根本不掌握任何秘密的情况下威胁一名PC，但假如她真的掌握着一个特别危险或令人耻辱的把柄，那么其威吓检定将会获得+2环境加值。

大成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}状态，并且其胁迫以及挫败士气的检定结果下降一个等级。

成功 同大成功，但仅@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 生物不受影响。

大失败 生物不受影响，且其胁迫以及挫败士气检定获得 +1 环境加值，其还会对“真要试试看？”能力免疫 24 小时。

Kagekuma.name: 痂苦魔 Kagekuma

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description: 被痂苦魔杀死的生物很难复活或唤起成不死生物。痂苦魔会自动反制复活或唤起任何被其杀死生物的尝试（反制调整[[/r 1d20+16 #Counteract]]{+16}，反制等级4）。如果杀害生物的痂苦魔本身被杀死，被其杀死的生物便能如常被复活或唤起成不死生物。

Manifest Bundle.name: 具现捆子 Manifest Bundle
Manifest Bundle.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 痂苦魔具现出一大捆稻草，芦苇，绳子，毛线，头发，或类似之物，全部都用绳子束在一起，绑在其背后。只要捆子仍然具现，痂苦魔的AC便提升至27，但它的速度降低至15尺。

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description: 当痂苦魔持用一把破损的非魔法武器时，他不会承受任何武器破损带来的缺陷。当痂苦魔持用它时，该武器成为一把+1强击武器，且在成功命中时能造成额外1d6心灵伤害。

Shadow Bite.name: 阴影啃咬 Shadow Bite
Shadow Bite.description:
需求 痂苦魔正投下影子

效果 痂苦魔以投下影子的相邻生物为目标，然后它的影子吞噬该生物的影子。如果痂苦魔具现有捆子，观察者（包括影子正在被啃咬的生物）需要成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:38]检定才能够注意到痂苦魔的阴影啃咬。目标必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}）。

Shed Bundle.name: 摘下捆子 Shed Bundle
Shed Bundle.description:
需求 痂苦魔具现有捆子

频率 每日一次

效果 痂苦魔使它的捆子消失，行走，然后尝试一次锁镰打击和一次啃咬打击。目标对这些打击视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

Kagekuma.publicNotes:
痂苦魔存在于边缘地区，完全潜伏在猎物的阴影中。这种灵堕魔在一些地区被称作“影子魔”，其拥有变形成人群中大众脸的能力，让它们可以在人口稠密地区捕食。痂苦魔外表为有着长脖子和长满尖牙的嘴的驼背类人生物，不过当背负捆子时，这种生物的头和脖子会紧紧夹在肩膀之间，变得完全看不清。痂苦魔象征着在复杂的人际关系中，信任一次次被建立与打破的循环。

痂苦魔的捆子 Kagekuma Bundles

痂苦魔的捆子不仅仅是一种伪装和护甲——这是它们所裁短的生命与所吞下的灵魂数量的物理表现。捆子由稻草，绳子，头发，或其他材料捆扎而成，每一根都象征着“收割者的收获”，因此捆子中的每一根都隐喻着灵堕魔已经切断和收集的生命线——象征被夺走的生命数量已经压倒了灵堕魔自身在世上的存在。

Iogaka.name: 尤伽喀 Iogaka
Iogaka.blurb:
女性风暴鬼婆变体
Variant female storm hag
Iogaka.publicNotes:
残忍而喜怒无常，风暴鬼婆是风暴狂暴的化身。由于自身行为而被排斥，风暴鬼婆常见于那些被她们改造成私人避风港的岛屿上，并通过威胁来控制当地居民。与大多数鬼婆不同，许多风暴鬼婆会表现出对自己后代的真切关爱，无论是收养的还是亲生的。然而，任何拥有道德感的此类孩子都不会过上轻松的生活，因为他们往往只能徒劳地面对自己母亲对他人毫不动摇的坏脾气。

风暴鬼婆的真实形态像一位年长的类人生物女性，拥有被风暴吹乱的白发、如闪电般明亮的眼睛，以及深蓝色的皮肤。她们通常只会在狂暴时显露真实形态，这反而使她们天生的面容看起来比实际更加可怖。

鬼婆是起源不明的怪异掠食者，最为人所知的是她们会把儿童和年轻人当作目标。她们无一例外都呈现女性外貌，而且在日常生活中通常会伪装成凡人女性。她们强大的魔法与操纵性手段使她们能够引诱天真而脆弱的人，为了自己施虐般的目的而利用受害者，随后再绑架或吞食他们。普通鬼婆的特征在于虚荣且控制欲强的天性。或许也存在不那么邪恶的鬼婆，但即便如此，她们也会把自己深深藏匿起来，以避开冒险者以及她们自己那些恶毒亲族的注意。

Ruthless and temperamental, storm hags are the personification of a storm's rage. Outcasts by their own behavior, storm hags are often found on islands they've made into personal havens, controlling the local inhabitants through threats. Unlike most hags, many storm hags show signs of genuinely caring for their offspring, both those adopted and by birth. Any such children who possess morals aren't in for an easy life, however, as they're usually left trying and failing to deal with their mother's implacable temper toward others.

A storm hag's true form resembles an older humanoid woman with storm-tossed white hair, lightning-bright eyes, and dark blue skin. They typically only show their true form when in a rage, which makes their natural visage seem more terrifying than it actually is.

Hags are bizarre predators with uncertain origins, best known for targeting children and the young. To a one, they appear female, and they typically disguise themselves as mortal women in their day-to-day lives. Their powerful magic and manipulative tactics allow them to lure in the naive and vulnerable, exploiting their victims for their own sadistic purposes before kidnapping or devouring them. The typical hag is defined by a vain and controlling nature. Less malevolent hags may exist, but if so, they keep themselves well hidden to avoid the attentions of adventurers and their own abusive kin.

Coven.name: 巫团 Coven
Coven.description:
风暴鬼婆将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{水流爆发}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JyT346VmGtRLsDnV]{闪电风暴}和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z2mfh3oPnfYqXflY]{水手的诅咒}增添到她的巫团法术中。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

A storm hag adds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{Hydraulic Torrent}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JyT346VmGtRLsDnV]{Lightning Storm}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z2mfh3oPnfYqXflY]{Mariner's Curse} to her coven's spells.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

Stormsight.name: 风暴视界 Stormsight
Stormsight.description:
风、降水和云层不会妨碍风暴鬼婆的视野；她会无视由风暴、浓雾、降水等造成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽（状态）}状态。

Wind, precipitation, and clouds don't impair a storm hag's vision; she ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from storms, mist, precipitation, and the like.

Voice of the Storm.name: 风暴之声 Voice of the Storm
Voice of the Storm.description:
风暴鬼婆可以借助风，将口头信息或声音送到她曾见过且风所能到达的、50英里半径内的任何地点。她可以送出轻柔的低语或响亮的尖叫，并决定其是清晰可闻，还是仅仅勉强盖过风声而被听见。无论那里是否有人在场聆听，信息都会被送达。鬼婆可以用这种能力，以可怕的威胁或令人不安的末日低语，对听见她信息的生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{挫败士气}。

A storm hag can send spoken messages or sounds on the wind to any spot that she has seen and the wind can reach within a 50-mile radius. She can send a quiet whisper or a loud scream, and decides whether it's clearly audible or barely heard above the wind. The message is delivered regardless of whether anyone is present to hear it. The hag can use this ability to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} creatures that hear her message with dire threats or unnerving whispers of doom.

Sickened by Incense.name: 被熏香熏得恶心 Sickened by Incense
Sickened by Incense.description:
如果尤伽喀在其回合开始时邻近已点燃的熏香，她会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}，并且必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:27]豁免；在一次失败时，她改为因熏香而变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3}。如果她在其回合结束时邻近已点燃的熏香，她会因其引发的恶心而变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到其下个回合结束。

If Iogaka begins her turn adjacent to lit incense, she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save; on a failure, she instead becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} by the incense. If she ends her turn adjacent to lit incense, she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of her next turn by the nausea it causes her.

Wind Mastery.description:
风暴鬼婆不受自然或魔法强风影响。对她而言，多风环境不属于困难地形。

A storm hag is unaffected by strong winds, natural or magical. Windy conditions are not difficult terrain for her.
Wind Mastery.name: 御风精通 Wind Mastery

Stormcalling.name: 唤暴 Stormcalling
Stormcalling.description:
风暴鬼婆可以施放一个特殊的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{控制天气}仪式，此仪式不需要次要施法者，以改变其所在位置 5 英里范围内的天气，持续 [[/r 4d12 #Duration Stormcalling]]{4d12 小时}。主要检定是一次 @Check[occultism|dc:23]神秘学检定，且她的结果不会比失败更差。

风暴鬼婆只能制造飓风、雷暴雨和龙卷风，但无论当前是什么季节，她都可以如此做。她也可以平息自然天气事件，但她绝不会主动这样做。

A storm hag can perform a special @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{Control Weather} ritual, which requires no secondary casters, to change the weather within 5 miles of her location for [[/r 4d12 #Duration Stormcalling]]{4d12 hours}. The primary check is a @Check[occultism|dc:23] check, and she can't get an outcome worse than a failure.

The storm hag can create only hurricanes, thunderstorms, and tornadoes, but she can do so regardless of the current season. She can also quell natural weather events but never willingly does so.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
风暴鬼婆可以呈现任何中型类人生物女性的外观。这不会改变其速度，也不会改变其打击的攻击与伤害加值，但可能会改变其打击造成的伤害类型（通常变为钝击伤害）。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The storm hag can take on the appearance of any Medium humanoid woman. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Storm Passage.name: 风暴通道 Storm Passage
Storm Passage.description:
风暴鬼婆无视由风、雨和其他风暴天气造成的困难地形。

The storm hag ignores difficult terrain caused by wind, rain, and other stormy weather.

Jinkin.name: 蹑影小魔怪 Jinkin

Tinker.name: 修补匠 Tinker
Tinker.description:
六只蹑影小魔怪可以共同工作1小时，在60英尺射程内为一件物品附加一个诅咒。虽然这一过程耗时较长，但也很不显眼，并且可以在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}时进行。蹑影小魔怪更喜欢对魔法物品使用这一能力。该诅咒会使该物品变得不可靠（进行一次@Check[flat|dc:5]检定，否则任何用于交互该物品或启动该物品的动作都会被浪费），为使用该物品增添一个怪异需求，或施加其他类似程度的诅咒。

A group of six jinkins can work together for an hour to imbue an item with a curse at a range of 60 feet. While this process is lengthy, it's also unobtrusive and can be performed while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}. Jinkins prefer to use this ability on magic items. The curse makes the item unreliable (@Check[flat|dc:5] check or waste any action to Interact with or Activate the item), adds a bizarre requirement to use the item, or imparts some other curse of a similar caliber.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
蹑影小魔怪对措手不及的生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。

The jinkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Jinkin.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是残忍成性的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，还以自己能对珍贵物件施加诅咒的力量为傲。它们心怀怨念，一旦觉得自己受了轻慢，就会设计错综复杂的复仇计划，比如当某个生物竟敢移除它们施加的诅咒时。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱；它们同样从折磨与谋杀中获得极大快感，不过比起直接杀死受害者，它们更喜欢把受害者引入为俘获或制服而设计的陷阱。深坑是它们偏爱的手段，因为即便受害者在坠落后幸存下来，也会因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去，而蹑影小魔怪则聚集在坑边，对其讥笑折磨。

小魔怪是残忍的精类恶作剧者与破坏者，已经完全适应了物质宇宙中的生活，并为自己充满创意的毁灭性找到了明确的生态位。几乎所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎东西，无论是装置、载具之类有形之物，还是联盟、关系之类无形之物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是看着复杂造物走向崩溃，最好还是在它们那一点点精心针对的推动之后。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀比自己弱小的同类，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；更强大的小魔怪还会轻蔑地把它们称作“袋崽子”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge when they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than just kill them outright. Deep pits are a preferred method, since victims who survive their fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst while jinkins gather at the edge of pits to tease and torment them.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life in the Universe, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. Nearly all gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the slightest, carefully targeted nudge from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom stronger gremlins derisively call "baggies."

Stone Spider.name: 石蜘蛛 Stone Spider

Anchored Soul.name: 锚定灵魂 Anchored Soul
Anchored Soul.description: 石蜘蛛绑定与某个特定的定居点，必须保持在定居点边界10英里范围内。

Spirit Body.name: 魂魄躯体 Spirit Body
Spirit Body.description: 当没有栖身容器时，石蜘蛛是虚体且获得对全伤害的6抗力（力场伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]造成的伤害，精魂和命能除外；对非魔法伤害抗力加倍）。

Spirit Web Trap.name: 精魂网缚 Spirit Web Trap
Spirit Web Trap.description: 被石蜘蛛蛛网攻击命中的生物将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]，并被粘在最近的表面上直到其[[/act escape dc=22]]。

Bonded Vessel.name: 绑定容器 Bonded Vessel
Bonded Vessel.description: 石蜘蛛容器的状态决定了其最大生命值。未受损时，容器是一件具有62HP（BT 31）的物体。当石蜘蛛处于魂魄形态时，伤害它不会伤害到容器，但伤害容器会对石蜘蛛造成等量伤害。当石蜘蛛栖身在容器中时，他们是单个目标，伤害会同时减少石蜘蛛和容器的生命值。如果容器破损，石蜘蛛仍然可以栖身在其中正常战斗，不会遭不良影响，但如果容器被摧毁，那石蜘蛛会立即被杀死且无法重构。

Reconstitution.name: 重构 Reconstitution
Reconstitution.description: 当石蜘蛛变为0 HP时，它的魂魄就会消散。如果其绑定的容器完好无损，石狮幼崽会在[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后在此容器中重塑，被完全治愈。如果容器破损，它必须先被修复，随后幼崽会在[[/br 3d4 #days]]{3d4天}后重塑。

Inhabit Vessel.name: 栖身容器 Inhabit Vessel
Inhabit Vessel.description:
石蜘蛛接触并融入其绑定容器中，使得其活过来。它可以使用一个具有专注特征的单动作来结束栖身容器。当栖身容器时，它失去飞行速度，并获得：

免疫 治疗，非致命

抗力 物理 6（钝击除外）

速度 25尺，攀爬25尺

以及如下打击。

  • 近战 1 石牙 +14（娴熟），伤害 2d8+7穿刺

Stone Spider.publicNotes: 崇拜蜘蛛的传统是为了防止害虫，害鸟，和邪恶，总之比现代络新妇的统治要早，因此用是石蜘蛛来扮演类似石狮的角色。石蜘蛛护院兽可以安放在靠近城镇和村庄入口处的台座上，静止矗立——某些情况会静止几代人——以至于许多当地人都会忘了本地的护院兽不仅仅是一种装饰。

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description: 无面鬼士兵变成某个在过去24小时内接触过的小型或中型类人生物的无面版本。在变形期间，其脸部会被遮盖，士兵在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装 Impersonate}成该生物时获得+2环境加值。无面鬼士兵可以再次使用该能力变回原形。

Noppera-bo Grunt.name: 无面鬼士兵 Noppera-bo Grunt
Noppera-bo Grunt.publicNotes:
无面鬼士兵没有将自己的脸完全伪装成另一个人所必须的举止。

无面鬼会以普通人的样貌出现，甚至可能就是你认识的人，直到他们露出那张没有五官的脸。

完美专家 Consummate Professionals

虽然一般的无面鬼冷酷无情，沉迷于恐怖行径或折磨类人生物，但他们中不是全部都堕入恶道。中立的无面鬼往往是用能力进行欺骗和捉弄的恶作剧者，而稀有的善良无面鬼则用能力尊崇他们所崇拜的事物，同时专注于将他们的时间用于提升艺术和手艺的技艺。

无面鬼起源 Noppera-bo Origins

关于无面鬼起源有诸多理论——从用能力变形错误的化狸（tanuki），或是深陷诅咒的人形生物，又或是自然诞生的妖怪（yokai）。甚至有些理论说这种状态跟兽化症（lycanthropy）一样是可传染的诅咒。大多数无面鬼不记得自己的起源，而通常更感兴趣于完全伪装成另一个人。

Black Apoxia.name: 黑色缺氧症 Black Apoxia
Black Apoxia.description:
目标无法从由黑色缺氧症导致的疲乏（状态）中恢复，直到该疾病被治愈

豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良影响（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 和 疲乏（1天）

阶段 4 死亡

The target can't recover from the fatigued condition caused by black apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead

Brawling Critical.name: 搏击大成功或大失败 Brawling Critical
Brawling Critical.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以拳击打击或具有武僧（特征）的武器造成重击时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到该武僧下个回合结束。

When a monk of Kugaptee scores a critical hit with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the monk's next turn.

Sagebane.name: 贤者祸根 Sagebane
Sagebane.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以A:拳击打击或具有武僧（特征）的武器对一个活物造成伤害时，目标必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

苦迦菩提武僧随后造成的进一步伤害会将持续时间重置为1分钟，并且若豁免失败，则使呆滞值增加1，最大为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}。

When the monk of Kugaptee damages a living creature with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the monk of Kugaptee resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Steal Breath.name: 窃息 Steal Breath
Steal Breath.description:
需求 苦迦菩提武僧邻接一个处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、缓慢、震慑或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态的活物

效果 苦迦菩提武僧俯下身，吸出目标的气息；目标必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:22]豁免。无论结果如何，该生物都会暴露于猩红窒息症，且其呼吸在1分钟内都带有腐烂野花的恶臭。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在1分钟内无法说话。

失败 该生物变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}，且在1分钟内无法说话。

大失败 如失败，且该生物陷入失去意识并开始窒息。

Requirements The monk of Kugaptee is adjacent to a living creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, slowed, stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Effect The monk of Kugaptee leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to scarlet apoxia and its breath reeks of rotting wildflowers for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls unconscious and begins suffocating.

Stunning Flurry.name: 震慑连击 Stunning Flurry
Stunning Flurry.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 苦迦菩提武僧进行两次A:拳击打击。如果两次都命中同一个生物，则为了抗力和弱点的目的，将它们的伤害合并计算，且目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}（若为大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}）；此次豁免具有失能（特征）特征。

Frequency once per round

Effect The monk of Kugaptee makes two fist Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.

Scarlet Apoxia.name: 猩红窒息症 Scarlet Apoxia
Scarlet Apoxia.description:
目标无法从由猩红窒息症导致的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏（状态）}状态中恢复，直到该疾病被治愈

豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良影响（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 和疲乏（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 和疲乏（1天）

阶段 4 死亡（因猩红窒息症死亡的生物会在死后24小时轮回转世为一个等级等于或低于其原本等级的宁多鲁，除非其躯体得到妥善安葬；一旦轮回转世发生，该死亡生物在其所转生为的宁多鲁首先被杀死之前，无法恢复原本的生命）

The target can't recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition caused by scarlet apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead (a creature that dies of scarlet apoxia reincarnates as a nindoru of equal or lower level 24 hours after death unless the body is given a proper funeral; once reincarnation occurs, the dead creature can't be restored to its original life until after the nindoru it reincarnates into is first slain)

The Chewer.name: 咀嚼者 The Chewer
The Chewer.publicNotes:
一名生前违背了自身修道誓言的武僧，可能会在死后化为一种名为黑坊主的亡灵恐怖。这样的掠食者以凡人的气息为食，用扭曲的肢体悄然爬入卧室，夺走熟睡受害者的生命。这样的进食会在受害者身上留下痕迹，表现为呼吸中带有令人作呕的腐朽恶臭，以及一种会逐渐导致衰竭并最终致死的衰弱性疾病。

黑坊主仍保留着苦修训练的些许残响，使其能在战斗中从虚弱的敌人身上吸走气息。它们怀着恶意的狡猾与苦修者的自律相结合，使其能够策划精密而漫长的阴谋，以实施自己出于嫉妒的复仇。很少有黑坊主足够具有说服力，能诱使它们曾经的同伴违背自己的誓言，但这并不妨碍它们一次次尝试。

A monk who violated their monastic vows in life might arise after death to become an undead horror known as a kurobozu. These predators feast upon the breath of mortals, creeping on twisted limbs into bedrooms to steal the life from sleeping victims. This act of feeding leaves its mark on the victim in the form of a vile scent of rot on the victim's breath and a debilitating disease that eventually results in exhaustion and finally death.

Kurobozus retain echoes of their ascetic training, enabling them to suck the breath from debilitated foes in the midst of battle. Their malevolent cunning combined with ascetic discipline helps them concoct elaborate and lengthy schemes to enact their jealous revenge. Few kurobozus are convincing enough to persuade their onetime allies to break their own oaths, but this doesn't stop them from making the attempt.
The Chewer.blurb:
苦迦菩提武僧男性变体
Variant male monk of Kugaptee

Collapse Outward.name: 向外坍塌 Collapse Outward
Collapse Outward.description:
触发 从外部尝试解除该危害时严重失败，或有人试图爬进这堆木材中

效果 这堆木材向外坍塌，对4名狂欢者造成 @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] 基础豁免），并对困住狂欢者的中央10足见方周围10足区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] 基础豁免）。

Trigger An attempt to disable the hazard from outside critically fails, or someone attempts to clamber into the pile of lumber

Effect The pile collapses outward, inflicting @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage to the four revelers (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save), and @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to all creatures in a 10-foot area surrounding the central 10-foot-square where the revelers were trapped.

Collapse Inward.name: 向内坍塌 Collapse Inward
Collapse Inward.description:
触发 危害内四名狂欢者中的任意一人进行任何带有移动（特征）的动作

效果 那堆瓦砾崩溃并砸向四名狂欢者，对他们每人造成 @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] 反射豁免）。四人还会受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]] 伤害，直到他们被人以一次 @Check[athletics|dc:17] 运动检定从瓦砾中拉出，或能够 [[/act escape dc=17]]。

Trigger Any of the four revelers within the hazard perform any action with the Move trait

Effect The pile collapses onto the four revelers, dealing @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to each of them. All four also take @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]] damage until they're pulled from the rubble with a @Check[athletics|dc:17] check or can [[/act escape dc=17]].

Haphazard Wood Pile.name: 杂乱的木柴堆 Haphazard Wood Pile
Haphazard Wood Pile.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:17]（受训） 、@Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）或 @Check[engineering-lore|dc:17]（受训）以弄清如何安全地拆解这堆东西而不让它坍塌砸到任何人。

@Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained), @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained), or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:17] (trained) to figure out how to safely dismantle the pile without it collapsing on anyone.
Haphazard Wood Pile.hazarddescription:
沉重而尖锐的木梁彼此倚靠，组成了一个摇摇欲坠、勉强维持平衡的笼子，并系在数根绊摔线和承受张力的木钉上。

Beams of heavy and sharp wood rest against one another to form a precariously balanced cage tied to several trip lines and tension-bearing dowels.
Haphazard Wood Pile.stealthdetails:
（受训）以察觉这堆东西在有人解除它时可能如何倒向那人；难度等级 0 可看见这堆东西。

(trained) to notice how the pile might fall on a person disabling it; DC 0 to see the pile.

prototypeToken.name: 杂乱的木柴堆 Haphazard Wood Pile

Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Primal).name: 无面鬼原能模仿者 Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Primal)

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description: 无面鬼模仿者携带一件+1强击武器，看上去与被模仿的PC最喜爱的武器完全相同。如果PC喜爱无武装打击，它会呈现为缠手带。如果PC喜爱远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上述的远程武器规则；除此之外，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果PC们没有喜爱的武器，无面鬼会持用一件棍棒作为它的虚假武器。虚假武器只是部分真实，在命中时只会造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损，被卸武，或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟的时间重塑来制造一件替代虚假武器。

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description: 无面鬼模仿者获得一套内在法术，对应被模仿的PC所使用的施法根源。你可以调整法术来让其更完美适合模仿。

Distracting Giggle.name: 分神讪笑 Distracting Giggle
Distracting Giggle.description: 15尺。草人的讪笑声在脑海中回荡。灵光内的生物在意志豁免上承受–1状态减值。

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: 当草人被火焰以外伤害摧毁时，它尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:11]检定。如果成功，它将于[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 天}在被摧毁处重塑，被完全治愈。草人在被火焰伤害减至0生命值，或有障碍阻止灵魂获得新形体时，总是会被永久摧毁。

Thatchling's Curse.name: 草人诅咒 Thatchling's Curse
Thatchling's Curse.description:
草人将注意力集中于30尺内单个可见生物，然后开始喃喃低语起废话。目标尝试一次@Check[will|dc:16]豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，且暂时免疫草人诅咒24小时。

成功 目标暂时迷失方向，难以向正确方向移动。目标在速度上承受–5尺减值1轮。

失败 同成功，但速度减值持续1分钟。

大失败 同失败，但速度减值持续到诅咒被移除，或直到创造该效果的草人被永久摧毁，以先触发为准。此外，当被诅咒的生物尝试生存检定来辨别方向或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]时，其使用比检定结果低一级的成功度，其不能采用侦察探索期行动。

Thicket Walker.name: 灌木行者 Thicket Walker
Thicket Walker.description: 草人忽略由荆棘，缠绕的草丛和灌木形成的困难地形。

Thatchling.name: 草人 Thatchling
Thatchling.publicNotes:
通常的草人看上去像是一束人形的干草和树枝，由看上去像是蓝色的头发缠绕在一起。这些小型不死生物不能形成比人类小孩更大的躯体。

在神门乡村，一些善解（Sangpotshi）分支会警告，如果一个注定要转世的灵魂被阻止进入灵魂之河重新加入轮回的话会发生什么。这些灵魂会变得沮丧，困惑，然后是对他们并非处于应得的身体中而感到愤怒，反过来，他们又强迫植物化作他们的新身体。其他理论则称当一具尸体被埋在浅墓中，草根就会向下碰到遗骸，缠绕上灵魂然后抓住它。

草人具有智力且能够说话，但很少这么做——他们通常对那些拥有自己所渴望生命的人没什么好说的。罕有的情况下，单个草人会通过向某人寻求帮助，尝试引诱某人进入高草丛或灌木茂盛的区域，但他们并不擅长欺骗，所以这种策略并没有让他们看上去像是真正需要帮助的活物。

False Victory.name: 虚假胜利 False Victory
False Victory.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:27] 以使危害在其显现之前隐纹，或 @Check[deception|dc:30] 假装无视不断扩大的连续性断裂并毫无恐惧地继续前进，使其自行崩溃。

@Check[occultism|dc:27] to cause the hazard to fade away before it manifests, or @Check[deception|dc:30] to pretend to ignore the growing continuity break and proceed without fear, causing it to collapse in on itself.
False Victory.hazarddescription:
在战斗结束后，战场会诡异地闪烁，尸体抽搐，被摧毁的物体震动，而既视感也变得强烈到压倒一切。

After a battle concludes, the battlefield shimmers strangely as dead bodies twitch, destroyed objects shake, and feelings of déjà vu grow overwhelmingly strong.

Reaction.name: 反应动作 Reaction
Reaction.description:
触发 PC们结束了一个发生过战斗的遭遇

效果 心景开始逆转战斗的结果，将一切转回遭遇开始时的样子。这个逆转需要1轮才能完成，在此期间，PC们可以尝试解除该危害，或进行任何其他动作，为再次面对同一遭遇做准备。在该轮结束时，遭遇重置，并重新掷先攻；所有敌人和环境要素都会恢复到战斗开始前的状态，但PC们自己不会。

Trigger The PCs conclude an encounter in which a battle took place

Effect The mindscape starts to revert the results of the battle, shifting things back to the way they were at the start of the encounter. The reversion takes 1 round to complete, during which the PCs can attempt to disable the hazard or take any other actions to prepare for facing the same encounter over again. At the end of the round, the encounter resets and initiative is rolled again; all foes and environmental elements return to the condition they were in just before the fight began, but the PCs themselves do not.

Spiritual Disruptor.name: 灵性干扰器 Spiritual Disruptor
Spiritual Disruptor.reset:
如果两个危害都被解除或摧毁，则在[[/gmr 1d4+2 #Rounds]]轮后，会在仍位于正在坍塌的建筑内的一名随机决定的角色 adjacent to 形成一个新的危害。一旦所有三名非玩家角色都被救出或驱邪，这些危害就不会重置。

If both hazards are disabled or destroyed, a new one forms adjacent to a randomly determined character still inside the crumbling building after [[/gmr 1d4+2 #Rounds]] rounds. Once all three NPCs are rescued or exorcised, these hazards don't reset.
Spiritual Disruptor.disable:
@Check[intimidation|dc:23]（专家）以扰乱作祟在现世中的专注并切断其与心景的联系，@Check[religion|dc:27]（专家）以将能量从心景中驱逐，或 @Check[occultism|dc:30]（专家）以使作祟的能量反噬其自身并将其抵消

@Check[intimidation|dc:23] (expert) to disrupt the haunt's concentration in the living world and break its link to the mindscape, @Check[religion|dc:27] (expert) to banish the energy from the mindscape, or @Check[occultism|dc:30] (expert) to turn the haunt's energy back against itself to cancel it out
Spiritual Disruptor.hazarddescription:
一个闪烁不定的类人生物身影，长着四只金色眼睛，身穿红袍黑袖，手持一支燃烧着红色火焰与烟雾的火把，在地面上坚定地前行；它周围的现实发生扭曲，使木头弯折腐朽，并让血肉中传来令人痛苦万分的剧痛。

A flickering humanoid shape with four gold eyes, clad in red robes with black sleeves and wielding a torch that burns with red fire and smoke, strides purposefully across the ground, creating distortions in reality around it that cause wood to twist and decay and sends agonizing pain through the flesh.
Spiritual Disruptor.routine:
（3 动作）灵性干扰器每轮的第一个动作总是会在一个 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] 中制造一阵起伏的能量脉冲，使周围的结构看起来迅速老化并发生扭曲，导致该区域内的地面变为困难地形。如果灵性干扰器邻接一个活着的目标，它会尝试以其冒烟的火把进行一次打击，以扰乱该目标的生命能量。如果灵性干扰器未邻接活着的目标，它便会朝最近的目标进行魅影野猪行走。若其邻接多个目标，灵性干扰器会优先选择等级较高的目标；如果邻接的多个同等级目标存在，则随机选择其一。

(3 actions) The spiritual disruptor's first action each round is always to create a pulse of rippling energy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] that causes the surrounding structure to appear to age rapidly and become distorted, causing the ground in this area to become difficult terrain. If the spiritual disruptor is adjacent to a living target, it attempts to disrupt that target's life energy by making a Strike with its smoking torch. If the spiritual disruptor isn't adjacent to a living target, it Strides toward the closest target. If it has multiple adjacent targets, the spiritual disruptor favors higher-level targets, selecting randomly from multiple adjacent equal-level targets.

Manifest.name: 显现 Manifest
Manifest.description:
触发 PCs进入该建筑，或以其他方式与建筑及其内容进行交互

效果 一台灵性干扰器在所有标记为A4的分布地点显现。随后，这两个危害掷先攻。

Trigger The PCs enter or otherwise interact with the building and its contents

Effect A spiritual disruptor manifests at both locations marked A4. Both hazards then roll initiative.

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description: 无面鬼骗子变成某个在过去24小时内接触过的小型或中型类人生物的无面版本，获得目标生物的脸和声音。在变形期间，其脸部会被遮盖，骗子在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装 Impersonate}成该生物时获得+2环境加值。只要无面鬼骗子拥有一张脸，他就会失去无面能力以及所列免疫。无面鬼可以再次使用该能力变回原形。

Remove Face.name: 移除面容 Remove Face
Remove Face.description:
需求 无面鬼骗子正乔装成一个有脸的生物

效果 无面鬼骗子的脸部特征融化成虚无，并恐吓30尺内一个生物。该生物如果在DC 17意志豁免中失败，将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}（大失败时为@Check[will|dc:17] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}）。

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: 无面鬼骗子对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]的生物造成额外1d4精准伤害。

Noppera-bo Trickster.name: 无面鬼骗子 Noppera-bo Trickster
Noppera-bo Trickster.publicNotes:
这些无面鬼是伪装艺术的大师。

无面鬼会以普通人的样貌出现，甚至可能就是你认识的人，直到他们露出那张没有五官的脸。

完美专家 Consummate Professionals

虽然一般的无面鬼冷酷无情，沉迷于恐怖行径或折磨类人生物，但他们中不是全部都堕入恶道。中立的无面鬼往往是用能力进行欺骗和捉弄的恶作剧者，而稀有的善良无面鬼则用能力尊崇他们所崇拜的事物，同时专注于将他们的时间用于提升艺术和手艺的技艺。

无面鬼起源 Noppera-bo Origins

关于无面鬼起源有诸多理论——从用能力变形错误的化狸（tanuki），或是深陷诅咒的人形生物，又或是自然诞生的妖怪（yokai）。甚至有些理论说这种状态跟兽化症（lycanthropy）一样是可传染的诅咒。大多数无面鬼不记得自己的起源，而通常更感兴趣于完全伪装成另一个人。

Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。
Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description: 无面鬼模仿者携带一件+1强击武器，看上去与被模仿的PC最喜爱的武器完全相同。如果PC喜爱无武装打击，它会呈现为缠手带。如果PC喜爱远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上述的远程武器规则；除此之外，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果PC们没有喜爱的武器，无面鬼会持用一件棍棒作为它的虚假武器。虚假武器只是部分真实，在命中时只会造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损，被卸武，或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟的时间重塑来制造一件替代虚假武器。

Impersonated Abilities.name: 模仿能力 Impersonated Abilities
Impersonated Abilities.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得如下能力之一，由你选择。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kkP0tagXmAYuSH3u]

  • 着甲 Armored 无面鬼模仿者似乎全副武装，其AC提升至24。
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.W7SbTykXrNwxDzJc]
  • 持盾者 Shield Carrier 无面鬼携带一面 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f9ygr5Cjrmop8LWV]（在其被摧毁，丢下，或无面鬼死亡时会变为无用的道具），且其获得盾牌格挡通用专长。
  • 武器提升 Weapon Perk 无面鬼从如下武器特征中选择一项添加至虚假武器上：灵巧，致命d8，叠劲，格挡，长触及，推撞，横扫，或摔绊。

Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Martial).name: 无面鬼武术模仿者 Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Martial)

Heh Shan-Bao.name: 和善保 Heh Shan-Bao
Heh Shan-Bao.blurb:
男性人类总督
Male human governor

Esoteric Lore.name: 秘传学识 Esoteric Lore
Esoteric Lore.description:
和善保可以尝试以 +15 调整值对任何主题进行回忆知识。

Heh Shan-Bao can attempt to Recall Knowledge on any topic with a +15 modifier.

Reflecting Ward.name: 护身结界 Reflecting Ward
Reflecting Ward.description:
频率 每天两次

触发 和善保将要受到任意形式的能量伤害

效果 和善保随身携带的许多原本非魔法的符箓之一会闪耀出金色光亮并碎裂成灰，使他对触发的伤害类型获得 10 点抗力，持续 1 分钟，或直到他再次使用这个能力。

Frequency twice per day

Trigger Heh Shan-Bao would take any form of energy damage

Effect One of the many otherwise non-magical fulus Heh Shan-Bao keeps on his person flashes with golden light and crumbles to ash, granting him resistance 10 to the triggering damage type for 1 minute, or until he uses this ability again.

Scroll Thaumaturgy.name: 卷轴奇术 Scroll Thaumaturgy
Scroll Thaumaturgy.description:
和善保的魔法训练使他即使自身并无真正的施法能力，也能启动任何根源的卷轴。他使用任何卷轴时，其法术DC为28，法术攻击加值为+20。

Heh Shan-Bao's magical training allows him to activate scrolls of any tradition despite having no actual spellcasting power of his own. His spell DC is 28, and his spell attack is +20 for any scroll he uses.

Scroll Esoterica.name: 卷轴秘藏 Scroll Esoterica
Scroll Esoterica.description:
和善保每天早晨会制造九张临时卷轴，这些卷轴会在24小时后失去魔法。在普通的一天里，这位镇长可供使用的卷轴如下。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3x6eUCm17n6ROzUa]{信仰危机}卷轴（4环）

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YrzBLPLd3r9m6t1p]{火焰护盾}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{焰击术}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{加速术}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{水流爆发}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物}卷轴（5环）

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{幻象场景}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{隐形术}卷轴

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{安抚术}卷轴（4环）

Heh Shan-Bao creates a set of nine temporary scrolls each morning that lose their magic after 24 hours. On a typical day, the governor has the scrolls listed below available for use.

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3x6eUCm17n6ROzUa]{Crisis of Faith} (4th level)

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YrzBLPLd3r9m6t1p]{Fire Shield}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{Flame Strike}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{Hydraulic Torrent}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} (5th level)

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}

scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe} (4th level)

Bakeneko.name: 化猫 Bakeneko
Bakeneko.publicNotes:
当一只猫超出其正常寿命后，化猫便诞生了，无论是借由难以置信的运气，魔法，或是其他原因。随着时间推移，猫会变得越来越可怕——体型越来越大，变得越来越聪明，并获得对魔法的亲和力。最终，他们能够用后腿直立行走，追求新爱好，并学会言语。虽然智力得到了增长，但许多化猫会更喜欢他们进化的头几十年，继续作为一只（通常体型更大的）家猫如常生活。虽说对于一些化猫而言，他们想要获取作为猫而无法领悟的世界的知识，但对于其他化猫来说，他们只是渴望和现在的家人和所爱之人一起生活，然后再谈接下来的事情。

化猫在所有娱乐活动中最喜欢的是跳舞，他们会忍不住随着音乐点头，敲爪，拍打尾巴。他们经常活化尸体只是为了看他们跳舞——这种消遣经常会给附近的聚集地带来麻烦，因为不死生物会脱离化猫的掌控。化猫通常有着爱玩闹淘气的性格，虽然他们不是天生邪恶的生物，但他们仍然因活化尸体和挥使火焰的能力而被恐惧。村民们经常会被漫步在行尸旁燃烧着的猫而吓得半死，而化猫与邪恶和神秘现象之间的联系导致天夏一些村庄对所有猫的诋毁。

猫又 Nekomatas

化猫大多数时候会把他们唤起但无心智的丧尸视作娱乐，不过他们也把丧尸视作护卫，甚至是复仇的代理人。不过他们还是会尽力确保他们唤起的不死生物不会被抛下随意乱逛。多数有关“邪恶化猫”的传说事实上指的是一种相似但危险得多的生物，猫又——一种6级中型体型的化猫变种，其咬伤会导致一种使心智衰弱的疾病。

Cat at Heart.name: 心中猫 Cat at Heart
Cat at Heart.description: 当化猫被杀死时，它会立即转世成为一只普通家猫，且再也无法再次成为化猫。

Flammable.name: 易燃 Flammable
Flammable.description:
由于其高脂饮食，化猫会从皮肤上分泌易燃油脂覆盖皮毛。如果化猫受到任何火焰伤害，它整具身体都会燃烧起来，将它变成一团毛茸茸的火球，直到其下回合结束。因此燃烧期间，化猫的打击造成额外1d6火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.insc09aslLptd0dN]{效果：易燃}

Feel the Beat.name: 感受节拍 Feel the Beat
Feel the Beat.description: 化猫喜欢跳舞。如果化猫开始回合时周围30尺内有音乐来源，它将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}直到其下回合开始，因为它遵循了跟随曲子韵律的冲动，仍不住拍打尾巴，来回跺脚，或拍打前爪。

Skilled Ritualist.name: 娴熟主祭 Skilled Ritualist
Skilled Ritualist.description: 化猫只能用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{唤起死灵 Create Undead}创造丧尸，但可以在没有次要施法者的情况下举行仪式，且降低施法时间到4小时。

Far Too Drunk.name: 醉得离谱 Far Too Drunk
Far Too Drunk.description:
蹑影小魔怪在使用其动作时效率低下，并且每轮总会花费一个动作来咯咯怪笑、原地踉跄，或以其他方式做出无效的滑稽举动。

The jinkins are inefficient with their actions and always spend one action each round to cackle, stumble in place, or otherwise perform ineffective antics.

Very Drunken Jinkin.blurb:
变种蹑影小魔怪
Variant jinkins
Very Drunken Jinkin.name: 非常醉的金金 Very Drunken Jinkin
Very Drunken Jinkin.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是施虐成性的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，还对自己诅咒珍贵物件的能力引以为傲。每当它们觉得自己受了怠慢——例如有生物胆敢移除它们施加的某个诅咒——便会心怀怨念，策划错综复杂的复仇阴谋。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱；它们同样从折磨与谋杀中获得巨大的快感，不过它们更喜欢把受害者引入那些旨在俘获或使其失去行动能力、而非直接杀死的陷阱。深坑是它们的最爱，因为从坠落中幸存下来的受害者还将面临因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去的命运。蹑影小魔怪喜欢聚集在坑边，嘲弄、戏耍并折磨受害者。

小魔怪是残忍的精类诡计家与破坏者，早已完全适应了主物质位面的生活，并为自己富有创意的毁灭性行径找到了各自明确的生态位。所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎东西，无论那是装置、载具之类的有形之物，还是联盟、关系之类的无形事物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是看着复杂造物崩溃，最好还是在它们以最轻微、最细小且精心瞄准的一推之后发生。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀自己较弱小的同类，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；小魔怪（以及许多其他人）还会轻蔑地把它们称作“螨怪”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge whenever they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than kill outright. Deep pits are favorites, since victims who survive the fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst. Jinkins enjoy gathering at the edge of pits to mock, tease, and torment.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life on the Material Plane, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. All gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the lightest and slightest, carefully targeted push from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom gremlins (and many others) derisively call "mites."

prototypeToken.name: 非常醉的金金 Very Drunken Jinkin

Phantom Raven.name: 魅影渡鸦 Phantom Raven

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影行走于灵界位面与物质宇宙之间的狭窄界线上，从而同时存在于这两个位面之上。

它们可以再次使用中此能力，转回仅存在于灵界位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal Plane and the Universe in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影不是活物，但它们也不是不死生物，并且会对死亡效果表现出独特的脆弱性。

若魅影因死亡效果（例如来自类似 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} 的法术）而使其生命值降至 0，它会立即被送往灵魂之河，在那里它的灵魂会继续踏上通往来世的通常道路。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Vulnerable to Kindness.name: 友善易伤 Vulnerable to Kindness
Vulnerable to Kindness.description:
任何位于30尺内且魅影能看见并听见的生物，都可以用一个具有听觉、专注、语言和心灵（特征）特征的双动作行动，向它发出镇静且友善的问候。以这种方式向魅影问候的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] 检定。

大成功 魅影受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

成功 魅影受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害。

失败 魅影受到 @Damage[1d8[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 魅影不受影响，并且在1轮内不受此弱点影响。

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the auditory, concentrate, linguistic, and mental traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] check.

Critical Success The phantom takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The phantom takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

Failure The phantom takes @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.

Phantom Raven.publicNotes:
多数神学家认为，灵魂通往来世的普通轨迹相当直接。当一名凡人死去时，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。被审判过的灵魂会前往其最终安息的相应领域——天堂、地狱、荒原等等——并在那里成为祈愿者。

然而，当一个正在排队等待审判的灵魂过早脱离灵魂之河，并被转移到灵界位面时，情况就会变得复杂。无论这是由于暗夜夜鬼婆之类心怀恶意的闯入者、凶险的位面魔法，还是甚至出于命运，这些灵魂都会脱离生与死的自然秩序，滞留在某种炼狱状态之中。与祈愿者不同，这些灵界魅影保留着死前生时的记忆；而与幽灵之类的精魂不同，魅影并未沾染亡灵那种污秽的影响——至少起初并非如此，尽管腐化的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈从于那样的命运，而另一些则终会重新回归灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游移的灵魂自成一类——一种没有真正家园、目标或意义的存在。

许多魅影都不愿继续停留在这种奇异的炼狱状态中，要么是因为他们想继续自己穿行灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为他们害怕亡灵腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环，并接受审判以继续前往来世，魅影只需找到回到灵魂之河的方法即可。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——灵界位面朦胧的浓雾足以令即便最老练的旅者也迷失困惑，而众多掠食者则在这片领域中游荡，搜索那些离群的灵魂，以便将其束缚或吞噬。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

Explosive Manifestation.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:27]以使危害隐纹而不触发它，或 @Check[survival|dc:30]以感知现实的哪些部分正在变动，并避开该区域

@Check[occultism|dc:27] to cause the hazard to fade away without triggering it, or @Check[survival|dc:30] to sense what parts of reality are in flux and to avoid the area

Reaction.name: 反应动作（） Reaction
Reaction.description:
触发 一个生物对该危险的物体进行交互，或踏入该危险的区域

效果 一阵突如其来的爆炸引爆，以触发生物所在的方格为中心。此次爆炸充满一个 @Template[burst|distance:20]，并对区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[(4d10+18)[untyped]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] 豁免）。伤害类型由游戏主持从物理（钝击或穿刺）、或酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波中选择。

这场爆炸显现的描述应根据所造成的伤害类型而变化，但也应取材于触发生物的过往，仿佛旧日伤痕的记忆突然带着复仇席卷而来。一次造成穿刺伤害的爆发显现，可能表现为无数尖刺突然自地面向上迸射而出（源于某个生物记忆中自己曾跌入布满尖刺的地狱深坑、险些丧命的经历）。一次造成火焰伤害的爆发显现，则可能伴随着一声龙类的咆哮，空气骤然爆发成烈焰（来自某个生物记忆中自己曾险些被一头龙类焚烧殆尽的经历）。片刻之后，该危害显现的一切痕迹都会消失（除了它对其区域内生物造成的伤害之外）。

Trigger A creature Interacts with the hazardous object, or steps into the hazardous area

Effect A sudden blast detonates, centered on the triggering creature's square. This blast fills a @Template[burst|distance:20] and inflicts @Damage[(4d10+18)[untyped]] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). The type of damage is chosen by the GM from physical (bludgeoning or piercing), or from acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The description of how this explosion manifests should vary to match the type of damage inflicted, but should also draw from the triggering creature's past, as if memories of old wounds had suddenly come back with a vengeance. An explosive manifestation that deals piercing damage might be conveyed as a sudden blast of spikes radiating up out of the ground (stemming from a creature's memory of the time it fell into a spiked pit and almost died). One that deals fire damage might involve the sound of a dragon's roar as the air erupts into flames (coming from a creature's memory of being nearly incinerated by a dragon). A moment later, all evidence of the hazard's manifestation (save for the damage it causes to the creatures in its area) vanish.

Explosive Manifestation.name: 爆发显现 Explosive Manifestation
Explosive Manifestation.hazarddescription:
现实突然且猛烈地扭曲，将一片无害的地形转变为真正致命之物，因为心景汲取痛苦与折磨的记忆，使旧日创伤再度重现。

Reality suddenly and violently transforms, shifting from a harmless patch of terrain into something truly deadly as the mindscape draws from memories of pain and agony, revisiting old wounds.

Dalgyal Gwishin.name: 蛋脸鬼 Dalgyal Gwishin

Stone-Faced.name: 石脸 Stone-Faced
Stone-Faced.description: 虽然蛋脸鬼没有物理身体，但它的石脸是固体。它不能穿越固态物体。

Jealous Frenzy.name: 嫉妒狂暴 Jealous Frenzy
Jealous Frenzy.description:
触发 蛋脸鬼打击一个拥有比它更高魅力调整值的生物

效果 蛋脸鬼进入一种嫉妒的狂暴中，因为它感受到了打击的生物身上强烈的友谊和气质。蛋脸鬼获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]，但只能用迅捷动作打击触发生物。如果蛋脸鬼在其回合打击触发生物失败至少一次，嫉妒狂暴结束。该能力也将在持续1分钟之后结束。在嫉妒狂暴结束后，蛋脸鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

Peel Face.name: 剥取面容 Peel Face
Peel Face.description:
触发 蛋脸鬼处于嫉妒狂暴期间重击命中一个生物或将一个生物减至0生命值

效果 蛋脸鬼将它的石头脸压在生物的脸上，在那张脸上留下幽灵般的印痕，然后将其剥走复制到自己的头上。触发生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}）。蛋脸鬼的嫉妒狂暴结束，且不会陷入缓慢。

Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet.name: 生命感知（精准） 120尺 Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet
Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet.description:
蛋脸鬼能够感知到所列范围内活物与不死生物的生命本质。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Lifesense]

Lifesense.name: 生命感应 Lifesense
Lifesense.description:
蛋脸鬼感知列出射程内活着的与不死生物的生物所拥有的活力要素。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Lifesense]

The dalgyal gwishin senses the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Lifesense]

Dalgyal Gwishin.publicNotes:
蛋脸鬼是带着石头面具的无脸不死精魂。这种孤独的不死生物来自于孤独死去，无人记得的凡人灵魂，他同样也无法记起自己生前的模样。蛋脸鬼在生前的土地上徘徊，寻找着自己生前的痕迹。他们满腔怒火，嫉妒着被亲朋好友或崇拜者包围的受人爱戴或知名的人士——这类人永远不会和蛋脸鬼有着相同的命运。

虽然蛋脸鬼有着近乎由迷雾构成的幽灵身躯，但它戴在头上的无五官石头面具是固体。即便它偷走了脸也是暂时的，会在一天之后破裂，看上去就像破碎的陶瓷死人面具。这些孤独的灵魂保存着这些面具，将它们收藏在偏远孤僻的巢穴中，希望能在越来越多沉默的面容展览中找到陪伴。

无面骇物 Faceless Horror

蛋脸鬼最主要的物理特征——缺失面容——与被称作无面鬼的活着的异怪相同。虽然有着同样的特征和偷窃面容的能力，但两种生物并不合作，且往往是敌人。任何被蛋脸鬼杀死的人都会留下一具令人不安的无脸尸体。
Dalgyal Gwishin.languages: （不能说出任何语言）；心灵感应120尺

Xin Yue.name: 新月 Xin Yue
Xin Yue.blurb: 女性变种苦迦菩提不灭侍僧

Chastise Heretic.name: 惩戒异教徒 Chastise Heretic
Chastise Heretic.description:
触发 新月可见的60尺内的一个生物施放神术法术

效果 新月尝试用其法术攻击调整来反制触发法术，反制等级为4。如果法术被反制，施法者受到@Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]]伤害。如果新月反制法术失败，施法者将临时免疫此法术的继续使用，持续24小时。

Field of Past Regrets.name: 前尘憾事气场 Field of Past Regrets
Field of Past Regrets.description: 40尺。灵光范围内所有拥有至少一次前世的生物（包括所有PC）会回忆起前世的失败，并在对抗反复回忆中提振精神，在对抗心灵效果时豁免+1状态加值。灵光范围内活着的非灵堕魔生物，在承受心灵攻击时，会感觉到来自所有前世的痛苦，以及当下的痛苦，获得对心灵伤害的弱点3。

Profane Reincarnation.name: 亵渎转世 Profane Reincarnation
Profane Reincarnation.description:
频率 每1000天一次

触发 新月减至0生命值

效果 新月发出一声尖叫，伴随她不死的身躯裂开，短剑破损。她立即转世成为一名@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.season-of-ghosts-bestiary.Actor.TVi4RDeqw7GDsxp0]灵堕魔，带有精英生物调整。

Near-Death Experience.name: 濒死体验 Near-Death Experience
Near-Death Experience.description:
触发 新月将一个生物减至0生命值并使其获得濒死状态

效果 对于濒死的生物来说，时间似乎变慢了，因为他濒死体验的巨大压力使他的大脑超速运转。目标看到他自己的生命在眼前闪过，抵抗死亡的冲动愈发强烈。目标减少其复苏DC 2，但如果他失去濒死状态，则必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.3HaT8gBo8krdVniF]

大成功 生物因该体验而被强化，获得快速治疗5，持续1分钟。

成功 生物因该体验而被强化，获得快速治疗1，持续1分钟。

失败 生物因该体验而变得沮丧，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续24小时。

大失败 生物因该体验而变得麻木，陷入呆滞1（持续1周）与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ejnUAEdbvj6uPuNJ]

Xin Yue.publicNotes:
当一名神祇或神祇的先驱花费一小点力量来唤回一个祭司时，一位不灭侍僧就会诞生。有些祭司生前的力量则强到能够以自己的意志归来，尽管它们的实力会被大大削弱。

不灭侍僧在不死生物中是个异类。他们既不是自愿被转化为亡灵，严格意义上说，也不是违背意愿被转化。不灭侍僧的诞生是一名神祇的直接干预行为，这既是赐福也是诅咒，通常被赠与那些因无法控制的情况而未能完成神圣使命的忠实牧师。

Willowshore Waldgeist.name: 柳岸镇林鬼 Willowshore Waldgeist

Fleeting Existence.name: 短暂存在 Fleeting Existence
Fleeting Existence.description:
这些林鬼只是一次失败驱邪所产生的短暂显现。自它们在心景中首次显现起经过 1 分钟后，它们便会无影无踪地消失。

These waldgeists are only fleeting manifestations of a failed exorcism. They vanish without a trace after 1 minute has passed from their first manifestation in the mindscape.

Lignify.name: 木质化 Lignify
Lignify.description:
林鬼的接触会将血肉转化为木头。被林鬼的木质化之手打击造成伤害的活物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}）。此后，对木质化的豁免若再次失败，会提高缓慢（状态）状态的等级。一旦某生物因木质化使其动作减少至0，该生物便会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}，只是它们会被转化为木头而非石头。

The touch of a waldgeist transforms flesh into wood. A living creature damaged by the waldgeist's lignifying hand Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure). Further failed saves against lignify increases the slowed condition. Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by lignify, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}, except they're transformed into wood instead of stone.

Papery Lignification.name: 纸化木质化 Papery Lignification
Papery Lignification.description:
柳岸镇林鬼的接触会将血肉转化为厚重的纸卷与压缩的纸张。被林鬼的木质化根源打击伤害到的活物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24|inflicts:slowed,inflicts:petrified] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}（若大失败，则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}）。之后对纸质木化的豁免若再次失败，会提高缓慢（状态）。一旦某生物因纸质木化而使其动作减少至0，该生物便会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}，但它们并非化为石头，而是被转化为一尊压缩纸张构成的雕像（很像纸塑）。幸运的是，这种状态并非永久；当柳岸镇林鬼在显现1分钟后消失时，被变成纸张的生物会恢复为活体血肉，但会因这场命运占卜般可怖的转变而处于0生命值并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}（但并未濒死）。

The touch of a Willowshore waldgeist transforms flesh into thick rolls and compressed sheets of paper. A living creature damaged by the waldgeist's lignifying root Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|inflicts:slowed,inflicts:petrified] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure). Further failed saves against papery lignification increases the slowed condition. Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by papery lignification, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}, except they're transformed into a statue of compressed paper (much like paper-mache) instead of turned to stone. Fortunately, this condition isn't permanent, and once the Willowshore waldgeists vanish a minute after they've manifested, creatures that have been turned to paper revert to living flesh, but are at 0 Hit Points and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (but not dying) from the trauma of the harrowing transformation.

Storm of Paper.name: 纸张风暴 Storm of Paper
Storm of Paper.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 柳岸镇林鬼令成千上万张纸从云纸屋的废墟中飞出，切割并割伤血肉。所有位于柳岸镇林鬼90尺内 @Template[type:burst|distance:20] 中的生物受到 @Damage[8d6[slashing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] 基础豁免）。严重失败此次豁免的生物会被部分埋入成堆的纸张中，并在1轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

Frequency once per day

Effect The Willowshore waldgeist causes thousands of sheets of paper to fly out of the ruins of Cloud Paper House to slice and cut flesh. All creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] within 90 feet of the Willowshore waldgeist take @Damage[8d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). A creature that critically fails this save becomes partially buried in mounds of paper sheets and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Willowshore Waldgeist.publicNotes:
林鬼作为自然的化身而行动，会为环境遭到的虐待——如污染与滥伐森林——寻求复仇。这些由被摧毁树木形成的不死生物精魂，会在树木被毁之处生成；若原本地点已被彻底夷平，则会在附近的林地中出现。它们会成为森林的守护者，掌控其边界内植物的力量。对于任何被它们发现正在破坏其所联结林地的人，林鬼都不会施以救济；无论是伐木工、精类、旅人还是入侵物种，它们都会一视同仁地加以攻击。

当灾害降临自然世界时，可能会有另一类不死生物崛起，与复苏的类人生物截然不同。大多数植物、鱼类、昆虫和其他动物，并不具备足够复杂的心智，无法在没有外力干预的情况下经历变成不死生物所需的情感宣情。而大规模灭绝就能成为那种外力。

类人生物将整片森林皆伐殆尽，或海滨社群灭绝了对其生态系统至关重要的某个物种，都可能催生出翠腐体。垂死生物群系的集体精神能量与情绪痛苦为这些不死生物提供动力；它们会以聚合体或代表者的形态形成。

Waldgeists act as avatars of nature that seek vengeance for environmental abuse, such as pollution and deforestation. These undead spirits of destroyed trees form at the site of their destruction or in a nearby woodland, if the original location was entirely razed. They become guardians of the forest, possessing power over the plants within its boundaries. Waldgeists show no mercy to anyone caught damaging their bonded woodland, attacking loggers, fey, travelers, and invasive species with equal prejudice.

When disaster befalls the natural world, a different kind of undead may rise, entirely unlike risen humanoids. Most plants, fish, insects, and other animals don't possess a psychology complex enough to experience the emotional catharsis required to return as undead without intervention from an outside force. Mass extinction can serve as that outside force.

Humanoids clear-cutting an entire forest or a seaside community wiping out a species critical to their ecosystem can spawn a verdorite. The collective spiritual energy and emotional distress of a dying biome powers these undead, formed as conglomerates or representatives.

Phantom Boar.name: 魅影野猪 Phantom Boar

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影并非活物，但它们也不是不死生物，而且会对死亡效果表现出独特的脆弱性。

如果魅影因死亡效果而使生命值降至0（例如来自类似 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} 的法术），它会立刻被送往灵魂之河，在那里，它们的灵魂会继续踏上通往来世的寻常道路。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Vulnerable to Kindness.name: 友善易伤 Vulnerable to Kindness
Vulnerable to Kindness.description:
30尺内任何魅影能够看见并听见的生物，都可以用一个具有听觉、专注、语言和心灵（特征）的双动作行动，向它发出镇静且友善的问候。以这种方式向魅影问候的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] 检定。

大成功 魅影受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

成功 魅影受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害。

失败 魅影受到 @Damage[1d8[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 魅影不受影响，且在1轮内不会再受到此弱点影响。

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the auditory, concentrate, linguistic, and mental traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] check.

Critical Success The phantom takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The phantom takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

Failure The phantom takes @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.

Boar Charge.name: 凶猪冲锋 Boar Charge
Boar Charge.description:
魅影野猪进行两次魅影野猪行走，然后用獠牙进行一次打击。只要它至少移动了20尺，它的攻击掷骰便获得+2环境加值。

The phantom boar Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影行走于灵界位面与物质宇宙之间那道纤细的界线上，以便同时存在于这两个位面之中。

它们可以再次使用中此能力，转回仅存在于灵界位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal Plane and the Universe in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Phantom Boar.publicNotes:
大多数神学家认为，灵魂通往来世的普通轨迹相当直接。当一名凡人死去时，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。经审判的灵魂会前往适合自己的最终安息领域——天堂、地狱、荒原等等——并在那里成为祈求者。

然而，当一个排队等待审判的灵魂过早离开灵魂之河，并被转入灵界位面时，复杂情况就出现了。无论是由于夜鬼婆这类邪恶闯入者、恶性的位面魔法，还是甚至命运所致，这些灵魂都会脱离生与死的自然秩序，滞留在某种炼狱般的状态中。与祈求者不同，这些灵界魅影保留着死前生活的记忆；而与幽灵这类精魂不同，魅影并未沾染亡灵那种污秽的影响——至少一开始还没有，尽管腐化的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈从于那样的命运，另一些则终将重新汇入灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游移的灵魂自成一类——一种没有真正家园、目标或意义的存在。

许多魅影都不愿停留在这种奇异的炼狱状态中，要么是因为他们想继续自己穿越灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为他们害怕亡灵腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环并接受审判，从而继续前往来世，魅影只需找到回到灵魂之河的方法即可。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——以太位面的朦胧浓雾足以让最有经验的旅者也迷失方向，而无数掠食者在这片领域中游荡，搜索那些离散的灵魂，以便将其束缚或吞噬。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

Familiar Shadow.name: 魔宠之影 Familiar Shadow
Familiar Shadow.publicNotes:
被称为阴影的神秘亡灵潜伏在黑暗之处，并吸血那些离光太远的目标。

The mysterious undead known as shadows lurk in dark places and feed on those who stray too far from the light.

Light Vulnerability.name: 光弱点 Light Vulnerability
Light Vulnerability.description:
如果攻击暗影的生物处于魔法光亮中，或者用于进行该攻击的物体处于魔法光亮中（例如来自@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{光亮术}法术），则这些攻击视为魔法。

Attacks against the shadow are treated as magical if made by a creature who is in magical light or with an object that is in magical light (such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} spell).

Infest Shadow.name: 侵染暗影 Infest Shadow
Infest Shadow.description:
需求 魔宠之影与其所复制形象的玩家角色相邻，该玩家角色不处于黑暗中，也不是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，且魔宠之影察觉到该玩家角色

效果 魔宠之影试图侵染其所拥有外观的玩家角色之影子。魔宠之影贴着该玩家角色的影子扭曲蠕动，随后又缩回，而成为目标的玩家角色必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 豁免，结果如下。

大成功或大失败 该玩家角色不受影响，并免疫于后续的侵染暗影尝试。

成功 该玩家角色不受影响。

失败 魔宠之影将其亵渎影响遗留在该玩家角色的影子中，使其受到侵染。该玩家角色的影子会自行扭动和扭曲，仿佛故意无视其所依附角色的动作。被侵染的影子习惯做出分散注意力且令人尴尬的动作，并使其所依附的玩家角色在欺瞒、交涉和隐秘检定上承受 –2 状态减值。若该玩家角色处于不会投下影子的情境中（例如身处完全黑暗中，或处于隐形状态），这些减值会被压制，但一旦其受侵染的影子再次出现，这些减值就会恢复。若拥有受侵染影子的玩家角色获得濒死（状态），该影子会挣脱并变成一只暗影孳生体（其运作方式与由普通暗影创造出的暗影孳生体相同）。这只暗影孳生体不会攻击它所诞生自的生物，但其他目标都可能成为猎物。若该濒死角色恢复，其暗影孳生体会立刻死亡，而其影子恢复正常——否则，摆脱这诡异诅咒的唯一方式，就是使用如净化苦难之类的法术，因为它的持续时间为无限。

大成功或大失败 如同失败，但这些减值适用于该玩家角色进行的所有检定。

Requirements The familiar shadow is adjacent to the PC whose image it duplicates, that PC is not in darkness or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, and the familiar shadow is aware of the PC

Effect The familiar shadow attempts to infest the shadow of the PC whose appearance it has. The familiar shadow twists and writhes against the PC's shadow before pulling back, and the targeted PC must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save with the following results.

Critical Success The PC is unaffected and is immune to further attempts to Infest Shadow.

Success The PC is unaffected.

Failure The familiar shadow leaves its unholy influence behind in the PC's shadow, infesting it. The PC's shadow writhes and twists on its own, as if willfully ignoring the actions of the character to whom it's attached. The infested shadow has a habit of making distracting and embarrassing motions and imparts a –2 status penalty to its attached PC's Deception, Diplomacy, and Stealth checks. If the PC is in a situation where they aren't casting a shadow (such as when they're in complete darkness or are invisible), these penalties are suppressed, but they return as soon as their infested shadow does. If a PC with an infested shadow gains the dying condition, the shadow breaks free and becomes a shadow spawn (which functions the same as a shadow spawn created by a typical shadow). This shadow spawn won't attack the creature it spawned from, but any other targets are fair game. If the dying character recovers, their shadow spawn immediately dies, and their shadow returns to normal—otherwise, the only way to be rid of this strange curse is through the use of a spell like cleanse affliction, as it has an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalties apply to all checks made by the PC.

Shadow Spawn.name: 暗影孳生体 Shadow Spawn
Shadow Spawn.description:
当一个生物的影子被{@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{窃影}}拉离时，它会变成一个受创造它的暗影所命令的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{暗影孳生体}。这个暗影孳生体不具有窃影，并且会永久且无法治愈地处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}状态。如果这个暗影孳生体所源自的生物死亡，该暗影孳生体就会变成一个完整且自主的暗影。如果该生物从它的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱}中恢复，它的影子就会回到它身上，而该暗影孳生体会被熄灭。

When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} under the command of the shadow that created it. This shadow spawn doesn't have Steal Shadow and is perpetually and incurably @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeeblement}, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.

Slink in Shadows.name: 潜于影 Slink in Shadows
Slink in Shadows.description:
暗影可以在一个生物或物体的阴影中@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}，或结束其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}。

The shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or end its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in a creature's or object's shadow.

Steal Shadow.name: 窃影 Steal Shadow
Steal Shadow.description:
需求 该魔宠暗影在其上一个动作中，以影手打击命中了它正在复制的一名活物

效果 该魔宠暗影拉扯目标的暗影，使该生物陷入力竭1。这会与其他来自暗影的力竭状态累积，最高可达 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}。如果这使某个生物的力竭值提高至3或更高，则该目标的暗影会与其躯体分离（见暗影孳生体）。窃影造成的力竭值每小时减少1。

Requirements The famliar shadow hit a living creature it is duplicating with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action

Effect The famliar shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body (see shadow spawn). The enfeebled value from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.

Unholy Hunger.name: 邪秽饥渴 Unholy Hunger
Unholy Hunger.disable:
@Check[cooking-lore|dc:19] 以通过从附近搁板上加入少量精挑细选的香料来中和这锅作祟的汤，或 @Check[religion|dc:25] 来驱除该作祟

@Check[cooking-lore|dc:19] to neutralize the haunted soup with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or @Check[religion|dc:25] to exorcise the haunt
Unholy Hunger.hazarddescription:
一股难以言喻、恶臭扑鼻的瘴气从汤中翻涌而出，尖啸的人脸在蒸汽泡中几乎可见。

An unspeakable miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.

Worse Than It Smells.name: 比闻起来更糟 Worse Than It Smells
Worse Than It Smells.description:
触发 一个非宁多鲁生物掀开烹饪锅的锅盖

效果 锅15尺内的所有生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。触发该效果的生物则必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 豁免，以抗拒将脸埋进炖煮物中并吞下一大口的强迫（此效果具有情绪和心灵（特征）特征）。若失败，触发该效果的生物受到 @Damage[5d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] 豁免）。

Trigger A non-nindoru creature takes the lid off the cooking pot

Effect All creatures within 15 feet of the pot must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. The triggering creature instead must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to resist the compulsion to dip their face into the stew and swallow a mouthful of the stuff (this effect has the emotion and mental traits). On a failure, the triggering creature takes @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Unholy Hunger.reset:
当锅盖重新盖回烹饪锅上后，该作祟会在1轮后重置。

The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.

Meokdan.name: 莫啖魔 Meokdan
Meokdan.publicNotes:
作为他们种族的根本，莫啖魔忍受着长久且痛苦的饥饿，因为他们缺乏更强大的灵堕魔那从转世的灵魂中汲取营养的能力。这份饥饿驱使着莫啖魔不断寻找食物，并经常迫使他们吃几乎没有（如果称得上有的话）营养价值的泥土，石头和垃圾。不管他们吃下多少，莫啖魔总是身材消瘦。而无论他们有多饥饿，他们永远也不会饿死。

莫啖魔瘦弱的身形看起来貌似人类，有着浓密卷曲的头发，直接从面部和头部其余部分长出。他们的手臂看起来像是断了，不自然地长，有着一样长的手指，嵌着粗糙的指甲。他们的皮肤上布满了小疮口。

莫啖魔是食物循环的缩影，从生物的吃到最终被吃，无论是被捕食者吃下，还是他们的遗骸所诞生的环境。

当一个邪恶的灵魂在多次转世中对灵魂轮回感到痛苦并被腐化，它便经历可怖的转变，成为名为灵堕魔的魔族。作为熵的力量和对轮回的破坏，灵堕魔是一种可怕的生物，其身躯往往显得扭曲，其持用的武器已经破碎但仍能发挥效用，其真实的面容往往被隐藏起来。他们会展现出人们往往会在不死生物身上看到的特征，比如腐烂的肉体或暴露的骨骼，但灵堕魔依然活得尚好。

每个灵堕魔斗士某种循环破碎的缩影，它可能来自自然世界又或是来自社会传统。对于灵堕魔来说，没有什么比吞下转世多次的生物更为美味的了，而那些理论上将要抵达真正开悟的存在则是最为美味的大餐。那些被灵堕魔杀死的人将从轮回中被撕扯出——幸运者会前往骨园接受审判，但许多人则会被腐化成为这些可怕魔族的一员。

善解信徒认为灵堕魔尤其令人厌恶，将他们视作所能想象的最大威胁。大多数出现在转世轮回最为强烈地区的灵堕魔，如罗刹（rakshasas）和恶鬼（oni）一般，与物质位面联系得最为紧密。

转世的灵魂 Reincarnated Souls

某些情况下，你会知道被灵堕魔攻击的灵魂是否拥有一个转世的灵魂。类似轮回者（samsarans）这样的族裔总是拥有转世的灵魂，而PC的背景故事甚至其背景通常也能表明其前世的存在。《肆季鬼志》所有PC都视作转世的灵魂，因为他们已经反复重度了几十年的生活。如果你要确定一个生物的灵魂是否为转世来判断灵堕魔的能力，尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:11]检定——如果成功，它拥有一个转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神 Nindoru Demigods

最强大的灵堕魔乃是半神，尽管其教会非常稀少。因为倾向于在死后转世，如苦迦菩提这样的灵堕魔半神更常被称作“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒 Nindoru Traitors

虽然大多数灵堕魔天性纯粹混乱邪恶，但传说极为稀少的灵堕魔会设法超脱自己的本性获得飞升，在死后转世成为神灵（kami）或其他仁慈精魂，并借此摆脱灵堕魔特征。当然，这些“叛徒”被其他灵堕魔认为是所能想象的最美味的大餐。

灵堕魔蝴蝶 Nindoru Butterflies

多种灵堕魔最奇怪的共有特征便是看上去跟随在他们周围，在他们身上筑巢，或是周期性从他们伤口中冒出的血红蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫是灵堕魔思维的物理具现，象征着他们曾经度过却又背离他们的无尽过往。灵堕魔蝴蝶不会存在太久，只会飞出源头几尺远，便逐渐消散成烟雾，很快就消失在空气中。

其他灵堕魔 Other Nindorus

这些页面所列的四种灵堕魔之外还存在许多其他种类的灵堕魔。其他灵堕魔还包括复制尸体的阿恪尸魔（哭泣灵堕魔），潜入社群的贾奇库魔（潜伏灵堕魔），玷污死者的死煞星魔（扭曲灵堕魔），强大而野蛮的阿吉泽魔（无头灵堕魔）。

Immune to Fatigued From the Effects of S.name: 免疫疲乏（来自饥饿或口渴效果）

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description: 被莫啖魔杀死的生物很难复活或唤起成不死生物。莫啖魔会自动反制复活或唤起任何被其杀死生物的尝试（反制调整[[/r 1d20+7 #Counteract]]{+7}，反制等级2）。如果杀害生物的莫啖魔本身被杀死，被其杀死的生物便能如常被复活或唤起成不死生物。

Manifest Bone Club.name: 具现骨制棍棒 Manifest Bone Club
Manifest Bone Club.description:
需求 莫啖魔没有携带骨制棍棒

效果 莫啖魔将手从喉咙伸进胃里，拔出一根人类股骨，可以作为骨制棍棒持用。在莫啖魔打击一个生物后，骨制棍棒会破碎，但其锋利的碎片仍然会大致保持相同的形状；破碎骨制棍棒的打击会造成挥砍和流血伤害。在莫啖魔用破碎骨制棍棒进行打击后，或则如果莫啖魔丢下了骨制棍棒，棍棒将被摧毁，而灵堕魔能够具现一把新的骨制棍棒。

Quick Snack.name: 快速啃食 Quick Snack
Quick Snack.description:
触发 莫啖魔用啃咬打击重击命中一个活着的生物

效果 莫啖魔对该生物使用啃食。

Snack.name: 啃食 Snack
Snack.description:
莫啖魔尝试对一个相邻生物进行一次啃咬打击，或咬住其携带的一件手持物品。如果该生物活着或该物体是食物，莫啖魔会开心地咯咯发笑，恢复@Damage[(1d8+8)[healing]]生命值。如果该生物是不死生物或构装体，或物体不可食用，莫啖魔会沮丧地尖叫，在攻击掷骰或豁免上获得+1状态加值直到其下回合结束。莫啖魔不能在1轮内再次使用啃食。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.d0aJSi7GI6AhBlAJ]

Nosois' Vengeance.name: 疫鸟的复仇 Nosois' Vengeance
Nosois' Vengeance.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:36]（在不触发该危害的情况下迅速摧毁卷轴），@Check[religion|dc:33]（就先前的冒犯向法拉斯玛和诺索伊道歉），或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（6环；反制 DC 29）。

@Check[thievery|dc:36] (to quickly destroy the scroll without triggering the hazard), @Check[religion|dc:33] (to apologize to Pharasma and the nosois for the previous insult), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th level; counteract DC 29).
Nosois' Vengeance.hazarddescription:
卷轴上的麻雀活了过来，用野口的声音（来自事件 11：诺索伊斯的早午餐中的一只疫鸟）对PC们说道：“就是他们！他们就是那些连茶都不会好好端上的亵渎者！把他们送去见女士！”

The sparrow on the scroll animates, speaking to the PCs in Noguchi's voice (one of the nosois from Event 11: Nosois' Brunch): "They're the ones! They're the blasphemers who can't even properly serve tea! Send them along to the Lady!"

Summon Vanths.name: 召唤范斯族 Summon Vanths
Summon Vanths.description:
触发 一名PC进入房间并被该危害察觉

效果 该陷阱召唤四个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.74TxKGaW7RPzTdbm]{万斯}，随后它们掷先攻，并会持续最多1分钟，之后法术结束，万斯消失。与大多数被召唤的生物不同，被召唤出的万斯每轮可以使用3个动作，并且可以使用反应动作。

Trigger One of the PCs enters the room and is noticed by the hazard

Effect The trap summons four @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.74TxKGaW7RPzTdbm]{Vanths}, who then roll initiative and remain for up to 1 minute before the spell ends and the vanths disappear. The summoned vanths can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

Shou Matsuki.name: 松木胜 Shou Matsuki
Shou Matsuki.blurb: 男性 人类 木匠

Cataracts.name: 白内障 Cataracts
Cataracts.description: 老松木视力衰退，所有基于视觉的察觉检定受到 -2 环境减值。

Wood-Grain Speaker.name: 木纹有语 Wood-Grain Speaker
Wood-Grain Speaker.description: 在检查木质物品、建筑物以及树木时，老松木的察觉检定获得 +2 环境加值。对于主要由木头制成的物品，他可以使用手艺技能来辨识魔法。该能力不受白内障影响。

You Know, They Say....name: 你知道的，人们说…… You Know, They Say...
You Know, They Say....description: 老松木可以用柳岸镇学识来代替奥法、医疗、神秘以及宗教技能来尝试进行回忆知识（Recall Knowledge）检定，但该检定会受到 -2 减值。他以此种方式回忆知识时，将视为拥有可疑知识（Dubious Knowledge）专长效果。

A Drink for Good Luck.name: 为好运，干杯 A Drink for Good Luck
A Drink for Good Luck.description:
频率 每季节一次

需求 老松木手里正握着一份饮品

效果 老松木为好运举杯，在喝下饮品前，他可以选择 30 呎范围内最多六个其它生物。他以及所有被选中的生物，若在其下个回合结束前成功干杯畅饮，则将会被注入好运。在当前季节结束前，他们将有一次机会，以一个自由动作重骰一次豁免检定，必须采用第二次的结果。

Respect Your Elders!.name: 尊重长辈！ Respect Your Elders!
Respect Your Elders!.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 老松木公开训斥 30 呎范围内他所能看见的一位角色，批评他们不仅对他或是柳岸镇的其他长者大不敬，更是违背了柳岸镇自古以来的传统。无论他的训斥是否真的讲道理，被训斥的目标都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响，并免疫“尊重你的长辈！”能力 1 周。

成功 生物感觉到了片刻的羞愧，其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 羞耻与自我怀疑的想法充斥着生物的内心，严重地干扰了他们，使他们陷入呆滞 1 状态，持续 1 小时。

Wait, Give Me a Moment....name: 且慢，吾尚需片刻…… Wait, Give Me a Moment...
Wait, Give Me a Moment....description:
触发 老松木在一次回忆知识检定中失败

频率 每日一次

效果 老松木意识到自己犯了错误，并以 +2 环境加值重骰触发该能力的检定。

Fiendish Reflection.name: 恶魔映像 Fiendish Reflection
Fiendish Reflection.hazarddescription:
这里水中的倒影看起来如同怪物与邪魔；一名玩家角色若在这些水中看见自己，映入眼帘的会是自己扭曲的映像，正回望着自己，露出讥诮与嘲弄的神情。

Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish; a PC who views themself in these waters sees a distorted version of themself looking back at them, sneering and mocking.
Fiendish Reflection.reset:
该作祟会在该轮结束时自动重置，准备好在下次有人凝视水中时再次触发。

The haunt resets at the end of the round automatically, ready to trigger again the next tome someone looks into the water.

Frightening Visage.name: 骇人幻象 Frightening Visage
Frightening Visage.description:
触发 一个生物看向水面

效果 该生物看到自己在水的表面上的倒影扭曲成一个邪魔版的自己；它必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:20] 意志豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}（若大失败，则只要它仍处于惊惧状态，就会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}）。

Trigger A creature looks at the water

Effect The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of itself; it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened on a critical failure).

Fiendish Reflection.disable:
@Check[宗教|dc:20]以驱邪此作祟，或 @Check[威吓|dc:23] 将恐惧反过来施加于作祟，并用它自身的怖惧将其蹂躏

@Check[religion|dc:20] to exorcise the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:23] to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it with its own terror

Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Occult).name: 无面鬼异能模仿者 Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Occult)

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description: 无面鬼模仿者携带一件+1强击武器，看上去与被模仿的PC最喜爱的武器完全相同。如果PC喜爱无武装打击，它会呈现为缠手带。如果PC喜爱远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上述的远程武器规则；除此之外，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果PC们没有喜爱的武器，无面鬼会持用一件棍棒作为它的虚假武器。虚假武器只是部分真实，在命中时只会造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损，被卸武，或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟的时间重塑来制造一件替代虚假武器。

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description: 无面鬼模仿者获得一套内在法术，对应被模仿的PC所使用的施法根源。你可以调整法术来让其更完美适合模仿。

Red-Hooded Thatchling.name: 红头草人 Red-Hooded Thatchling

Distracting Giggle.name: 分神讪笑 Distracting Giggle
Distracting Giggle.description: 15尺。草人的讪笑声在脑海中回荡。灵光内的生物在意志豁免上承受–1状态减值。

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description: 当草人被火焰以外伤害摧毁时，它尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:11]检定。如果成功，它将于[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 天}在被摧毁处重塑，被完全治愈。草人在被火焰伤害减至0生命值，或有障碍阻止灵魂获得新形体时，总是会被永久摧毁。

Create Thatchling Spawn.name: 创造草人衍体 Create Thatchling Spawn
Create Thatchling Spawn.description: 被红头草人杀死的在处于草人诅咒影响下有生命的类人生物，会在[[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}后复生为草人。该草人衍体处于杀死它的红头草人命令下。如果一个红头草人同时控制着太多草人（由GM判断），一些草人可以在自己回合开始时通过一次@Check[will|dc:18]豁免后解放自身。如果创造衍体的红头草人被摧毁，衍体草人将变为独立的草人。

Howl of Vengeful Fury.name: 复仇怒嚎 Howl of Vengeful Fury
Howl of Vengeful Fury.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 红头草人可怜地啜泣着，然后放出一道可怕的尖叫。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]范围内所有非草人生物受到@Damage[2d10[sonic]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic]豁免），并将免疫所有草人的分神讪笑1分钟。区域内的草人获得5点临时生命值，并在打击和豁免骰上获得+1状态加值，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.X1Q1uBiylZoJg3Co]

Thatchling's Curse.name: 草人诅咒 Thatchling's Curse
Thatchling's Curse.description:
草人将注意力集中于30尺内单个可见生物，然后开始喃喃低语起废话。目标尝试一次@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，且暂时免疫草人诅咒24小时。

成功 目标暂时迷失方向，难以向正确方向移动。目标在速度上承受–5尺减值1轮。

失败 同成功，但速度减值持续1分钟。

大失败 同失败，但速度减值持续到诅咒被移除，或直到创造该效果的草人被永久摧毁，以先触发为准。此外，当被诅咒的生物尝试生存检定来辨别方向或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]时，其使用比检定结果低一级的成功度，其不能采用侦察探索期行动。

Thicket Walker.name: 灌木行者 Thicket Walker
Thicket Walker.description: 草人忽略由荆棘，倒塌的建筑，废墟，缠绕的草丛和灌木形成的困难地形。

Red-Hooded Thatchling.publicNotes:
当一个注定变成草人的灵魂在极大的痛苦中死去时，其会在死后化作红头草人。这些渴望复仇的草人在远处看上去就带戴着红兜帽，但靠近观察，一个可怕事实——他们的头上满是鲜血——展露无疑。不像其他草人，红头草人擅长欺骗，他们可以通过幻术魔法来装成活人，使得他们将无心者引入伏击中要容易得多。

在神门乡村，一些善解（Sangpotshi）分支会警告，如果一个注定要转世的灵魂被阻止进入灵魂之河重新加入轮回的话会发生什么。这些灵魂会变得沮丧，困惑，然后是对他们并非处于应得的身体中而感到愤怒，反过来，他们又强迫植物化作他们的新身体。其他理论则称当一具尸体被埋在浅墓中，草根就会向下碰到遗骸，缠绕上灵魂然后抓住它草人具有智力且能够说话，但很少这么做——他们通常对那些拥有自己所渴望生命的人没什么好说的。罕有的情况下，单个草人会通过向某人寻求帮助，尝试引诱某人进入高草丛或灌木茂盛的区域，但他们并不擅长欺骗，所以这种策略并没有让他们看上去像是真正需要帮助的活物。

Temporal Warp.name: 时间扭曲 Temporal Warp
Temporal Warp.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:27] 使该危害隐纹消退，并使所有受其影响者脱离该危害的效果，或 @Check[intimidation|dc:30] 以电击使一个邻近生物摆脱该扭曲，并使其脱离该危害的效果。

@Check[occultism|dc:27] to cause the hazard to fade away and release all those affected by it from the hazard's effects, or @Check[intimidation|dc:30] to shock a single adjacent creature out of the distortion and free them from the hazard's effects.
Temporal Warp.hazarddescription:
就在战斗开始之际，该区域内的时间仿佛突然破碎，导致某些事物凝滞在原地，而其他事物则缓慢或提速，给在场者带来一种支离破碎、如噩梦般的感受。

Just as a fight begins, time suddenly seems to break in the area, causing some elements to freeze in place and others to slow down or speed up, imparting a disjointed and nightmarish sensation upon those present.

Reaction.name: 反应动作（） Reaction
Reaction.description:
触发 在一场战斗开始掷先攻时，PC们面对的是一种他们以前曾战斗过的敌人类型

效果 随着战斗开始，一切突然都变得扭曲而如梦似幻。就像在梦中一样，连时间本身似乎也会以改变一切的方式拉长或压缩，将所有事物化为噩梦。战斗中第一个行动的生物周围 @Template[burst|distance:30] 内的所有生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免骰，因为在短暂的一瞬间，时间仿佛静止了。

大成功 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷} 1，持续1分钟；它每轮只能将这个额外动作用于具有移动（特征）的动作。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}，因为它感知到对自己而言时间已完全停止。当它从昏眩中恢复时，它会获得减速1，持续1分钟。

注：派佐未为此能力提供难度等级。此处所用的难度等级是根据《游戏掌控指南》中的危害构筑表，为该危害等级采用的困难难度等级。

Trigger Initiative is rolled at the start of a combat where the PCs face a type of foe they have fought before

Effect As the combat begins, everything suddenly feels distorted and dreamlike. Just as in dreams, time itself seems to stretch or compress in ways that transform everything into a nightmare. All creatures within a @Template[burst|distance:30] from the first creature to act in combat must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] saving throw as, for a brief moment, time appears to stand still.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 1 for 1 minute; it can only use the extra action each round for actions with the move trait.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} as it perceives time to have stopped entirely for it. When it recovers from the stun, it is slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The DC present here is a hard DC for the hazard level according to the Gamemastery Guide hazard building Tables.

Kugaptee's Blessing.name: 苦迦菩提的祝福 Kugaptee's Blessing
Kugaptee's Blessing.publicNotes:
死灵强化赋予了这只丧尸增大体型和更强的力量。

丧尸唯一的欲望就是吃喝活人。它们是毫无思想、永不停歇地蹒跚前行的死亡邪魔先驱，只有在被摧毁时才会停下。

Necromantic augmentations have granted this zombie increased size and power.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
丧尸永久处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，且不能使用反应动作。

A zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Improved Push 5 feet.name: 强化推离 5 尺 Improved Push 5 feet
