即便如神灵（kami）这种不朽者也无法避免死亡。当一个神灵或同等强大的实体拒绝骨园的呼唤时，死神就会被召唤来让这些顽固的灵魂屈服。精确而迅速，死神以高效又无情地进行死亡判决而闻名。

轮回卫士 Guardians Of The Cycle

死神负责调查和处理普遍存在阻碍自然生命流动的显像。他们可能会复制解决问题，或被告知等待，观察，然后提供最小援助。虽然大部分死神都能够在长久的值守中保持公正，而一些则超越了无情，最终摇摆向了仁慈或残忍。
Shinigami.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1状态加值

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1状态加值

Change Shape.name: 变身 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
死神变成某个特定小型或中型类人生物的外貌。这不会改变其数据，除了会减少打击中的触及范围至10尺。死神的人类外形是死神独有的，不能用于乔装成某个生物。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Pouch of Four Gems.name: 四玉袋 Pouch of Four Gems
Pouch of Four Gems.description: 每个死神都携带有装着四枚黑色蓝宝石的袋子，用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]。每颗玉珠都能够容纳最大等级等同于死神等级的灵魂，宝玉也可以被摧毁，它们中容纳的灵魂将被无害地放出前往骨园。

Release Soul.name: 释放灵魂 Release Soul
Release Soul.description:
需求 死神袋子中的黑宝石容纳着由缚魂术困住的灵魂

效果 死神打碎他手里的宝石，将灵魂送入骨园，并伴随着一道强大的能量。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]范围内所有生物受到@Damage[18d6[untyped]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:drained,inflicts:sickened]豁免）；死神选择此伤害为命能伤害还是虚能伤害。因该效果受到伤害且豁免骰失败的生物，还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 4}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}）。

Spirit Touch.name: 精魂接触 Spirit Touch
Spirit Touch.description: 死神的打击可以如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥 Ghost Touch}性能符文效果一样影响到虚体生物。

Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Divine).name: 无面鬼神术模仿者 Noppera-Bo Impersonator (Divine)

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description: 无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉是精确感官。他们没有呼吸，免疫需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得营养——通常会将手或没有脸的头浸入液体中通过渗透来“喝”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中受益，例如药水或灵药。

Sensitive Hearing.description: 只要无面鬼陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，他还将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。
Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description: 无面鬼模仿者携带一件+1强击武器，看上去与被模仿的PC最喜爱的武器完全相同。如果PC喜爱无武装打击，它会呈现为缠手带。如果PC喜爱远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上述的远程武器规则；除此之外，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果PC们没有喜爱的武器，无面鬼会持用一件棍棒作为它的虚假武器。虚假武器只是部分真实，在命中时只会造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损，被卸武，或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟的时间重塑来制造一件替代虚假武器。

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description: 无面鬼模仿者获得一套内在法术，对应被模仿的PC所使用的施法根源。你可以调整法术来让其更完美适合模仿。

Hong Meigui.publicNotes:
僵尸是来自天夏、以跳跃移动的可怖吸血鬼。尽管它们与其他吸血鬼相似——它们是不死生物，会从活物身上吸取生命能量，且只能以特定方式被消灭——但僵尸享用的并非血液，而是活物的气息，也称为气或炁。它们拥有独特的力量，包括能偏转魔法的符箓、惊人的跳跃能力，以及对阳光的免疫；同时，僵尸也有独特的弱点，例如除了通过呼吸感知之外无法看见活物、对铃铛与镜子的厌恶，以及几乎令人神志昏沉的忧郁。值得庆幸的是，大多数僵尸都无法制造吸血鬼子嗣。

地方僵尸从噩梦般的沉眠中被粗暴唤醒后，便在其领地周边的村庄与墓地间游荡，搜寻维持自身所需的养分，以缓解它的饥饿。

Jiang-shi are terrifying hopping vampires from Tian Xia. Though similar to other vampires—they are undead, drain vital energy from the living, and can be slain only in specific ways—jiang-shi feast upon the breath of the living, also known as qi or ki, instead of blood. While they possess unique powers, including their magic-deflecting paper fulus, extraordinary jumping ability, and immunity to sunlight, jiang-shi also possess unique vulnerabilities, such as the inability to see living creatures save through breathsense, a revulsion to bells and mirrors, and near-stupefying melancholia. Thankfully, most jiang-shi can't create vampiric spawn.

Roused rudely from their nightmarish slumber, the provincial jiang-shi roams the villages and graveyards around their domain searching for sustenance to slake their hunger.

Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.description:
洪玫瑰无法感知5尺外的活物，除非通过呼吸感应；一个屏住呼吸的活物在其屏息期间对她而言是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。

Hong Meigui can't perceive living creatures beyond 5 feet except with breathsense; a living creature that holds its breath is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to her as long as it holds its breath.
Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.name: 吐息感知（精确）60尺 Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet

Warped Fulu.description:
贴在洪玫瑰额头上的腐化符箓使她免疫由魔法物品施放且不消耗法术位的法术，例如卷轴或魔杖施放的法术。生物可以通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{偷窃} 扭曲符箓，对抗她的察觉DC 30。这样会结束她对这些效果的免疫。若随后有生物以一个交互动作用破坏该扭曲符箓，洪玫瑰也会失去她的快速治疗。她可以花费1个不受打扰的小时，用书写工具在纸条上描绘，制作一张替代的扭曲符箓。

The corrupted fulu attached to Hong Meigui's brow makes her immune to spells cast from a magic item without expending a spell slot, such as from a scroll or wand. A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} the warped fulu, rolling against her Perception DC of 30. This ends her immunity to these effects. If a creature then destroys the warped fulu with an Interact action, Hong Meigui also loses her fast healing. She can create a replacement warped fulu by spending 1 uninterrupted hour inscribing a strip of paper with a writing instrument.
Warped Fulu.name: 扭曲符箓 Warped Fulu

Drain Qi.description:
需求 洪玫瑰触及内有一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，或自愿的生物

效果 洪玫瑰通过呼吸吸取受害者的生命能量。如果受害者处于被擒抱状态，则这需要进行一次对抗受害者强韧难度等级的运动检定；若受害者处于其他任一状态，则自动生效。受害者陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态） 1}，且洪玫瑰恢复12 HP，任何超出的部分转为临时HP。从一个已经处于流失（状态）的生物身上吸取真气不会恢复任何HP，但会使受害者的流失（状态）值增加1；如果其达到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态） 5}，则会死亡。如果受害者具有施放真气法术的能力，则可以花费1聚能点，以避免因当前攻击而陷入流失（状态）。

该流失（状态）值每周减少1。每天一次，如果受害者当天将饮食限制为糯米，并通过成功进行一次@Check[athletics|dc:25]检定来花费10分钟进行剧烈身体行动，则其流失（状态）减少1。

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within Hong Meigui's reach

Effect Hong Meigui drains the victim's life energy through their breath. This requires an Athletics check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and Hong Meigui regains 12 HP, gaining any excess as temporary HP. Draining qi from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP but increases the victim's drained condition value by 1, killing them if they reach @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}. If the victim has the ability to cast qi spells, they can spend 1 Focus Point to avoid becoming drained by the current attack.

This drained condition value decreases by 1 every week. Once per day, if the victim restricts their diet to glutinous rice for the day and spends 10 minutes engaging in vigorous physical activity by succeeding at a @Check[athletics|dc:25] check, they reduce their drained condition by 1.
Drain Qi.name: 汲取气 Drain Qi

Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.name: 僵尸弱点 Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities
Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.description:
所有僵尸都具有以下弱点。

  • 厌恶 僵尸无法自愿进入距离被挥舞的镜子或摇响的手铃10尺以内的范围。生物可以用一个交互动作使用镜子或手铃，在1轮内挥舞或摇响该物品（类似于在举起盾牌）。如果僵尸非自愿地进入其厌恶之物10尺以内，它会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态，并远离其厌恶之物，直到距离该物体10尺或更远。暴露在其厌恶之物前1轮后，僵尸可以用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。若成功，它会克服其厌恶[[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6轮}（若大成功，则为1小时）。
  • 苦涩顿悟 当僵尸被提醒其堕落本质，以及它与生者之间存在性断裂这一事实时，会陷入严重的忧郁。当地僵尸看见一座供奉着至少1负载祖先精魂食物祭品的祭坛时，它必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。随后，它会在1分钟内暂时免疫苦涩顿悟。

大成功 僵尸不受影响。

成功 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。

失败 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 僵尸陷入呆滞 2，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，持续1分钟。

All jiang-shi possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Revulsion A jiang-shi can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or the sound of ringing handbells. A creature can Interact with a mirror or handbell to brandish or ring the item for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the jiang-shi involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they are 10 feet or farther from the object. After 1 round of being exposed to the object of their revulsion, a jiang-shi can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Bitter Epiphany A jiang-shi is afflicted by severe melancholia when reminded of their debased nature and the truth of their existential disconnection from living beings. When a jiang-shi sees an altar with at least 1 Bulk of food offerings to ancestor spirits, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save. They are then temporarily immune to Bitter Epiphany for 1 minute.

Critical Success The jiang-shi is unaffected.

Success The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The jiang-shi is stupefied 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute.

One More Breath.name: 再喘一口气 One More Breath
One More Breath.description:
洪玫瑰在 0 生命值时不会被摧毁；相反，她会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并在 1 分钟后以 1 生命值唤醒。趁她以这种方式失去意识时，在她身上撒下至少 1 负载的糯米或母鸡蛋，就能将她永久摧毁；任何由暮木或桃木制成的武器所造成的攻击也同样如此。

Hong Meigui isn't destroyed at 0 HP; instead, she falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and awakens in 1 minute with 1 Hit Point. Scattering at least 1 Bulk of glutinous rice or hen eggs on her while she's unconscious in this way destroys her permanently, as will any attack from a weapon made of duskwood or peachwood.

Rigor Mortis.name: 尸僵 Rigor Mortis
Rigor Mortis.description:
洪玫瑰的跳跃式移动使她能够无视困难地形，以及会使她陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}的效果。她不能使用伏倒动作，而且当她跳跃时，不会触发通常由移动所触发的反应动作。

Hong Meigui's hopping movement lets her ignore difficult terrain and effects that would render her @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. She can't take the Drop Prone action, and when she Leaps, she doesn't trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.

Hong Meigui.name: 洪玫瑰 Hong Meigui
Hong Meigui.hp: fast healing 10, one more breath, void healing
Hong Meigui.blurb:
女性僵尸吸血鬼
Female jiang-shi vampire

Universal Language.name: 通识语言 Universal Language
Universal Language.description:
听者会将脑生子所说的任何话语感知为其母语。

Anything spoken by the brainchild is perceived by the listener in its native language.

Urban Legend.description:
脑生子仅由先于其而来的名声所维持。无心智生物免疫脑生子，且无法感知到它们。

脑生子的体型、特性和物品，以及其攻击的外观，都与感知它的敌人所预期的一致。如果敌人预期看到不同的事物，则由脑生子选择显现哪一种。如果任何能够感知脑生子的生物相信脑生子拥有以下某项能力之一，则脑生子就拥有该能力。

生物可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{察言观色}（对抗脑生子的欺瞒 DC）来尝试识破某一项单独的能力。如果在任何时候，没有任何感知脑生子的生物相信该能力存在，脑生子便会立即失去该能力。如果敌人预期的细节不同，例如一个认为脑生子免疫火焰，另一个认为它免疫预言系，则脑生子选择其中一项拥有。

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{震颤感知}（模糊）100尺
  • 免疫 一种伤害类型、魔法学派或状态
  • 弱点 15，针对一种非心灵伤害类型
  • 抗力 15，对物理伤害，冷铁或白银除外
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{恐怖威压}（灵光、情绪、恐惧、心灵）100尺，直到其逃脱
  • 打击 额外造成1d6点挥砍伤害
  • 额外法术 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{魅影灾祸}

A brainchild is sustained only by the reputation that precedes them. Mindless creatures are immune to a brainchild and can't perceive them.

The brainchild's size, features, and items, as well as the appearance of their attacks, match what the foes perceiving them expect. If foes expect to see different things, the brainchild chooses which to manifest. If any creature that can perceive the brainchild believes the brainchild has one of the abilities below, the brainchild has that ability.

A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} (against the brainchild's Deception DC) to attempt to disbelieve an individual ability. If at any point no creature perceiving the brainchild believes in the ability, the brainchild loses that ability immediately. If foes expect different particulars, such as one believing the brainchild is immune to fire and another believing they're immune to divinations, the brainchild chooses one to have.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{Tremorsense} (imprecise) 100 feet
  • Immunity to one damage type, magic school, or condition
  • Weakness 15 to one damage type other than mental
  • Resistance 15 to physical damage, with an exception for either cold iron or silver
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence} (aura, emotion, fear, mental) 100 feet, DC 28
  • 1d6 Extra Slashing Damage on Strikes
  • Additional Spells @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{Phantasmal Calamity}
Urban Legend.name: 都市传说 Urban Legend

Fear of Flutes.name: 恐惧长笛 Fear of Flutes
Fear of Flutes.description:
每个轮中第一次有人在和善保30尺内吹奏长笛时，他必须尝试对抗吹笛者表演难度等级的 @Check[will] 意志豁免。如果吹笛者是（由游戏主持酌情决定）宗教信仰特别虔诚的人，这个难度等级增加4。

大成功 和善保不受影响。

成功 和善保变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 和善保变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 和善保变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，直到他下个回合结束。

The first time in any round when someone plays a flute within 30 feet of Heh Shan-Bao, he must attempt a @Check[will] save against the flute player's Performance DC. This DC increases by 4 if the flute player is someone (at the GM's discretion) who's strongly religious.

Critical Success Heh Shan-Bao is unaffected.

Success Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of his next turn.

Persistence of Memory.name: 记忆存留 Persistence of Memory
Persistence of Memory.description:
当一个脑生子被摧毁时，只要仍有任何人完全相信它存在，它就会回归，并在任意一名信徒100尺内于[[/br 2d4 #Persistance of Memory]]{2d4天}后重新成形。

When a brainchild is destroyed, it returns if anyone still fully believes it exists, re-forming within 100 feet of any believer after [[/br 2d4 #Persistance of Memory]]{2d4 days}.

Steal Soul.name: 窃魂 Steal Soul
Steal Soul.description:
触发 和善保施放魅影灾祸、灵魂冲击或死亡幻景

效果 如果触发的法术杀死一个10级或以下的生物，目标的双眼会消失，所有脂肪会从其躯体中流失，手腕周围会显现出烧灼的烙印，同时目标的灵魂被虹吸进腐化的柳岸镇心景。在第4幕结束、腐化的柳岸镇心景被摧毁之前，目标无法通过任何手段重获生命，即使是像祈愿术仪式这样的强大魔法也不行。

Trigger Heh Shan-Bao casts phantasmal calamity, spirit blast, or vision of death

Effect If the triggering spell kills a 10th-level or lower creature, the target's eyes vanish, all fat drains from its body, and burnt brands manifest around the wrists as the target's soul is siphoned into the corrupted Willowshore mindscape. The target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic like the wish ritual, until the corrupted Willowshore mindscape is destroyed at the end of Act 4.

Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13).name: 和善保（13级） Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13)
Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13).blurb:
男性脑生子变体
Male variant brainchild
Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13).publicNotes:
一个谣言可能会变得如此鲜活而持久，以至于获得生命，创造出一个脑生子——一种活生生的幻象，由对一个冷酷无情、不可阻挡的杀手的强烈信念孵化而出。这类谣言通常源自曾遭受 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]{Vision of Death} 法术影响的受害者。脑生子在追逐信徒时能力会增强，但面对怀疑者时则会萎缩，因此它们究竟有多危险，只取决于人们多么相信它们。驱使脑生子的，是偷偷接近、恐吓与杀戮的单纯冲动，但这种生物也可能表现出其他那些经由闲言碎语而被归于它们的行为。

A rumor can become so vivid and persistent that it comes to life, creating a brainchild—a living illusion that hatches from an intense belief in a remorseless and implacable killer. Often, these rumors are borne from victims of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]{Vision of Death} spell. A brainchild's capabilities grow when they pursue a believer but deflate against skeptics, making them only as dangerous as one believes them to be. A simple drive to stalk, terrify, and kill propels a brainchild, but the creature might also exhibit other behaviors ascribed to them through gossip.

Algriever.name: 灵蜘蛛 Algriever

Acolyte's Defense.name: 助祭防御 Acolyte's Defense
Acolyte's Defense.description:
触发 灵蜘蛛视线内的一个生物对其缔结的神龛造成伤害、亵渎或污损

需求 灵蜘蛛与一个神龛缔结了联系

效果 灵蜘蛛朝该生物进行魅影野猪行走；此次移动不会触发反应动作（）。灵蜘蛛将该生物标记为其敌人，并在其以助祭防御选择新的敌人之前，对该敌人的攻击掷骰获得 +2 状态加值。

Trigger A creature within sight of the algriever damages, desecrates, or defiles their bonded shrine

Requirements The algriever is bonded with a shrine

Effect The algriever Strides toward the creature; this movement doesn't trigger reactions. The algriever marks the creature as their enemy and gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls against that enemy until they select a new enemy with Acolyte's Defense.

Shrine Bond.name: 神龛联结 Shrine Bond
Shrine Bond.description:
灵蜘蛛在该地点停留24小时后，会与一处神龛建立羁绊。处于羁绊状态时，灵蜘蛛的察觉检定和技能检定获得+2环境加值。

The algriever bonds with a shrine after they spend 24 hours at the site. While bonded, the algriever gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and skill checks.

Algriever Venom.name: 灵蜘蛛毒 Algriever Venom
Algriever Venom.description:
豁免骰 @Check[will|dc:28]

Maximum 持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[mental]] 伤害

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[mental]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}

阶段 3 @Damage[2d6[mental]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:28]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}

Pilgrim's Ward.name: 朝圣御守 Pilgrim's Ward
Pilgrim's Ward.description:
频率 每月一次

效果 灵蜘蛛触碰一名自愿的生物，使其心中充满对其所缔结神龛的崇敬。只要目标生物遵守灵蜘蛛所缔结神龛的典范与禁忌，或直到该灵蜘蛛将朝圣御守授予另一名生物为止，该生物在所有宗教检定和意志豁免上获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.zy4PDhXnaZh6e6iT]{效果：朝圣御守}

Frequency once per month

Effect The algriever touches a willing creature and fills it with reverence for their bonded shrine. As long as the target creature obeys the edicts and anathemas of the algriever's bonded shrine, or until that algriever grants Pilgrim's Ward to a different creature, that creature gains a +1 status bonus to all Religion checks and Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.zy4PDhXnaZh6e6iT]{Effect: Pilgrim's Ward}

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被灵蜘蛛的蛛网打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并被卡在最近的表面上，直到它[[/act escape dc=28]]{除非目标成功逃脱}。

A creature hit by an algriever's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=28]]{Escapes}.

Algriever.publicNotes:
有些人误以为这些蜘蛛般的精魂是搜刮废弃神龛的拾荒者，但事实恰恰相反：它们是被遗忘礼拜场所的自封守护者，捍卫被弃信仰的神圣性，并照料那些无人看管的地点。有时，哀悼者承担的职责带着悲伤与哀恸，因为它们会哀悼那些曾前来它们所选圣祠的人们的逝去。另一些则满怀挫败与狂暴，将任何误入其圣祠的人视作至多是失落的信徒，至坏则是亵渎者——应受惩罚的罪人。

哀悼者对活物几乎没有兴趣，除非对方闯入它们的领地。一旦哀悼者的圣祠遭到侵入，它们便会封锁道路，直到闯入者表达敬意。好斗的哀悼者会从旅人那里偷取财物，或劫持人质，直到其索求的供品得到满足。当哀悼者怀疑某人犯下亵渎之举时，任何赋礼都无法平息它们对复仇的口渴。

反应惩罚

哀悼者遵循与其绑定的圣祠所对应神祇或信仰的典范与禁忌，尽管它们的阵营仍保持中立。无论圣祠有多大，哀悼者都会从圣祠中选定三件中型或更小的物体作为自己防御的焦点，并且可以对任何触碰或扰动这些物体的生物使用助祭防御。

Some mistake these spiderlike spirits as scavengers looking to loot abandoned shrines, but they're actually the opposite: self-appointed guardians of forgotten places of worship, defending the sanctity of discarded faiths and tending sites that have no caretakers. Sometimes, an algriever's duties are tinged with sadness and grief, as they mourn the loss of those who once attended their chosen shrine. Others are filled with frustration and rage, viewing any who stumble upon their shrine as lapsed faithful at best or blasphemers at worse—sinners who deserve punishment.

Algrievers have little interest in living creatures until they wander into their territory. Once an algriever's shrine has been breached, they block passage until the interlopers pay their respects. Aggressive algrievers steal from travelers or take hostages until their demands for an offering are satisfied. When algrievers suspect someone of committing blasphemy, no gifts can slake their thirst for vengeance.

Reactive Punishment

An algriever follows the edicts and anathemas of the deity or faith of the shrine to which they're bonded, although they remain neutral in alignment. Regardless of how large the shrine is, an algriever chooses three Medium or smaller objects in the shrine as their own focus for defense, and can use Acolyte's Defense against any creature that touches or disturbs those objects.

Witherweird Runes.name: 枯萎诡符文 Witherweird Runes
Witherweird Runes.hazarddescription:
储存在以骨粉与女妖之泪绘制的符文中的魔法，会鞭挞除和善保之外打开次级隔层的任何人。

Magic stored in runes painted in powdered bone and banshees' tears lash out at anyone other than Heh Shan-Bao who opens the secondary compartment.

Withering Wail.name: 枯萎哀嚎 Withering Wail
Withering Wail.description:
触发 除和善保以外的某人打开了次要隔层

效果 一张呼啸的幽魂面孔从箱子中显现并发出尖啸，导致C4区域内的所有生物尝试进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:33] 豁免；这声音也会惊动C3a和C6区域内的僵尸，它们会迅速前来调查声音来源。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[7d6[void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[15d6[void]] 伤害。此外，它们的血肉会枯萎并变得虚弱，使其看起来衰老而憔悴——该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到诅咒被移除。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[30d6[void]] 伤害，并如上方失败所述那样受到诅咒，但改为变成 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

Trigger Someone other than Heh Shan-Bao opens the secondary compartment

Effect A howling, spectral face manifests out of the chest and screeches, causing all within area C4 to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save; the sound also alerts the jiang-shi in areas C3 a and C6, who quickly come to investigate the sound.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[7d6[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[15d6[void]] damage. In addition, their flesh withers and weakens, leaving them to appear old and decrepit—the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the curse is removed.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[30d6[void]] damage and becomes cursed as failure above, but becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Witherweird Runes.disable:
[[/act disable-device dc=37]] 以搔挠掉这些符文并使其魔法无害地消散，@Check[arcana|dc:40] 以破坏该法术并使这些符文干涸后化作惰性粉末随风飘散，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第7环阶；反制 DC 31）以反制这些符文

[[/act disable-device dc=37]] to scratch out the runes and dissipate their magic harmlessly, @Check[arcana|dc:40] to sabotage the spell and cause the runes to dry up and blow away as inert powder, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the runes

Argyrzei.publicNotes:
大多数宁多鲁斯都会被白银所伤，但稽折魔不会。相反，阿耳癸耳宙斯会把白银当作传播疾病与痛苦的手段，并借此帮助他们操作那些在不知不觉间落入其染疫赋礼诅咒之人们的心智。他们乐于伪装自己，然后将染疫银卖给或送给受害者。其他灵堕魔尤其恐惧阿耳癸耳宙斯对银的精通，因为他们知道，阿耳癸耳宙斯能够用他们的银刃造成痛苦的伤口。

阿耳癸耳宙斯外表看起来像类人生物，但他们的脚是反着长的，而且没有头。他们发着红光的断颈里塞满了各式各样的小刀、刀刃和金属碎片。这些宁多鲁斯象征着艺术被创造、摧毁，并被回收再造成新艺术的循环。

Most nindorus are harmed by silver, but not the argyrzei. Instead, argyrzeis use silver as a method of spreading sickness and pain, and to help them manipulate the minds of those who unwittingly fall under the curse of their infected gifts. They delight in disguising themselves and then selling or giving infected silver to victims. Other nindorus particularly fear argyrzeis for their mastery over silver, knowing that they're capable of causing painful wounds with their silver blades.

Argyrzeis appear humanoid, but their feet point backwards and they have no heads. Their glowing red neck stumps are stuffed with a wide assortment of knives, blades, and shards of metal. These nindorus represent the cycle of art being created, destroyed, and recycled into new art.

Soul Shred.description:
被稽折魔杀死的生物很难重获生命，或被转化为亡灵。稽折魔会自动尝试反制任何将其所杀死的生物施加复活术或转化为亡灵的企图（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+23 #Counteract]]{+23}，反制等级第7级）。如果杀死该生物的稽折魔本身被杀死，那么该生物便可以正常地从死亡中归来或变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by an argyrzei are difficult to bring back to life or to animate as undead. The argyrzei automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+23 #Counteract]]{+23}, counteract level 7th). If the argyrzei who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.
Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred

Cursesense.name: 诅咒感知 Cursesense
Cursesense.description:
稽折魔可以通过它诅咒过的任何白银物品进行视听，只要该物品位于1英里以内。

The argyrzei can see and hear through any silver object it cursed, as long as the object is within 1 mile.

Headless.name: 无头 Headless
Headless.description:
稽折魔是无头的，但仍能像有头一样听、说、看和闻。稽折魔免疫斩首效果，例如由斩首武器造成的效果。

An argyrzei is headless but can still hear, speak, see, and smell as if it had a head. The argyrzei is immune to decapitation effects, such as those caused by vorpal weapons.

Infect Silver.name: 染银 Infect Silver
Infect Silver.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 稽折魔对一个相邻且不大于2负载的白银物体进行专注。该物体变为受诅咒；如果该物体正被携带，则其携带者可以通过一次 @Check[will|dc:33] 豁免来抵抗该物体变为受诅咒。稽折魔最多可同时维持五个诅咒；如果它感染第六件白银物品，则最早受诅咒的物品会失去诅咒。关于染疫银的详情，见本页侧栏。

染疫银

罕见

受诅咒

魔法

用法 诅咒白银物品

在携带染疫银1分钟后，它会与你纠缠。你变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，并在诅咒持续期间一直保持该状态。只要你仍受诅咒，你对抗由宁多鲁斯制造的心灵效果的所有豁免骰都会承受–2状态减值。

Frequency once per day

Effect The argyrzei concentrates on an adjacent silver object that's no larger than 2 Bulk. That object becomes cursed; if the object is being carried, the object's carrier can resist the object becoming cursed with a @Check[will|dc:33] save. The argyrzei can maintain up to five curses simultaneously; if they infect a sixth silver item, the oldest cursed item becomes uncursed. See the sidebar on this page for details on cursed silver.

Infected Silver

RARE

CURSED

MAGICAL

Usage curses silver item

After 1 minute of carrying infected silver, it fuses to you. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and remain so as long as the curse persists. As long as you remain cursed, you take a –2 status penalties to all saving throws against mental effects created by nindorus.

Manifest Silver Blade.name: 具现银剑 Manifest Silver Blade
Manifest Silver Blade.description:
需求 稽折魔未携带银刃

效果 稽折魔从其颈部残 stump 中拔出一把破损的白银武器之一，并将其变形成一把+1 强击 致伤白银手半剑。如果这把武器离开稽折魔的持有，它便会碎裂成沙。

有时，稽折魔可能会显现出不同类型的武器，而非剑刃——尤其是在它们正渗透或猎食于某个使用标志性武器的组织时。在这种情况下，银刃的外观可以改变，并且可能造成钝击或穿刺伤害，但其其他效果不变。

Requirements The argyrzei isn't carrying a silver blade

Effect The argyrzei pulls one of the broken silver weapons from the stump of their neck, transforming it into a +1 striking wounding silver bastard sword. This weapon crumbles into sand if it leaves the argyrzei's possession.

Sometimes, an argyrzei might manifest a different type of weapon than a blade—particularly if they're infiltrating or preying upon an organization that utilizes a signature weapon. In this case, the appearance of the silver blade can change and might inflict bludgeoning or piercing damage, but its other effects are unchanged.

Argyrzei.name: 稽折魔 Argyrzei

Path Maiden (Spring's Path).name: 行道女（春之路） Path Maiden (Spring's Path)

Limited Flight.name: 有限飞行 Limited Flight
Limited Flight.description:
行道女的飞行速度等同于她的速度，但她不能飞到离地面超过10英尺的高度；如果她在非稳定地面的表面上方结束自己的回合，她会消失，并在她最后一次位于稳定地面上方的空间重新实体化，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

A path maiden has a fly Speed equal to her Speed but can't fly higher than 10 feet above the ground, and if she ends her turn above a nonsolid surface, she vanishes and rematerializes on the last space she occupied over solid ground and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗命能时所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Imprisoning Grave.name: 监禁坟墓 Imprisoning Grave
Imprisoning Grave.description:
30尺。一个生物的灵魂若在行道女的灵光范围内死亡，就会被困在其尸体中，直到其躯体在灵光范围外度过1分钟。被困期间，该灵魂无法前往来世，但仍然可以被复活，或被转化为不死生物。

30 feet. The soul of a creature that dies within the path maiden's aura is trapped within its corpse until its body spends 1 minute outside the aura. While trapped, the soul can't move on to the afterlife but can still be brought back to life or transformed into an undead creature.

Blasphemous Aura.name: 渎神灵光 Blasphemous Aura
Blasphemous Aura.description:
30尺。当灵气中的一个生物使用具有治疗（特征）的法术或能力时，它必须进行一次对抗行道女法术DC - 3的意志豁免。若失败，该法术或能力恢复的生命值数量减半。若大失败，命能会变为虚能，因此不再治疗活体目标，而是对其造成伤害。

30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a spell or ability with the healing trait, it must succeed at a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC – 3. On a failure, the amount of Hit Points restored by the spell or ability is halved. On a critical failure, the vitality energy becomes void energy, harming a living target instead of healing it.

Corrupting Doubt.name: 腐化疑念 Corrupting Doubt
Corrupting Doubt.description:
被行道女之手打击伤害到的生物必须意志豁免成功，以避免陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮（大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}）。

A creature damaged by the path maiden's hand Strike must succeed at a Will save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

Path Maiden (Spring's Path).publicNotes:
神门中那些将自己的每一口气息都奉献给法拉斯玛、却在生命最后关头违逆这位女神的教徒，有时会在死后转变为行道女。所有行道女所穿的衣装，都是她们昔日信仰残存的最后痕迹，也是她们耻辱的永久提醒。

行道游民

行道女几乎总是以女性形态显现。那些显现为男性形态的，则被称为行道游民。这些不死生物拥有相同的属性，但往往游历得更广；与其说它们体现的是背弃法拉斯玛对生与死的掌管，不如说更体现了对她作为命运先知与操纵者这一角色的背离。

Worshippers in Shenmen who devote their every breath to Pharasma only to defy the goddess with their last sometimes transform, upon death, into path maidens. The garments all path maidens wear are the last vestiges of their former faith, a permanent reminder of their disgrace.

Path Nomads

Path maidens almost always manifest in feminine forms. Those who manifest in masculine forms are instead known as path nomads. These undead have the same abilities but tend to travel more widely; they represent turning one's back on Pharasma's role as a prophet and manipulator of destiny than of her roles over birth and death.

prototypeToken.name: 行道女（春之路） Path Maiden (Spring's Path)

Gurglegut.name: 咕噜肚 Gurglegut
Gurglegut.publicNotes:
A:步索 | B:独眼怪是栖居于树上的族群，心中始终潜藏着对吃喝他者血肉的欲望。他们的食物中很大一部分依赖树叶与块根作物补充，掌握大量农业知识，并天生拥有操控植物及其生长的力量。然而在肉类方面，A:步索 | B:独眼怪拒绝猛兽的血肉；他们转而吃喝其他类人生物。他们不仅觉得其他生物的味道令人作呕，而且他们的身体也会排斥非类人生物的肉，因为那对他们没有任何营养价值，吃下后只会让他们恶心且虚弱。

A:步索 | B:独眼怪异乎寻常的饮食需求意味着他们几乎总是与邻近的文化关系紧张。通常，他们只与地精维持还算不错的关系，因为地精这个族群较少会仅凭饮食来评判他人。其他社群畏惧A:步索 | B:独眼怪——而且这种畏惧也并非全无道理——不过除了偶尔外出猎取某个人作为下一餐之外，A:步索 | B:独眼怪通常还是离群索居。在某些绝望的分布地点，面对饥荒或其他自然灾害的社群甚至可能会主动寻求A:步索 | B:独眼怪的帮助，献上牺牲者，以换取知识或魔法援助，从而让他们的社群免于因饥饿而缓慢且糟糕地死去。

A:步索 | B:独眼怪的单眼有时会让他们被拿来与独眼巨人相提并论。然而，这两类生物都否认彼此拥有共同的族裔，而且他们最初是各自在世界上完全不同的地区独立出现的，属性也有显著差异。就A:步索 | B:独眼怪而言，他们相信自己祖先的行为造就了他们的单眼。面对威胁族群存续的饥荒时，这些祖先各自挖出自己的一只眼睛，作为献给森林中邪恶精魂的祭品，恳求获得拯救。A:步索 | B:独眼怪说，这些精魂——他们称之为busaw——赐予了他们农业知识、支配植物的力量，以及对有知觉者血肉的渴求。自那以后，他们便将busaw尊敬为神祇，并称自己为A:步索 | B:独眼怪：崇拜busaw者。

Busos are tree-dwelling folk with a simmering desire to consume the flesh of others. They to heavily supplement their food with leaves and root crops, possess significant knowledge of agriculture, and boast innate powers over plants and their growth. In regards to meat, however, busos reject the flesh of beasts; they instead consume other humanoids. Not only do they find the taste of other creatures repulsive, but their bodies reject non-humanoid meat since it provides them no nutritional value and consuming it leaves them sickened and weak.

Busos' unusual dietary needs mean they're almost always at odds with neighboring cultures. They typically maintain decent relations only with goblins, who are as a people less prone to judging others based on diet. Other communities fear busos-with some justification-though aside from the occasional forays to harvest someone for their next meal, busos tend to keep to themselves. In some desperate locations, communities faced with famine or other natural disasters might even seek out busos' aid, offering victims in exchange for knowledge or magical assistance that might save their communities from slow and terrible deaths through starvation.

A buso's single eye sometimes leads to them being compared to cyclopes. However, both types of creatures deny any common ancestry, and they first appeared independently in entirely different parts of the world with substantially divergent abilities. For their part, busos believe that their ancestors' deeds gave rise to their single eyes. When faced with a famine that threatened their existence, these ancestors each cut out one of their eyes as an offering to the malevolent spirits of the forest, imploring for their salvation. Busos say that these spirits, whom they call the busaw, gave them their knowledge of agriculture, power over plants, and craving for sentient flesh. Henceforth, they revered the busaw as gods and called themselves buso: those who worship the busaw.
Gurglegut.blurb:
变种雄性独眼怪
Variant male buso

Command Onidoshi.name: 命令术 鬼徒武士 Command Onidoshi
Command Onidoshi.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 咕噜肚向D1区域内的一名鬼武士犬吠下达命令。该鬼武士可以使用反应动作尝试对邻近的敌人进行一次近战打击。

Frequency once per round

Effect Gurglegut barks out a command to a single onidoshi in area D1. That onidoshi can use a reaction to attempt a melee Strike against an adjacent foe.

Spit Fire.name: 喷火 Spit Fire
Spit Fire.description:
频率 每天一次

效果咕噜肚饮下他的米酒壶中的内容（消耗酒壶中所含的一口），然后将其喷吐到他的弩上一支弩矢的燃烧尖端，形成一道火焰爆风，充满一个 @Template[cone|distance:20]，对区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免）。

Frequency once per day

Effect Gurglegut drinks the contents of his jug of rice wine (consuming one of the gulps contained in his jug), then spews it out across the flaming tip of a bolt in his crossbow, filling a @Template[cone|distance:20] with a blast of fire that inflicts @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] save) to all creatures in the area.

Resize Plant.name: 调整植物大小 Resize Plant
Resize Plant.description:
频率 每日两次。

需求 步索触碰一个小型、中型或大型植物。

效果 该植物的体型增大或缩小一级，并在接下来的5分钟内保持该体型。若用于植物生物，此效果具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{变巨术}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{缩小术}的效果（由步索选择）。不情愿的植物生物可以尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免骰来抵抗此效果。

Frequency twice per day.

Requirements The buso touches a Small, Medium, or Large plant.

Effect The plant grows or shrinks by one size, remaining that size for the next 5 minutes. If used on a plant creature, this effect has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Shrink} (buso's choice). Unwilling plant creatures can attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] saving throw to resist this effect.

Silkwasp Bandit.name: 绢黄蜂强盗 Silkwasp Bandit
Silkwasp Bandit.blurb:
人类怪物猎人
Human monster hunter

Rage.name: 狂暴 Rage
Rage.description:
需求 怪物猎人未处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}或狂暴状态

效果 怪物猎人获得9点临时生命值，持续至狂暴结束。处于狂暴时，其近战攻击额外造成8点伤害，获得+10足状态加值至其速度，并承受AC -1减值。怪物猎人不能使用具有专注特质的动作，但@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}和狂暴动作除外。

狂暴持续1分钟，直到怪物猎人无法察觉任何敌人，或直到怪物猎人陷入失去意识。

狂暴一旦结束，怪物猎人在1分钟内不能再次进入狂暴。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{效果：狂暴}

Requirements The monster hunter isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or raging

Effect The monster hunter gains 9 temporary Hit Points that last until the rage ends. While raging, they deal 8 additional damage with melee attacks, gain a +10-foot status bonus to their Speed, and take a -1 penalty to AC. The monster hunter can't use concentrate actions except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and rage actions.

The rage lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies the monster hunter can perceive, or until the monster hunter falls unconscious.

Once the rage ends, the monster hunter can't again for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Effect: Rage}

Sudden Charge.name: 突袭冲锋 Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description:
怪物猎人魅影野猪行走两次并进行一次近战打击。

The monster hunter Strides twice and makes a melee Strike.

Explosive Ammunition.name: 爆炸弹药 Explosive Ammunition
Explosive Ammunition.description:
弹药 任意

启动 A（操作）

这枚弹药涂覆着粗糙的黑色煤灰。启动后，爆炸弹药命中目标时，弹体会在 @Template[burst|distance:10] 内爆炸，对区域内的每个生物（包括目标）造成 @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] 伤害。每个生物都必须进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免。

Ammunition any

Activate A (manipulate)

This piece of ammunition is coated in gritty black soot. When activated explosive ammunition hits a target, the missile explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:10], dealing @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area (including the target). Each creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save.

Favored Game.name: 偏好的游戏 Favored Game
Favored Game.description:
怪物猎人特化于猎杀特定的非类人生物。这些偏好的猎物通常是动物和猛兽，但个体也可能狩猎龙类、植物，或更特化的生物，如老虎或蝎尾狮。

A monster hunter specializes in bringing down certain non-humanoid creatures. These favored game are typically animals and beasts, but an individual might hunt dragons, plants, or more specialized creatures like tigers or manticores.

Hunter's Onslaught.name: 猎手杀性 Hunter's Onslaught
Hunter's Onslaught.description:
频率 每小时一次

需求 该怪物猎人未处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}

效果 该怪物猎人率领众人向其可怖的猎物发起攻击。该怪物猎人选择一个其能够看见且符合其偏好猎物条件的敌人。该怪物猎人对该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}，并获得10点持续至猛攻结束的临时生命值。在猛攻期间，猎人对被指定敌人的伤害掷骰获得+8状态加值，而位于猎人周围30足灵气内的盟友获得该加值的一半。猛攻持续1分钟，或直到该怪物猎人或被指定的生物之一陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}。

Frequency once per hour

Requirements The monster hunter isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}

Effect The monster hunter leads an attack against their monstrous foe. The monster hunter chooses an enemy they can see that qualifies as their favored game. The monster hunter becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by that creature and gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last as long as the onslaught does. During the onslaught, the hunter gains a +8 status bonus to damage rolls against the designated enemy, and allies in a 30-foot aura around the hunter gain half that bonus. The onslaught lasts for 1 minute or until either the monster hunter or the designated creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

Primal Fear.name: 原始恐惧 Primal Fear
Primal Fear.description:
当怪物猎人命中一个符合其偏好猎物条件的生物时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（若为重击，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。

When the monster hunter hits a creature that qualifies as their favored game, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).

Silkwasp Bandit.publicNotes:
赏金猎人总是在不断移动，无论是在城墙之内还是荒野之中，都在追踪他们逃亡的猎物，以便俘获……或者处理掉。赏金猎人往往既依赖隐秘或欺瞒，也同样依赖武艺方面的技能，并运用广阔无边的各种才能来达成目标、领取丰厚的分红。

无论他们是受雇发动战争、保护大篷车，还是潜入坚不可摧的堡垒，在整个格拉利昂，雇佣兵都有大量的工作可做。

Bounty hunters are constantly on the move, whether within city walls or the wilderness, trailing their fugitive quarries for capture... or disposal. Often relying on stealth or deception as much as martial skill, bounty hunters employ a vast array of talents to accomplish their goals and collect the hefty payout.

Whether they're hired to wage war, protect a caravan, or infiltrate an impenetrable fortress, there's ample work for mercenaries all over Golarion.

Weakened Floor.name: 脆弱的地板 Weakened Floor
Weakened Floor.disable:
@Check[crafting|dc:33]（大师）三次，以在不触发孢子云的情况下在地板上打出孔洞，同时减轻地板承受的压力，使其可以在上面行走；@Check[stealth|dc:36]（专家），以在你的回合剩余时间内小心地移动穿过房间而不触发危害；或者在陷阱被触发后，进行两次 @Check[nature|dc:36]（专家），以在附近的墙壁上打出足够多的孔洞，使孢子散开

@Check[crafting|dc:33] (master) three times to knock holes in the floor without triggering the spore cloud while simultaneously lightening the strain on the floor so it can be walked upon, @Check[stealth|dc:36] (expert) to move carefully through the room for the remainder of your turn without triggering the hazard, or @Check[nature|dc:36] (expert) twice once the trap is triggered to knock enough holes into the nearby walls to cause the spores to disperse
Weakened Floor.hazarddescription:
脆弱的地板伴随着一声巨响塌陷了，将房间里的一切都坠入一片满是毒霉的泥泞沼泽之中。

The weakened floor gives way with a tremendous crash, dropping everything in the room into a muddy morass of toxic mold.
Weakened Floor.routine:
（1 动作）每轮在它的回合中，如今充满A4区域的孢子会对房间内所有生物造成 @Damage[8d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] 豁免），因为云雾会灼烧暴露的血肉；屏住呼吸的生物在此次豁免骰上获得+4环境加值。

(1 action) Every round on its turn, the spores that now fill area A4 inflict @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage to all creatures in the room (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save) as the cloud burns at exposed flesh; a creature that holds its breath gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this saving throw.
Weakened Floor.reset:
房间里有1分钟没有任何东西移动后，孢子就会沉降下来。地板仍然显而易见，且不会进一步崩溃，但任何穿过霉菌移动的生物都会使孢子再次扬起，重新触发该陷阱。

One minute after nothing moves in the room, the spores settle down. The floor remains obvious and won't collapse further, but any creature that moves through the mold causes the spores to plume up again, re-triggering the trap.

Collapse Floor.name: 地板坍塌 Collapse Floor
Collapse Floor.description:
触发 一轮开始时，一只小型或更大的生物站在A4区域的地板上

效果 整个房间的地板伴随着震耳欲聋的轰响崩溃，使房间内所有生物坠落5尺，掉入由泥浆、霉菌和有毒真菌构成的泥泞淤沼中，同时一团灰色与棕色的孢子云向上喷入空中。该房间变为高等困难地形。所有原本站在房间地板上的生物都会在下方的污秽中倒地，除非它们成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:34] 豁免，此时它们会双脚着地。随后，该危害掷先攻。

Trigger A round begins with a Small or larger creature standing on the floor in area A4

Effect The floor of the entire room collapses with a thunderous crash, dropping all creatures in the room 5 feet into a soupy morass of mud, mold, and toxic fungus while a cloud of gray and brown spores spews up into the air above. The room becomes greater difficult terrain. All creatures who were standing on the floor in the room fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in the mess below unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:34] save, in which case they land on their feet. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Path Maiden.name: 行道女 Path Maiden
Path Maiden.publicNotes:
神门中那些将自己的一呼一吸都奉献给法拉斯玛的教徒，有时却在生命最后一刻违逆了这位女神，并在死后转化为行道女。

所有行道女所穿的衣饰，都是她们过往信仰残留下来的最后痕迹，也是对其耻辱的永久提醒。

行道游民

行道女几乎总是以女性形态显现。那些以男性形态显现者，则被称为行道游民。这些不死生物拥有相同的属性，但往往游历得更广；她们所代表的，是背弃法拉斯玛作为预言者与命运操弄者的职责，而非她掌管生与死的职责。

Worshippers in Shenmen who devote their every breath to Pharasma only to defy the goddess with their last sometimes transform, upon death, into path maidens. The garments all path maidens wear are the last vestiges of their former faith, a permanent reminder of their disgrace.

Path Nomads

Path maidens almost always manifest in feminine forms. Those who manifest in masculine forms are instead known as path nomads. These undead have the same abilities but tend to travel more widely; they represent turning one's back on Pharasma's role as a prophet and manipulator of destiny than of her roles over birth and death.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗命能时所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Imprisoning Grave.name: 监禁坟墓 Imprisoning Grave
Imprisoning Grave.description:
30尺。死于行道女灵光内的生物的灵魂会被困在其尸体中，直到其躯体在灵光外度过1分钟。灵魂被困期间，无法进入来世，但仍可被复活，或被转化为不死生物。

30 feet. The soul of a creature that dies within the path maiden's aura is trapped within its corpse until its body spends 1 minute outside the aura. While trapped, the soul can't move on to the afterlife but can still be brought back to life or transformed into an undead creature.

Scorn Fate.name: 蔑视命运 Scorn Fate
Scorn Fate.description:
行道女以她能看见的一个生物为目标。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:32] 豁免。若失败，该生物的下一次掷骰会受到诅咒。若该次掷骰的结果为大成功，则改为普通成功。成功变为失败，而失败变为大失败。随后，该生物在24小时内会暂时免疫蔑视命运。

The path maiden targets a creature she can see. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save. On a failure, the creature's next roll is cursed. If the result of the roll is a critical success, it becomes a regular success. A success becomes a failure, and a failure becomes a critical failure. That creature is then temporarily immune to Scorn Fate for 24 hours.

Vengeful Frenzy.name: 复仇狂乱 Vengeful Frenzy
Vengeful Frenzy.description:
行道女以她能看见的60尺内一名生物为目标。该目标必须针对行道女的法术DC尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:32] 豁免。若失败，则该目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，直到其下个回合结束，但它不会因该困惑而攻击行道女或其自身。

The path maiden targets a creature within 60 feet that she can see. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of its next turn, but it can't attack path maidens or itself as the result of this confusion.

Limited Flight.name: 有限飞行 Limited Flight
Limited Flight.description:
行道女拥有等同于其速度的飞行速度，但不能飞到离地面超过10英尺的高度；如果她在非稳定表面上方结束其回合，她会消失，并在她最后一次位于稳定地面上方时所占据的空间重新实体化，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

A path maiden has a fly Speed equal to her Speed but can't fly higher than 10 feet above the ground, and if she ends her turn above a nonsolid surface, she vanishes and rematerializes on the last space she occupied over solid ground and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

False Governor.name: 伪镇长 False Governor
False Governor.blurb:
变体阿卡什提宁多如
Variant akashti nindoru

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被伪镇长杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为亡灵。恪尸魔会自动尝试反制任何针对其所杀死生物施放的复活术或将其转化为亡灵的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+36 #Counteract]]{+36}，反制等级 7）。如果杀死该生物的伪镇长被杀，这个生物便可以正常地从死亡中归来，或正常地变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by an false governor are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The akashti automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+36 #Counteract]]{+36}, counteract rank 7). If the false governor who slew the creature is slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Body.name: 具现身躯 Manifest Body
Manifest Body.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 伪镇长在其纤细的骸骨躯体外显现出一具中空的类人生物身体，其外观看起来与镇长和善保完全一致。当穿着这具显现出的身体时，伪镇长失去其爪击打击，且其声音听起来与和善保的声音相同。如果伪镇长不每天花费10分钟来维持这具虚假血肉的显现，这具显现出的身体就会迅速腐朽。该身体有10生命值，且具有与伪镇长相同的防御。当这具身体被摧毁时，伪镇长会毫发无伤地浮现，而留下的血肉外壳会散成一团红色蝴蝶，并迅速隐纹为红色浓雾。这种浮现方式极其血腥骇人，令人不安，因此30尺内所有目睹此景的生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:29] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}（大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3}）；这具有精神和视觉（特征）特征。

Frequency once per day

Effect The false governor has manifested a hollow humanoid body around their slender skeletal frame that looks identical to that of Governor Heh Shan-Bao. While wearing this manifested body, the false governor loses their claw Strike, and their voice sounds like that of Heh Shan-Bao's. The false governor's manifested body decays swiftly if they don't take 10 minutes once per day to maintain the manifestation of the false flesh. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the false governor. When the body is destroyed, the false governor emerges unharmed, and the fleshy shell left behind scatters into a cloud of red butterflies that swiftly fade into red mist. This emergence is so grisly and unsettling that all creatures within 30 feet who witness it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} on a critical failure); this has the mental and visual traits.

Stunning Despair.name: 震慑绝望 Stunning Despair
Stunning Despair.description:
伪镇长爆发出数声令人难以承受的绝望恸哭。30尺内的生物必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免，以避免陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}）。

伪镇长在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次使用震慑绝望。

The false governor unleashes several overwhelming sobs of despair. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure).

The false governor can't use Stunning Despair again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4 rounds}.

False Governor.publicNotes:
阿卡什提斯是狡诈的魔族，专门猎食哀悼中的人；它们会化作最近亡故的挚爱之人，以便潜入家中，随后谋杀并吞食悲痛家庭成员的灵魂。它们有时被称为“拟尸”；恪尸魔显出真实形态时，看起来像一具覆着皮肤的骨架，手指上长着锋利的利爪，无睑的双眼中滴落着血液般的泪水。它的颅骨敞开如碗，里面栖息着一捧捧猩红色的蝴蝶。当恪尸魔藏身于它显化出的躯体之中时，若仔细查看，有时就能揭开真相：那个仿佛死而复生的挚爱之人，其头皮会隐约起伏鼓胀，仿佛里面的蝴蝶正在蠕动。阿卡什提斯体现了悲伤这一复杂循环。

已死的入侵者

有时，阿卡什提斯伏击并杀害目标，并不是为了沉浸于其挚爱之人的悲痛之中，而是为了冒充其形貌，从内部渗透某个组织，腐化既有的同志情谊羁绊。不过，这些阿卡什提斯最终总会对欺瞒感到厌倦，并把它们的新盟友引入陷阱，加以屠杀。

Akashtis are manipulative fiends who prey on those in mourning; they assume the form of a recently deceased loved one so they can infiltrate homes, then murder and consume the souls of grieving families. Sometimes called a "copycorpse," an akashti in its true form appears as a skin-covered skeleton with sharp talons on its fingers and tears of blood dripping from its lidless eyes. Its skull appears open like a bowl, and inside nest handfuls of crimson butterflies. When an akashti hides within its manifested body, close investigation can sometimes reveal the truth when the scalp of the supposed beloved one returned to life seems to subtly ripple and bulge as the butterflies within writhe. Akashtis embody the complex cycle of grief.

Deathly Invaders

Sometimes, akashtis ambush and murder targets not to bask in the grief of their loved ones, but instead to assume their form and infiltrate an organization from within to corrupt established bonds of camaraderie. Inevitably, though, these akashtis grow bored with deception and lead their new allies into a trap for slaughter.

Imprecasia.name: 食厄精 Imprecasia
Imprecasia.publicNotes:
食厄精，通常被称为食咒者，是一种独居的精类，会被从诅咒中散发出的能量所吸引。它们看起来像消瘦的类人生物，有着阴影般的翅膀、长而纤细且带有锋利利爪的双手，以及带羽状触角的昆虫般头部。

食厄精出现在某个地区，意味着这片土地正受困扰，但它们并不是不受欢迎的生物。恰恰相反，食厄精的下落是令人觊觎的情报，因为它们有能力彻底吃喝物体和生物身上的诅咒。许多背负诅咒重担的人都会去寻找食咒者，而它们大多也乐于接受带有毁灭的物体，或出于善意消除某个人身上的诅咒。

食厄精绝不会接受治疗一片受诅咒土地或枯萎地区这种想法。它甚至可能会主动强化一片区域上的苦难，只为了确保稳定的食物来源。更大胆的食厄精会跨越数代追踪受诅咒的家族，以他们的不幸为食，直到诅咒终结或血脉断绝。任何试图摧毁这类诅咒的人，都可能发现自己成了食厄精的敌人，因为它会保卫自己的养分来源。

An imprecasia, commonly known as a curse eater, is a solitary fey drawn to the energy emanating from curses. They appear as emaciated humanoid creatures with shadowy wings, long thin hands with sharp claws, and insectile heads with feathery antenna.

An imprecasia's appearance in a region signifies the land is troubled, but they're not unpopular creatures. On the contrary, an imprecasia's whereabouts are coveted information, as they have the ability to fully consume curses on objects and creatures. Many carrying the weight of a curse seek out curse eaters, most of whom will gladly accept doomed objects or charitably destroy an individual's curse.

An imprecasia will never accept the idea of healing a cursed land or blighted region. One might even seek to strengthen the afflictions on a region simply to ensure a regular supply of food. A bolder imprecasia tracks cursed families over generations, feeding off their misfortune until the curse ends or the bloodline dies off. Any who attempt to destroy such curses may find themselves the enemy of an imprecasia defending their source of sustenance.

Drink Death.name: 饮下死亡 Drink Death
Drink Death.description:
触发 食厄精30尺内的一名生物处于濒死

效果 食厄精深吸一口气，将一缕细长的蓝色雾气从该濒死生物的躯体中抽出，吸入口中。该濒死生物的濒死（状态）值减少1，且食厄精恢复2d10+9生命值。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the imprecasia is dying

Effect The imprecasia inhales, drawing a thin blue streak of vapor out of the dying creature's body into their mouth. The dying creature's dying condition is reduced by 1, and the imprecasia regains 2d10+9 Hit Points.

Devour Curse.name: 吞噬诅咒 Devour Curse
Devour Curse.description:
食厄精对受诅咒影响的生物施放净化苦难。若其成功移除该诅咒，它还会从该生物体内吸入命能（看起来像是从目标的躯体中吸入蓝色条纹状蒸气），使该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，除非其成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:30]豁免（若大失败，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}）。若该诅咒被移除，食厄精就不会消耗掉这次将净化苦难作为原能先天法术的使用次数。

以物品为目标

食厄精可以对受诅咒的物品施放移除诅咒，而非对生物施放，但它们不能对其使用吞噬诅咒。它们只能对等级等于或低于自身等级的物品如此做；若成功，若该物品等级等于食厄精等级–4或更高，则该物品在24小时内不再受诅咒；若其等级低于该值，则会永久解除诅咒。

The imprecasia casts cleanse affliction against a curse afflicting a creature. If they succeed in removing the curse, they also breathe in vitality from the creature (appearing to inhale blue streaks of vapor from the target's body), causing the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). If the curse is removed, the imprecasia doesn't expend that use of cleanse affliction as a primal innate spell.

Targeting Items

An imprecasia can cast remove curse on a cursed item rather than on a creature, but they can't use Devour Curse on it. They can only do so on an item that's of a level equal to or less than their own level; on a success, the item is uncursed for 24 hours if it's of a level equal to or higher than the imprecasia's level –4, or uncursed permanently if it's lower level than that.

Homeland's Hostility.name: 家园敌意 Homeland's Hostility
Homeland's Hostility.description:
从食厄精的爪击受到伤害的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:30]豁免。若失败，它将食厄精60尺内的所有地形视为困难地形。

A creature that takes damage from the imprecasia's claws must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save. On a failure, it treats all terrain within 60 feet of an imprecasia as difficult terrain.

Scent Curse.name: 诅咒嗅觉 Scent Curse
Scent Curse.description:
食厄精能够嗅出30尺内等级等于或低于其自身等级的诅咒的存在；这是一种模糊感官。

The imprecasia can smell the presence of curses of a level equal to or lower than their own level within 30 feet; this is an imprecise sense.

Shisagishin.name: 煞星魔 Shisagishin

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被煞星魔杀死的生物很难被复活术带回生命，或被转化为亡灵。煞星魔会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死生物施放的复活术或将其转化为亡灵的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21}，反制等级 6）。如果杀死该生物的煞星魔本身被杀死，该生物便可以正常地自死亡中被带回，或正常地变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by an shisagishin are difficult to bring back to life or to animate as undead. The shisagishin automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21}, counteract level 6th). If the shisagishin who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Burst From Death.name: 死中暴起 Burst From Death
Burst From Death.description:
触发 一个生物触碰了伪装中的煞星魔，或触碰了煞星魔被放入的棺材或其他容器

需求 尚未掷先攻，且煞星魔正通过具现尸壳伪装成一具尸体

效果 煞星魔猛烈地展开为其真正形态，撕碎其腐朽的尸壳，并在掷先攻前尝试对一个相邻目标进行一次爪击打击。

Trigger A creature touches the disguised shisagishin or a coffin or other container the shisagishin has been placed into

Requirements Initiative hasn't yet been rolled, and the shisagishin is disguised as a corpse with Manifest Corpse Shell

Effect The shisagishin violently unfolds into their true form, shredding their decaying corpse shell, and attempts a claw Strike on an adjacent target before they roll initiative.

Manifest Corpse Shell.name: 具现尸壳 Manifest Corpse Shell
Manifest Corpse Shell.description:
煞星魔将其手臂和腿缩入自己的身体，丢弃@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并在10分钟的专注过程中于自身周围显现一具腐烂和/或残 mutilated 的类人生物尸体。煞星魔可以通过以欺瞒冒充他们此前见过的某个特定生物，使这具尸体显现为该生物的遗骸。一旦其尸壳显现，在煞星魔下一次行动之前，他们看起来就像是一具尸体。他们在以尸体身份蒙混过关的欺瞒检定和DC上自动获得44的结果。

The shisagishin tucks their arms and legs into their body, drops @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and manifests a decaying and/or mutilated humanoid corpse around themself over the course of 10 minutes of concentration. The shisagishin can cause this corpse to appear to be the remains of a specific creature they've seen before by Impersonating that creature with Deception. Once their corpse shell has manifested, until the next time the shisagishin acts, they appear to be a corpse. They have an automatic result of 44 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a corpse.

Spread Decay.name: 散播腐败 Spread Decay
Spread Decay.description:
煞星魔的提灯面孔发光，使任何数量被其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的生物的血肉迅速开始腐朽。这些生物中的每一个都必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:32]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[2d8[void]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[4d8[void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。

大失败 该生物受到@Damage[6d8[void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}

The shisagishin's lantern face glows, causing the flesh of any number of creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by them to swiftly begin to decay. Each of those creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d8[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d8[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d8[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}

Shisagishin.publicNotes:
煞星魔乐于潜入某个群体，然后伪装成某位挚爱之人或备受爱戴的公众人物那腐烂不堪或残缺毁坏的遗骸，只待葬礼服务期间突然现出真正形态。煞星魔体现了腐朽孕育崭新生命的循环。

手作栖息地

煞星魔更喜欢在已经充满冲突和潜在意外事故的地方游荡，但如果有需要，它也很乐意亲手制造这样的地点。它们可能会在水井里下毒，让健康的牲畜染上疾病，甚至与腐败的人类合作，只要这意味着能获得杀戮的自由。受诅咒的城镇或闹鬼的道路，有时就是这类煞星魔的游乐场。

The shisagishin takes delight in infiltrating a community and then disguising itself as the horribly decayed or mutilated remains of a loved one or adored public figure, only to spring to life in its true form during funeral services. A shisagishin epitomizes the cycle of decay giving rise to new life.

Handmade Habitats

A shisagishin prefers to roam areas already rife with conflict and potential accidents, but it will happily create such a location if needed. They might poison wells, introduce disease to healthy livestock, or even collaborate with corrupt humans if it means the freedom to kill. Cursed towns or haunted roads are sometimes the playground of such a shisagishin.

Absorb Wraith.name: 吸收缚灵 Absorb Wraith
Absorb Wraith.description:
惧栗缚灵将手伸向100足内的另一个缚灵生物。目标缚灵溶解并沿直线冲向惧栗缚灵，对线形上的每个生物造成 @Damage[6d10[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

惧栗缚灵吸收目标缚灵的精华，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，并在等同于被吸收缚灵等级的轮数内获得飞行速度 +10足的状态加值。它只能将额外动作用于飞行或打击。

不情愿的目标可以尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 意志豁免，以抵抗被吸收。

The dread wraith extends its hand toward another wraith creature within 100 feet. The target wraith dissolves and streaks toward the dread wraith in a straight line, dealing @Damage[6d10[void]] damage to each creature along the line (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

The dread wraith absorbs the essence of the target wraith, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and gaining a +10-foot status bonus to its fly Speed for a number of rounds equal to the level of the absorbed wraith. It can use its extra action only to Fly or Strike.

An unwilling target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save to resist being absorbed.

Drain Life.name: 汲取生命 Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
当恐惧缚灵以其幽魂之手打击对活物造成伤害时，该缚灵获得10点临时生命值，且目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28|options:inflicts:drained] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 1}。此后该缚灵造成的进一步伤害会使流失状态值在豁免失败时增加1，最高至流失 4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{效果：汲取生命}

When the dread wraith damages a living creature with its spectral hand Strike, the wraith gains 10 temporary Hit Points and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|options:inflicts:drained] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the wraith increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{Effect: Drain Life}

Wraith Spawn.name: 怨灵孽种 Wraith Spawn
Wraith Spawn.description:
被缚灵的幽灵手打击杀死的活体类人生物会在[[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]{1d4轮}后化为一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{缚灵衍体}。这个缚灵衍体受杀死它的惧栗缚灵命令。它不具有吸取生命或缚灵衍体能力。若该缚灵衍体的创造者死亡，该缚灵衍体会变成一个完整且自主的缚灵；它恢复自由意志，并获得吸取生命和缚灵衍体能力。

A living humanoid slain by a wraith's spectral hand Strike rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{Wraith Spawn} after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]{1d4 rounds}. This wraith spawn is under the command of the dread wraith that killed it. It doesn't have drain life or wraith spawn. If the creator of the wraith spawn dies, the wraith spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous wraith; it regains its free will and gains drain life and wraith spawn.

Draining Presence.description:
10尺。进入该灵光的生物必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]强韧豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态）1}。在脱离该灵光1分钟后，它会恢复。此流失（状态）值可与吸取生命造成的流失（状态）值累积，但不能与多个汲取灵光灵光叠加。

成功通过其豁免的生物会在24小时内暂时免疫汲取灵光。

10 feet. A creature entering the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. It recovers after it has been out of the aura for 1 minute. This drained condition value is cumulative with the drained value caused by drain life, but not with multiple draining presence auras.

A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to draining presence for 24 hours.
Draining Presence.name: 汲取灵光 Draining Presence

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗命能的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光无力 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
一个A:惧栗缚灵若被阳光照射，则会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}。

A dread wraith caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Variant Dread Wraith.name: 变体惧栗缚灵 Variant Dread Wraith
Variant Dread Wraith.publicNotes:
这些凶恶的灵体残痕源自邪恶的军阀或嗜血的将军，是由暗影与死亡构成的高大幽魂。和其他缚灵一样，惧栗缚灵会在世界上阴暗的地方作祟，但惧栗缚灵更可能长途跋涉去散播怖惧或积聚影响，并且在穿越洒满阳光的土地时，常会停留于幽暗的林间空地或阴森的废墟。惧栗缚灵往往傲慢自大，很少与同类结成群体，反而更喜欢支配成群的平平无奇缚灵。不过，特别强大的死灵法师也可能强迫成群的惧栗缚灵为其效力，而某个格外邪恶的目标——例如铲除一座光明壁垒与生命的堡垒——也可能使数只惧栗缚灵因共同目的而聚集在一起。

These menacing spiritual remnants of wicked warlords or bloodthirsty generals are towering specters of shadow and death. Like other wraiths, dread wraiths haunt the shadowy places of the world, but dread wraiths are more likely to travel greater distances to sow terror or amass influence, often sticking to dark glades or sinister ruins when journeying across sun-dappled lands. Dread wraiths tends to be arrogant and rarely form a pack with others of their kind, preferring instead to dominate groups of ordinary wraiths. A particularly powerful necromancer might compel packs of dread wraiths into service, however, while a particularly malevolent goal-such as to eradicate a bastion of light and life-might draw several dread wraiths together in a common purpose.
Variant Dread Wraith.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality
Variant Dread Wraith.blurb:
变体惧栗缚灵
Variant Dread Wraith
