Unwelcoming Facade.name: 冷漠外表 Unwelcoming Facade
Unwelcoming Facade.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:32] 或 @Check[religion|dc:32] 以驱除该作祟，@Check[society|dc:35] 以符合礼数的方式接近庄园，从而尊重其住客在社群中的象征性地位；出示一份合法授予进入建筑许可的官方通行证可使这两个难度等级均降低 5（前提是 PC 们从正门接近，而不是从其他方向）。

@Check[occultism|dc:27] @Check[religion|dc:27] @Check[society|dc:30]

@Check[occultism|dc:32] or @Check[religion|dc:32] to exorcise the haunt, @Check[society|dc:35] to approach the manor in a proper way that defers to its occupant's symbolic standing in the community; displaying an official pass that legally grants permission to enter the building reduces both of these DCs by 5 (provided the PCs approach the front door and not from another direction).

@Check[occultism|dc:27] @Check[religion|dc:27] @Check[society|dc:30]
Unwelcoming Facade.hazarddescription:
一股令人不安的恶意与邪异能量从庄园中无形地荡漾而出，使那些看向这座建筑的人会从其建筑中看到一张狞笑的邪恶面孔，正怒目瞪视着他们。

An unsettling wave of malice and sinister energy ripples invisibly out from the manor, causing those who view the building to see a leering, evil face glaring at them from the structure's architecture.
Unwelcoming Facade.reset:
若未被停用，冷漠外表会立即重置，并可在下一轮立刻再次被触发。

The unwelcoming facade resets immediately if not disabled and can be triggered again the very next round.

Horrifying Vision.name: 骇人幻景 Horrifying Vision
Horrifying Vision.description:
触发 一个小型或更大的生物接近到房屋外部30英尺内

效果 一股恶意充满了庄园外60英尺内所有活物的心智，使其被压倒性的恐惧笼罩；每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响，并对骇人幻景获得24小时的临时免疫。除了这项临时免疫外，该生物还可以用一个自由动作尝试一次 @Check[occultism|dc:23] 或 @Check[religion|dc:23] 检定，以注意到尽管建筑正面只有一张脸，但似乎有数个灵性回响灌注于这栋建筑之中。若大成功或大失败，则该生物会意识到，灌注庄园的力量中只有最强大的那股力量是邪恶的，而其他成分则是非敌对的精魂，它们被那股单一力量压制并困住了。

成功 该生物会短暂看见庄园正面扭曲成一张巨大而可怖的面孔的幻景，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。该生物可以像上文一样尝试相同的 @Check[occultism|dc:33] 或 @Check[religion|dc:33] 检定，但难度等级提高至33。

失败 如失败所述，但该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}，并在其仍处于惊惧期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。该生物可以如常尝试神秘学或宗教检定来回忆知识（直到其逃脱）。

大成功或大失败 如失败所述，但该生物在1分钟内无法将其惊惧（状态）降低到1以下。此外，这种压倒性的恐惧使该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}；该状态会持续，直到以魔法治愈或危害被解除。

Trigger A Small or larger creature approaches within 30 feet of the house's exterior

Effect A wave of malice fills the minds of all living creatures outside of the manor within 60 feet of it with overwhelming fear; each creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Horrifying Vision for 24 hours. In addition to this temporary immunity, the creature can attempt a @Check[occultism|dc:23] or @Check[religion|dc:23] check as a free action to notice that despite there being only one face in the facade, several spiritual echoes seem to infuse the building. On a critical success, the creature realizes that only the most powerful force infusing the manor is evil and that the other elements are non-hostile spirits who are overwhelmed and trapped by that singular force.

Success The creature experiences a brief vision of the manor's facade twisting into an immense, horrific face and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. The creature can attempt the same @Check[occultism|dc:33] or @Check[religion|dc:33] check as above, but the DC increases to 33.

Failure As failure, but the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened. The creature can attempt the Occultism or Religion check to Recall Knowledge normally (DC 33).

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 for 1 minute. In addition, the overwhelming fear causes the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}; this condition persists until it's cured magically or the hazard is disabled.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
络新妇呈现为任意小型或中型蜘蛛的外观。这不会改变其速度或打击。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The jorogumo takes on the appearance of any Small or Medium spider. This doesn't change their Speed or Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Jorogumo Venom.name: 络新妇毒 Jorogumo Venom
Jorogumo Venom.description:
豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:37]

最长持续时间 4小时

阶段 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]] 伤害并且 呆滞 2（1轮）

阶段 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}（2d4小时）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:37]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and stupefied 2 (1 round)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (2d4 hours)

Spider Legs.name: 蜘蛛腿 Spider Legs
Spider Legs.description:
需求 该络新妇处于类人形态

效果 八条巨大的蜘蛛腿从络新妇的背后长出，使其获得40足攀爬速度，并允许其使用蛛腿拨挡反应动作（）。

Requirements The jorogumo is in humanoid form

Effect Eight large spider legs sprout from the jorogumo's back, granting them a 40-foot climb Speed and allowing them to use the Darting Legs reaction.

Web Trap.name: 网缚 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被络新妇的蛛网攻击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，并卡在最近的表面上，阻止该生物移动。

对该A:网捕进行[[/act escape dc=37]]或[[/act force-open dc=37]]的难度等级为37。

A creature hit by the jorogumo's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface, preventing the creature from moving.

The DC to [[/act escape dc=37]] or [[/act force-open dc=37]] the web trap is 37.

Darting Legs.description:
需求 络新妇已伸出其蜘蛛腿，或已改变形态

触发 络新妇成为一次攻击的目标

效果 络新妇抬起一条腿，在对抗触发攻击的AC上获得+2环境加值。

Requirements The jorogumo has their spider legs extended or has Changed Shape

Trigger The jorogumo is targeted with an attack

Effect The jorogumo raises a leg, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
Darting Legs.name: 蛛腿拨挡 Darting Legs

Silver Mistwalk.name: 白银雾行 Silver Mistwalk
Silver Mistwalk.description:
需求 任美璃当前位于她在神门领域的边界之内

频率 每小时一次

效果 一股旋转的银色浓雾涡流从任美璃脚下升起，如同缓慢旋转的龙卷风般缠绕着她的躯体，随后立刻将她以及她穿戴和手持的任何物品从当前空间传送到她在神门领域内曾经到访过的任意一处空旷空间，前提是她知道该地点相对于自己的位置与距离。由于任美璃过去曾到访过柳岸镇的废墟，因此她可以使用此能力出现在城镇中的任何地方，不过如果没人预期她会出现，她通常会避免直接出现在建筑物内部。

Requirements Ren Mei Li is currently located within the boundaries of her domain in Shenmen

Frequency once per hour

Effect A swirling vortex of silver mist rises up from Ren Mei Li's feet to wrap around her body like a slowly rotating tornado, then instantly transports her and any items she's wearing and holding from her current space to a clear space anywhere within her domain in Shenmen that she's visited before, provided she knows its relative location and distance from her. Since Ren Mei Li has visited Willowshore's ruins in the past, she can appear anywhere in the town using this ability, but she generally avoids directly appearing inside a structure if she isn't expected.

Ren Mei Li.publicNotes:
络新妇外表是美丽、衣着考究的人类，潜伏于高山之中，以旅人为食。这些邪恶生物能够完全变成一只巨型蜘蛛，或从背后长出蜘蛛腿，而且它们常把巨型蜘蛛当作宠物饲养。络新妇通常会吃掉猎物，但有些类人生物会遭遇更为可怖的命运——成为络新妇虫卵的活体宿主。尽管大多数络新妇都是独居生物，但其中一些已开始崇拜诺格博，并作为窃贼行会的宝贵盟友为其效力，追随该神祇作为灰白宗师时的化身。

Appearing as beautiful, well-dressed humans, jorogumo lurk in the high mountains and prey on travelers. These evil creatures can fully change into a giant spider or sprout spider legs from their backs, and they often keep giant spiders as pets. Jorogumo usually eat their prey, but some humanoids meet an even more gruesome fate as living incubators for jorogumo eggs. Though most jorogumos are solitary creatures, some have taken up worship of Norgorber and serve as valuable allies to thieves' guilds following that god's guise as the Gray Master.
Ren Mei Li.name: 任美璃 Ren Mei Li

Frightful Moan.name: 骇人悲叹 Frightful Moan
Frightful Moan.description:
幽灵哀叹自己的命运，迫使每个处于 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺}内的活物尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] 豁免。失败时，生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}（若为大失败，则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}）。成功时，生物在1分钟内暂时免疫该幽灵的骇人悲叹。

The ghost laments its fate, forcing each living creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} to attempt a @Check[will|dc:21|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). On a success, a creature is temporarily immune to this ghost's frightful moan for 1 minute.

Site Bound.name: 场地绑定 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
普通幽灵通常只能离它被杀死之处或它所作祟的地方一小段距离。普通的限制是120英尺。相反，有些幽灵不是被束缚于某个地点，而是被束缚于一个对它而言很特殊的房间、建筑、物品或生物。

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
纠正导致这名平民死亡的不公，能让它前往来世。

当一个幽灵被摧毁时，它会在其所束缚地点内于 [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天} 后重新成形，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正阻止该精魂休息的一切时，幽灵才能被永久摧毁。

Setting right the injustice that led to the commoner's death allows it to move on to the afterlife.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Ghost.name: 幽灵 Ghost
Ghost.publicNotes:
平民幽灵是一个相信自己死得冤屈的平平无奇之人。

当一些凡人因悲惨的境遇而死，或死时心愿未了，他们的灵魂就可能徘徊不去，并在生前对他们意义重大的地点作祟。

The ghost commoner is an ordinary person who believes they died unjustly.

When some mortals die through tragic circumstances or without closure, their souls can linger and haunt a locale significant to them in life.
Ghost.blurb:
变体平民幽灵
variant ghost commoner

prototypeToken.name: 嘲讽僧侣的头骨 Taunting Monk's Skull

Taunting Monk's Skull.name: 嘲讽僧侣的头骨 Taunting Monk's Skull
Taunting Monk's Skull.publicNotes:
一些无头亡灵在被唤起时，其心灵能力大多仍然完好无损。这些狡猾的亡灵常会挑衅受害者，诱使他们愚蠢地追赶自己，或伤害自己。

无头亡灵是失去身体、仅剩漂浮头颅并被转化为亡灵的存在。由于制造开销低廉且可定制性近乎无穷，它们是死灵法师“project minion”的天然选择。在任何长期由研习死灵法师占据的巢穴中，发现几颗四处游荡的漂浮头颅都并不罕见；它们各自展现出完全不同的特征，甚至连制造工艺的纯熟程度也各不相同。

Some beheaded are raised with their mental faculties mostly intact. These clever undead often provoke their victims into foolishly giving chase or harming themselves.

Beheaded are disembodied floating heads transformed into undead. They are natural candidates for a necromancer's "project minion," due to the inexpensive cost of creation and endlessly customizable nature. In any lair occupied for long by practicing necromancers, it isn't uncommon to find a handful of floating heads roaming about, each exhibiting completely different characteristics and even degrees of expertise in their creation.
Taunting Monk's Skull.blurb:
变体嘲弄颅骨
Variant taunting skull

Bite Back.name: 反咬一口 Bite Back
Bite Back.description:
触发 该颅骨受到其触及内一名生物的攻击

效果 该颅骨对该生物进行一次次颚咬打击。

Trigger The skull is attacked by a creature within their reach

Effect The skull makes a jaws Strike against that creature.

Behold the Promises of Kugaptee!.name: 瞧啊，苦迦菩提的应许！ Behold the Promises of Kugaptee!
Behold the Promises of Kugaptee!.description:
骷髅选择60尺内的一个生物，向其诉说如果将灵魂交给苦迦菩提，他们将被赐予的湮灭。目标必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24]豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并在1分钟内暂时免疫。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，持续1轮。

大失败 目标因绝望而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}1轮，随后再陷入措手不及1额外轮。

The skull chooses one creature within 60 feet and speaks to them about the oblivion they'll be granted if they cede their soul to Kugaptee. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} by despair for 1 round, and is then off-guard for 1 additional round.

Stingy.name: 刺仔 Stingy
Stingy.publicNotes:
这些体型巨大、令人恐惧的蛛形纲生物从头到尾巴根部通常有8英尺长。巨型蝎子是各种沙漠栖居生物——尤其是鬣狗人——偏爱的驮畜和战兽。不过，它们更常见于荒野之中。在那里，它们栖身于山边的洞穴中，或潜伏在浅浅的沙层之下，守株待兔，等待猎物游荡到近旁。

蝎子是沙漠、森林、稀树草原和荒地中覆有几丁质甲壳的可怕笞鞭，是拥有强大钳击与痛苦螫刺的致命蛛形纲生物。几乎各种气候中都能发现蝎子，它们以耐心的隐秘与纯粹的力量相结合来狩猎猎物。大多数蝎子生活在地下洞穴中，要么是独居的猎人，要么是大型群落的一部分。这些蛛形纲生物如此令人畏惧且危险，以至于在许多文化中，它们被视作神祇，或同时象征死亡以及免受这种死亡侵害之防护的二元印记。

These massive, terrifying arachnids are typically 8 feet long from head to the base of the tail. Giant scorpions are the favored pack animals and war beasts of various desert-dwelling creatures, particularly kholos. They are most commonly encountered in the wild, however. There they lair in mountainside caves or burrow beneath shallow layers of sand where they lie in wait for prey to wander near.

Chitinous scourges of deserts, forests, savannas, and badlands, scorpions are deadly arachnids with powerful pincers and a painful sting. Scorpions can be found in nearly every climate, where they hunt their prey with a mixture of patient stealth and raw strength. Most scorpions live in underground burrows, either as lone hunters or part of a larger colony. These arachnids are so feared and dangerous that in many cultures, they are treated as deities or dualistic symbols of both death and protection from said death.
Stingy.blurb:
变种巨人蝎子
Variant giant scorpion

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 震颤感知（模糊）60尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Reactive Strike (Stinger Only).name: 反应打击（仅限刺针） Reactive Strike (Stinger Only)

Forest Scorpion Venom.name: 森林蝎毒 Forest Scorpion Venom
Forest Scorpion Venom.description:
豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

最大持续时间 4轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]]伤害，并且 虚弱1（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

prototypeToken.name: 苦迦菩提武僧 Monk of Kugaptee

Monk of Kugaptee.name: 苦迦菩提武僧 Monk of Kugaptee
Monk of Kugaptee.publicNotes:
生前违背了僧院誓言的武僧，死后可能会化为一种被称为黑坊主的不死生物恐怖存在。这些掠食者以凡人的气息为食，用扭曲的肢体悄悄爬入卧室，从沉睡的受害者身上窃取生命。这种进食行为会在受害者身上留下痕迹，表现为呼吸中带有腐烂的恶臭，以及一种会逐渐导致衰竭并最终招致死亡的虚弱性疾病。

黑坊主仍保留着苦修训练的余韵，使它们能够在战斗中从虚弱的敌人身上吸取气息。它们怀着恶意的狡猾，再加上苦修者的自律，使其能够炮制出精心设计且旷日持久的阴谋，以实施它们出于嫉妒的报复。极少有黑坊主足够具有说服力，能劝诱它们昔日的同伴违背自己的誓言，但这并不妨碍它们一再尝试。

A monk who violated their monastic vows in life might arise after death to become an undead horror known as a kurobozu. These predators feast upon the breath of mortals, creeping on twisted limbs into bedrooms to steal the life from sleeping victims. This act of feeding leaves its mark on the victim in the form of a vile scent of rot on the victim's breath and a debilitating disease that eventually results in exhaustion and finally death.

Kurobozus retain echoes of their ascetic training, enabling them to suck the breath from debilitated foes in the midst of battle. Their malevolent cunning combined with ascetic discipline helps them concoct elaborate and lengthy schemes to enact their jealous revenge. Few kurobozus are convincing enough to persuade their onetime allies to break their own oaths, but this doesn't stop them from making the attempt.

Brawling Critical.name: 搏击 大成功或大失败 Brawling Critical
Brawling Critical.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以拳击打击或具有武僧（特征）的武器造成重击时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到该武僧下个回合结束。

When a monk of Kugaptee scores a critical hit with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the monk's next turn.

Sagebane.name: 贤者祸根 Sagebane
Sagebane.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以A:拳击打击或带有武僧（特征）的武器对一个活物造成伤害时，目标必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

苦迦菩提武僧进一步造成的伤害会将持续时间重置为1分钟，并在豁免失败时使呆滞值提高1，最大至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}。

When the monk of Kugaptee damages a living creature with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the monk of Kugaptee resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Scarlet Apoxia.name: 猩红窒息症 Scarlet Apoxia
Scarlet Apoxia.description:
目标无法从由猩红窒息症导致的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏（状态）}状态中恢复，直到该疾病被治愈

豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良影响（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{枯竭 1} 和 疲乏（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{枯竭 2} 和 疲乏（1天）

阶段 4 死亡（因猩红窒息症而死亡的生物会在死后24小时以同等或更低等级的宁多鲁轮回转世，除非其躯体得到适当的葬礼；一旦轮回转世发生，在其所轮回转世成的宁多鲁先被杀死之前，该死亡生物无法恢复其原本的生命）

The target can't recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition caused by scarlet apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead (a creature that dies of scarlet apoxia reincarnates as a nindoru of equal or lower level 24 hours after death unless the body is given a proper funeral; once reincarnation occurs, the dead creature can't be restored to its original life until after the nindoru it reincarnates into is first slain)

Steal Breath.name: 窃息 Steal Breath
Steal Breath.description:
需求 苦迦菩提武僧邻接一个处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、缓慢、震慑或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态的活物

效果 苦迦菩提武僧俯身吸走目标的气息，目标必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:22]豁免。无论结果如何，该生物都会暴露于猩红窒息症，且其呼吸会在1分钟内散发腐烂野花的恶臭。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在1分钟内无法说话。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}，且在1分钟内无法说话。

大成功或大失败 如同失败，此外该生物会失去意识并开始窒息。

Requirements The monk of Kugaptee is adjacent to a living creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, slowed, stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Effect The monk of Kugaptee leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to scarlet apoxia and its breath reeks of rotting wildflowers for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls unconscious and begins suffocating.

Stunning Flurry.name: 震慑连击 Stunning Flurry
Stunning Flurry.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 苦迦菩提武僧进行两次A:拳击打击。如果两次都命中同一个生物，则为抗力和弱点的目的合并其伤害，且目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}）；此豁免具有失能（特征）。

Frequency once per round

Effect The monk of Kugaptee makes two fist Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.

prototypeToken.name: 享乐主义者莫都求 Mo Douqiu the Hedonist

Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.name: 享乐主义者莫都求 Mo Douqiu the Hedonist
Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.publicNotes:
辘轳首会在凡人因某种恶行而遭受诅咒时诞生，不过承受诅咒的人往往并非犯下过错者本人，而是其子女或配偶。诅咒会在他们睡眠时缓慢地将其转变为辘轳首。起初，他们的脖颈会伸长，甚至彻底脱离身体，让他们的头能够自由游荡，进行一些简单的恶作剧，比如惊吓邻居或动物。沉睡者次日清晨醒来时，或许会从一个朦胧的梦中回神，梦见自己喝光了附近提灯里的灯油，结果却发现那些提灯果然已经空了。

随着时间推移，这些怪异幕剧会发展为愈发恶劣、甚至暴力的罪行。新生的辘轳首只有在极短的一段时间内，仍可能通过解除诅咒而获救，但没过多久，他们就会被彻底吞噬，再也不会入睡。

大多数辘轳首都会因自身的处境而绝望，试图借酒浇愁，或只是尽量避人耳目。少数邪恶的辘轳首则会接受自己的命运，并试图通过彻底屈从于诅咒来增强自身威力。这会赋予他们施展强大异能法术的能力，但也无可避免地使他们更加走向邪恶。

Rokurokubi come into being when mortals are cursed for some misdeed, though often the one who bears the curse is not the one who committed the offense, but instead their child or spouse. The curse slowly transforms the individual into a rokurokubi as they sleep. At first, their neck extends, or even detaches altogether, to let their head roam freely and engage in simple mischief like scaring neighbors or animals. The sleeper may awaken the next morning from a hazy dream of drinking the oil from nearby lanterns, only to find them indeed empty.

Over time, the bizarre acts progress to increasingly mischievous or even violent crimes. There's only a brief period during which the nascent rokurokubi might still be saved by dispelling the curse, but before long, they are fully consumed, never to sleep again.

Most rokurokubi despair at their state, seeking to drown their sorrows in drink or simply stay out of sight. A nefarious few rokurokubi embrace their fate and seek to enhance their power by completely giving in to the curse. This grants them the ability to cast potent occult spells but inevitably twists them even more toward evil.
Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.blurb:
男性辘轳首变体
Male variant rokurokubi

Drink Oil.name: 饮用油剂 Drink Oil
Drink Oil.description:
触发 莫斗秋成为一次炼金炸弹打击的目标

需求 莫斗秋察觉到此次攻击，且对此次攻击并非处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}

效果 莫斗秋试图用嘴接住被掷出的炸弹。他针对该触发攻击的 AC 获得 +4 环境加值。若该攻击未命中，他便用嘴接住炸弹，并无害地将其内容吞下，恢复等同于该炸弹物品等级的生命值。

Trigger Mo Douqiu is the target of an alchemical bomb Strike

Requirements Mo Douqiu is aware of the attack and is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to it

Effect Mo Douqiu attempts to catch the flung bomb in his mouth. He gains a +4 circumstance bonus to his AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, he catches the bomb in his mouth and harmlessly drinks down its contents down, regaining Hit Points equal to the bomb's item level.

Reactive Strike (Jaws Only).name: 反应打击（仅限颚咬） Reactive Strike (Jaws Only)

Drop Corpse.name: 弃尸 Drop Corpse
Drop Corpse.description:
需求 一具悬挂的尸体位于莫斗秋次颚咬打击的触及内

效果 莫斗秋猛咬住悬挂尸体的麻绳并将其咬断，使躯体落到正下方的方格地面上。该空间内的一个生物承受 @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] 豁免），并且在失败或大失败时被击倒至 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

Requirements A hanging corpse is within reach of Mo Douqiu's jaws Strike

Effect Mo Douqiu chomps onto a rope dangling a dead body and bites through it, causing the body to fall to the ground in the square directly below. A creature in that space takes @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save), and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a failure or critical failure.

Extend Neck.name: 延伸颈部 Extend Neck
Extend Neck.description:
辘轳首伸长其颈部，使其次颚咬打击的触及从10英尺增加到20英尺，直到其下个回合结束。

The rokurokubi extends their neck, increasing the reach of their jaws Strike from 10 feet to 20 feet until the end of their next turn.

Threatening Lunge.name: 威吓猛扑 Threatening Lunge
Threatening Lunge.description:
需求 莫斗秋的颈部当前未处于伸长状态

效果 莫斗秋的头槌在打中前会先逼近到离目标面部仅一英寸的位置。它伸长颈部，尝试对20尺内的一名对手进行[[/act demoralize]]挫败士气，然后对该对手进行一次颚咬打击。他的挫败士气检定是视觉而非听觉效果，且如果目标不理解他的语言，他不会承受减值。

Requirements Mo Douqiu's neck is not currently extended

Effect Mo Douqiu's head comes within an inch of his target's face before striking. He Extends his Neck, attempts to [[/act demoralize]] one opponent within 20 feet, and then makes a jaws Strike against that opponent. His Demoralize check is a visual rather than auditory effect, and he doesn't take a penalty if the target doesn't understand his language.

Gray Butcher.name: 灰屠夫 Gray Butcher
Gray Butcher.publicNotes:
诞生于大块布料之中的一反木绵在空中飘舞，捕捉着落日最后的余晖。一反木绵可以由任何足够大的布料唤醒，许多美丽却遭受残酷对待的挂毯都曾引诱毫无戒心的受害者，走向不合时宜的死亡。

付丧神是由一件百年老物体与一位神使结合而形成的智能、可移动的物体。付丧神有的无害，有的恶毒，每一个个体的性格都源于那件物体在被唤醒前受到怎样的对待。受到精心照料的物体往往会诞生乐于助人的、友善的付丧神，而遭受虐待或被遗弃的物体则会扭曲为充满恶意与暴力的存在。大多数付丧神天性顽皮，而且往往只想吸引活物的注意。

在那些文化上强烈相信应当珍惜物品价值的地区，通常都能见到付丧神，因为这种观念能帮助物品存续得足够久，最终成为付丧神。拥有大量付丧神的城镇与村庄被称为“无眠城镇”，因为付丧神每晚都会举行庆典，而这些庆典有时会喧闹到让当地的活物居民无法安然入睡。

Born from large pieces of cloth, ittan-momen flutter in the air, catching the last rays of the setting sun. Ittan-momen can awaken from any sufficiently large cloth, and many beautiful but cruelly-treated tapestries have lured unsuspecting victims to an untimely end.

Tsukumogami are intelligent, mobile objects formed from the union between a 100-year-old object and a kami. Tsukumogami range from harmless to malicious, each individual personality a result of how the object was treated before its awakening. Well-cared-for objects tend to birth helpful, friendly tsukumogami, while mistreated or abandoned objects twist into malevolent and violent beings. Most tsukumogami are, by nature, mischievous, and oftentimes want nothing more than to occupy the attention of living creatures.

Tsukumogami can commonly be found in areas with a strong cultural belief in the value of caring for objects, which helps items survive long enough to become tsukumogami. Towns and villages with large tsukumogami populations are referred to as "sleepless towns" due to the nightly tsukumogami celebrations, which can become so raucous that they prevent the living residents from sleeping peacefully.
Gray Butcher.blurb:
无性别变体一反木绵
Agender variant ittan-momen

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震颤感知（模糊）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Gory Appearance.name: 血腥外观 Gory Appearance
Gory Appearance.description:
当不移动时，灰屠夫几乎无法与一条浸透血液的屠夫围裙区分开来。它们在冒充一条浸透血液的围裙时，其欺瞒检定和 DC 自动获得 26 的结果。

When not moving, Gray Butcher is nearly indistinguishable from a blood-soaked butcher's apron. They have an automatic result of 26 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a blood-soaked apron.

Awful Engulf.name: 可怖吞没 Awful Engulf
Awful Engulf.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:18]，@Damage[(1d8+2)[bludgeoning]] 伤害，[[/act escape dc=18]]，破裂 5

灰屠夫一次只能吞没一个生物，但只要该生物的头能够合理地被灰屠夫的躯体覆盖，它也可以对更大体型的生物这样做。因“可怖吞没”受到伤害的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:15] 豁免，才不会因浸透血液的织物而变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

@Check[reflex|dc:18], @Damage[(1d8+2)[bludgeoning]] damage, [[/act escape dc=18]], Rupture 5

Gray Butcher can Engulf only one creature, but can do so to a creature of a larger size so long as the creature's head can feasibly be covered by Gray Butcher's body. A creature that takes damage from Awful Engulf must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from the blood-soaked fabric.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

Warty.name: 疣儿 Warty
Warty.publicNotes:
大多数巨蟾蜍生活在干燥的环境中，尤其是沙漠，并且会急切地吃掉几乎任何比自己小的生物。众所周知，它们会吃巨鼠，然后占据老鼠的洞穴作为巢穴。巨蟾蜍眼后有大型的毒素腺体，使它们能够让皮肤覆上一层毒素。因此，它们几乎没有天敌，如果放任不管，种群数量会迅速暴增。虽然大多数人认为巨蟾蜍是危险的害兽，但一些食人魔和丘陵巨人的队伍会饲养它们，以收集其毒素供消遣使用。

Most giant toads live in dry environments, particularly deserts, and eagerly eat almost any creature smaller than themselves. They're known to eat giant rats, then take over the rats' burrows as homes. Giant toads have large poison glands behind their eyes that enable them to coat their skin with poison. This leads to them having very few natural predators, and populations can quickly explode if left unchecked. While most consider giant toads dangerous pests, some groups of ogres and hill giants cultivate them to collect their poison for recreational use.
Warty.blurb:
变体巨蟾蜍
Variant giant toad

Poisonous Warts.name: 毒疣 Poisonous Warts
Poisonous Warts.description:
任何以徒手打击命中疣儿的生物，或以其他方式接触这只巨蟾蜍的生物，都会暴露于巨蟾蜍毒素。

Any creature that hits the Warty with an unarmed Strike or otherwise touches the toad is exposed to giant toad poison.

Giant Toad Poison.name: 巨蟾蜍毒素 Giant Toad Poison
Giant Toad Poison.description:
豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} (1 round)

Slurp Something Shiny.name: 啜食闪亮之物 Slurp Something Shiny
Slurp Something Shiny.description:
疣儿以其舌头打击，对触及内由目标持有的一件闪亮物体进行一次[[/act disarm]]尝试。

Warty makes a [[/act disarm]] attempt with his tongue Strike against a shiny object held by a target in reach.

Swallow Whole.name: 活吞 Swallow Whole
Swallow Whole.description:
中型，@Damage[(1d8)[bludgeoning]] 伤害，[[/act escape dc=18]] 破裂 8

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Medium, @Damage[(1d8)[bludgeoning]] damage, [[/act escape dc=18]] Rupture 8

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Tongue Grab.name: 舌卷 Tongue Grab
Tongue Grab.description:
被疣儿的舌头命中的生物会被巨蟾蜍@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}。该生物不会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，但它不能移动到蟾蜍舌头的触及范围之外。

生物可以通过一次对 AC 15 的成功打击，且造成至少 6 点挥砍伤害，来切断这条舌头。这不会对疣儿造成伤害，但会阻止它使用舌头打击，直到它重新长出舌头，这需要一周时间。

A creature hit by Warty's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the giant toad. The creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the toad's tongue.

A creature can sever the tongue with a successful Strike against AC 15 that deals at least 6 slashing damage. This deals no damage to Warty, but prevents him from using his tongue Strike until he regrows his tongue, which takes a week.

Matsuki Shou.name: 松木胜 Matsuki Shou
Matsuki Shou.blurb:
男性人类木匠
Male human carpenter

Cataracts.name: 白内障 Cataracts
Cataracts.description:
松木老人的视力日益衰退，使其基于视觉的察觉检定承受–2环境减值。

Old Matsuki's deteriorating eyesight imposes a –2 circumstance penalty to vision-based Perception checks.

Wood-Grain Speaker.name: 木纹有语 Wood-Grain Speaker
Wood-Grain Speaker.description:
松木老人检视木制物品、建筑结构和树木时，其察觉获得+2环境加值。对于主要由木头制成的物品，他可以使用制作来辨识魔法。此能力不受松木老人的白内障影响。

Old Matsuki gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception when examining wood items, structures, and trees. He can use Crafting to Identify Magic for items primarily made of wood. This ability isn't affected by Old Matsuki's cataracts.

You Know, They Say....name: 你知道的，人们说....... You Know, They Say...
You Know, They Say....description:
松木老人可以使用柳岸镇学识代替奥秘、医药、神秘学或宗教，以带有 –2 减值的方式尝试进行回忆知识检定。以这种方式尝试的回忆知识检定中，他具有拥有诡异知识专长的效果。

Old Matsuki can use Willowshore Lore in place of Arcana, Medicine, Occultism, or Religion to attempt Recall Knowledge checks with a –2 penalty. He has the effects of the Dubious Knowledge feat for Recall Knowledge checks attempted in this way.

A Drink for Good Luck.name: 来杯好运酒 A Drink for Good Luck
A Drink for Good Luck.description:
频率 每季一次

需求 松木老人手中拿着一杯饮品

效果 松木老人为好运来临举杯祝酒，然后在饮下杯中饮品前，选择30尺内至多六个其他生物。他以及所有在其下个回合结束前饮酒的生物都会被注入好运。每个目标在当前季节结束前可有一次以自由动作重骰一次失败的豁免骰，并采用第二次结果。

Frequency once per season

Requirements Old Matsuki has a drink in hand

Effect Old Matsuki toasts to good fortune, then selects up to six other creatures within 30 feet before he drinks his drink. He, and all creatures that drink before the end of their next turn, become infused with good luck. Once before the end of the current season, each target can reroll a failed saving throw as a free action, taking the second result.

Respect Your Elders!.name: 尊老敬贤！ Respect Your Elders!
Respect Your Elders!.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 松木老人会当众斥责一个他能看见且位于30尺内的角色，指责其不够恭敬；这种不敬不仅是针对他本人或柳岸镇的其他长者，也是对柳岸镇传统的不敬。无论他的训斥是否有理，这番斥责的目标都必须尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响，并在1周内免疫“尊老敬贤！”。

成功 该生物会短暂感到羞愧，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。

失败 羞愧与自我怀疑不断困扰着该生物，令其分心到陷入呆滞 1，持续1小时。

Frequency once per day

Effect Old Matsuki publicly chastises a character he can see and who's within 30 feet for being disrespectful, not just against him or Willowshore's other elders, but against Willowshore's traditions. Whether or not his reprimands are justified, the target of this tirade must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to Respect Your Elders! for 1 week.

Success The creature feels a momentary bout of shame, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure Feelings of shame and doubt nag at the creature, distracting them enough that they become stupefied 1 for 1 hour.

Wait, Give Me a Moment....name: 等等，给我点时间……. Wait, Give Me a Moment...
Wait, Give Me a Moment....description:
触发 老松木在进行回忆知识检定时失败

频率 每天一次

效果 老松木意识到自己的错误，然后以+2环境加值重骰此次触发的检定。

Trigger Old Matsuki fails a check to Recall Knowledge

Frequency once per day

Effect Old Matsuki realizes his error, then rerolls the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus.

prototypeToken.name: 苦迦菩提的德拉考希克斯 Kugaptee's Drakauthix

Kugaptee's Drakauthix.name: 苦迦菩提的德拉考希克斯 Kugaptee's Drakauthix
Kugaptee's Drakauthix.publicNotes:
德拉考希斯是一种巨大的真菌，漂浮在幽暗地域最大洞穴的高处，靠喷射空气和孢子的囊泡推进。作为一种贪婪却行动缓慢的猎人，德拉考希斯偏好从上方伏击多肉的生物，用它带钩的附肢将受害者向上拉起以便吸血。德拉考希斯的消化过程完全在体外进行——它会附着在受害者身上，而其布满孢子的表面会缓慢啃食并长入血肉之中，之后再将孢子感染的尸体丢弃。当这具受感染的躯体打击到下方地面时，便会爆开并释放出一团孢子云，放出一群名为“小孢体”的幼体；它们会立刻窸窣着爬上洞穴墙壁，附着在天花板上并继续生长。

德拉考希斯的智能并不比大多数掠食性动物更高，而且它常常利用一种类似共生拾荒者的方式来确保猎物到手——借助它常出没的大型洞穴系统中泥怪与害虫的狩猎方式。当某个相对无心智的生物杀死受害者后，德拉考希斯便会飘下来，用它的触须钩住新近被杀的尸体，再将这顿美餐卷回。那个刚被偷走食物的无心智泥怪或其他生物很少会心怀怨念，通常只会滑走去寻找新的猎物，让德拉考希斯得以平静地消化尸体。当然，德拉考希斯也不介意享用更活跃的猎物；若冒险者在探索神秘洞穴网络时没有抬头留意危险，它也可能发动攻击。

一些栖息于幽暗地域的生物，例如灰矮人，会为了它们的肉而狩猎德拉考希斯；这种肉带有独特风味，回味辛辣。地下种族还会通过焚烧德拉考希斯的尸体来制作墨水，然后将灰烬长时间研磨并压榨，直到一种银色物质凝结出来。

The drakauthix is a massive fungus that floats through the heights of the largest Darklands caverns, propelled by bladders that spray air and spores. A voracious but slow-moving hunter, the drakauthix prefers to ambush meaty creatures from above, using its hooked appendages to pull its victims upward to feed. The drakauthix's digestive process is entirely external-it clings to victims, and its spore-laden surface slowly feeds on and grows through the flesh before the spore-infested carcass is discarded. As the infested body strikes the ground below, it bursts and releases a cloud of spores, unleashing a host of young called sporelings that immediately scuttle up the cavern walls to cling to its ceiling and grow.

The drakauthix behaves no more intelligently than most predatory animals, and often uses a sort of symbiotic scavenger method to secure prey by capitalizing on the hunting methods of oozes and vermin found in the large cave systems it frequents. When a relatively mindless creature kills a victim, the drakauthix drifts down, hooks the freshly slain carcass with its tendrils, and reels in its meal. The mindless ooze or other creature that just had its food stolen rarely holds a grudge and simply slithers off to find a new quarry, letting the drakauthix digest the corpse in peace. Of course, the drakauthix isn't above feasting on more active prey as well, and might attack an adventurer who neglects to look upward for danger when exploring a network of mysterious caves.

Some Darklands-dwelling creatures, such as duergars, hunt drakauthixes for their flesh, which has a unique flavor with a peppery aftertaste. Subterranean races also make ink from drakauthixes by burning their carcasses, then grinding and pressing the ashes for a long time until a silvery substance congeals.
Kugaptee's Drakauthix.blurb:
变体龙兽巫妖
Variant drakauthixes

Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 孢视（模糊）60尺 Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet
Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
德拉考希斯散发出一团它用来视物的孢子云。这是一种模糊感官，只能在没有强风气流的区域中发挥作用。孢子视觉在水下不起作用。

The drakauthix exudes a cloud of spores that it uses to see. This is an imprecise sense that functions only in areas without strong wind currents. Sporesight does not function underwater.

Obscuring Spores.name: 遮蔽孢子 Obscuring Spores
Obscuring Spores.description:
每当德拉考希斯受到至少 @Damage[10[slashing]] 伤害时，它会释放一团棕色孢子云，形成一个 @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]，持续1分钟（或直到被强风驱散）。所有位于孢子中的生物都会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而所有位于孢子外的生物对于位于其中的生物而言也会变为隐蔽。在这团孢子云内，德拉考希斯的孢子视觉会变为一种精确感官。孢子云不会随德拉考希斯一起移动，也不会因其移动而被带动。

Whenever the drakauthix takes at least @Damage[10[slashing]] damage, it releases a cloud of brown spores in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] that persists for 1 minute (or until dispersed by a strong wind). All creatures within the spores become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it. Within this cloud of spores, the drakauthix's sporesight becomes a precise sense. The spore cloud does not move with the drakauthix nor is it displaced by its movement.

Reel In.name: 卷回 Reel In
Reel In.description:
德拉考希斯将所有被其 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱} 的生物拉向自己 15 尺。

The drakauthix pulls all creatures it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 15 feet closer to itself.

Spore Tendrils.name: 孢子触须 Spore Tendrils
Spore Tendrils.description:
覆盖德拉考希斯躯体的触须会伸出并侵染邻近的生物，造成 @Damage[4d6[毒素]]伤害和 @Damage[1d6[persistent,毒素]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] 豁免；被德拉考希斯以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 擒抱的生物在此次豁免中承受 –4 环境减值）。

The tendrils that cover the drakauthix's body reach out and infest adjacent creatures, dealing @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save; a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the drakauthix takes a –4 circumstance penalty to this save).

Whirlwind of Hooks.name: 钩旋风 Whirlwind of Hooks
Whirlwind of Hooks.description:
德拉考希斯旋身甩动，将周围的生物抽打一圈。它对触及内的每个生物各进行一次触手打击。这些攻击计入德拉考希斯的多重攻击减值，但在德拉考希斯完成所有攻击之前，多重攻击减值不会增加。

The drakauthix whirls, whipping creatures around it. It makes a tentacle Strike against every creature within reach. These attacks count toward the drakauthix's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the drakauthix makes all its attacks.

Kalen Bray.name: 卡伦·布雷 Kalen Bray
Kalen Bray.publicNotes:
蹒跚的丧尸是一种行动迟缓的恐怖，在数量较多时会更加危险。

丧尸唯一的欲望就是吃喝活人。它们是没有思想、永不停歇地蹒跚前行的死亡邪魔先驱，只有在被摧毁时才会停下。

A zombie shambler is a slow-moving horror dangerous in larger groups.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.

Shrine Caretaker.name: 圣坛看护者 Shrine Caretaker
Shrine Caretaker.publicNotes:
生命终结于火焰中的生物会以名为焚身尸的亡灵形态归来。即便死后仍在燃烧，它们也被永恒的痛苦所吞噬，并被驱使着陷入鲁莽的暴力之中。

尽管焚身尸已无法再真正被火焰所伤，它们却会永远承受自己死亡前最后时刻的折磨，被无尽的灼烧痛苦反复炙烤。许多焚身尸会试图把自己浸入湖泊或河流中，因为它们相信缠绕其形体的火焰必定是痛苦的来源。然而，水带来的阻碍多于帮助，浸没其中只会加剧它们的痛楚。

焚身尸已不再具备用痛苦哀号之外的任何方式沟通的能力，但它们仍保有感官与记忆。然而，它们很少会寻求依照过去行事，因为痛苦淹没了关于友谊、家人和复仇的思绪。随着时间流逝，焚身尸会被驱使着将自己的痛苦分享给他者，因为当它们身上的火焰点燃另一个活物的瞬间，它们会感受到片刻短暂的解脱。这种解脱常常使焚身尸与活物发生冲突，尽管那些攻击大型聚居地的焚身尸通常活不了太久。

有些焚身尸源自死于自燃的人，他们会突然变得炽热无比并当场起火。这一神秘过程尚未被完全理解，不过一些学者认为，这是由于火元素位面的力量发生了变化，在主物质位面形成了足以致命的高热点。更为罕见的是，在拥有特别强烈魔法火焰的区域周围也会出现焚身尸，例如用于打造魔法武器的熔炉；当火焰点燃生物，使其被活活烧死时，它们便会在转瞬之间超脱死亡，化为亡灵。

无论引发它们烈火焚身的源头为何，焚身尸所遭受的可怖死法都会在死后持续作祟。它们焦黑炭化的尸体上燃着火焰，时时刻刻提醒着它们临终时承受的痛苦。燃烧血肉的恶臭昭示着它们的到来，每一具焚身尸身后都会拖曳出黑色烟雾。

Creatures whose lives end in flames can return as undead called combusted. Still burning even in death, they're consumed by everlasting anguish that drives them to reckless violence.

Although combusted can no longer be truly harmed by fire, they endure the final moments of their death eternally, searing them with endless burning pain. Many combusted attempt to douse themselves in lakes or rivers, believing the flames that wreath their forms must be the source of their pain. However, water is more hindrance than help, and being immersed in it only amplifies their agony.

No longer possessing the ability to communicate in anything other than agonized wails, combusted nonetheless retain their senses and memories. Yet they rarely seek to act on their past, for the pain drowns out thoughts of friendships, family, and vengeance. In time, combusted are driven to share their pain with others, for the instant their flames catch fire on another living being, they feel a single, fleeting moment of relief. This relief leads combusted into conflict with living creatures often, although those that attack large settlements rarely survive long.

Some combusted form from those who died via spontaneous combustion, suddenly becoming so hot they burst into flames. This mysterious process isn't fully understood, though some scholars attribute it to shifts in power in the Plane of Fire causing hot spots in the Material Plane powerful enough to kill. Much more rarely, combusted arise around areas with especially intense magical flames, such as forges used to create magic weapons, when the fire sets creatures ablaze, so they burn to death and transcend into undeath in mere moments.

Regardless of the source of their conflagration, the horrifying deaths that combusted suffered haunt them in the afterlife. Their charred, blackened corpses alight with flames are a constant reminder of their final moments in pain. The stench of burning flesh heralds their presence, each combusted leaving black smoke in their wake.

Water Vulnerability.name: 水之弱点 Water Vulnerability
Water Vulnerability.description:
当圣坛看护者受到水系效果造成的伤害时，该亡灵会被痛苦折磨，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。水无法浇灭圣坛看护者的烈焰。若圣坛看护者浮现于暴风雨中，则只要其停留在大雨里，便视同处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。它们无法自行降低这一恶心（状态），但如果它们在回合结束时处于遮蔽处（例如C3b或C3d区域），该状态会自动结束。

When a shrine caretaker is dealt damage by a water effect, the undead is wracked by pain, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. Water can't douse the shrine caretaker's flames. A shrine caretaker who emerges into the rainstorm functions as if @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} as long as they remain in the downpour. They can't lower this sickened condition on their own, but it ends automatically if they end their turn in shelter (such as areas C3b or C3d).

Blazing Howl.name: 炽焰嚎叫 Blazing Howl
Blazing Howl.description:
圣坛看护者痛苦地尖叫，使 @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] 内的生物突然燃起火焰，对区域内每个生物造成 @Damage[4d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:17|basic] 豁免）。豁免严重失败的生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}；此惊惧（状态）属于情绪、恐惧和心灵效果。

圣坛看护者在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Blazing Howl]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次使用炽焰嚎叫。

The shrine caretaker screams in agony, causing creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] to burst into flame, which deals @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to each creature in the area (@Check[will|dc:17|basic] save). A creature that critically fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}; this frightened condition is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

The caretaker can't use Blazing Howl again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Blazing Howl]]{1d4 rounds}.

Gurglegut (Level 12).name: 咕噜肚（12级） Gurglegut (Level 12)
Gurglegut (Level 12).publicNotes:
A:步索 | B:独眼怪是居住在树上的族群，内心始终翻涌着吃喝他者血肉的欲望。他们的食物中有很大一部分依赖树叶和根源类作物补充，掌握着大量农业知识，并天生拥有操控植物及其生长的力量。然而说到肉类，A:步索 | B:独眼怪拒绝猛兽的血肉；他们转而吃喝其他类人生物。不仅是因为他们觉得其他生物的味道令人作呕，他们的身体也会排斥非类人生物的肉，因为那对他们没有任何营养价值，吃下后还会令他们恶心且虚弱。

A:步索 | B:独眼怪不同寻常的饮食需求，意味着他们几乎总是与邻近的文化格格不入。他们通常只与地精维持还算不错的关系，因为地精这个族群较少会根据饮食来评判他人。其他社群则畏惧A:步索 | B:独眼怪——而且这种畏惧并非毫无道理——不过除了偶尔外出猎取某人作为下一餐之外，A:步索 | B:独眼怪大多独来独往。在某些绝望的分布地点，面临饥荒或其他自然灾害的社群，甚至可能会主动寻求A:步索 | B:独眼怪的帮助，以受害者作为交换，换取知识或魔法援助，从而使他们的社群免于因饥饿而缓慢且糟糕地死去。

A:步索 | B:独眼怪的独眼有时会让人将他们与独眼巨人相提并论。然而，这两类生物都否认彼此拥有任何共同族裔，而且他们最初是分别在世界上完全不同的地区独立出现的，彼此的属性也有着显著差异。就A:步索 | B:独眼怪自己而言，他们相信祖先的行为造就了他们的独眼。面对威胁到族群存续的饥荒时，这些祖先各自挖出自己的一只眼睛，作为献给森林中恶毒精魂的祭品，恳求对方拯救他们。A:步索 | B:独眼怪说，这些精魂——他们称之为busaw——赐予了他们农业知识、操控植物的力量，以及对有智血肉的渴望。自那以后，他们将busaw尊敬为神祇，并称自己为buso：崇拜busaw之人。

Busos are tree-dwelling folk with a simmering desire to consume the flesh of others. They to heavily supplement their food with leaves and root crops, possess significant knowledge of agriculture, and boast innate powers over plants and their growth. In regards to meat, however, busos reject the flesh of beasts; they instead consume other humanoids. Not only do they find the taste of other creatures repulsive, but their bodies reject non-humanoid meat since it provides them no nutritional value and consuming it leaves them sickened and weak.

Busos' unusual dietary needs mean they're almost always at odds with neighboring cultures. They typically maintain decent relations only with goblins, who are as a people less prone to judging others based on diet. Other communities fear busos-with some justification-though aside from the occasional forays to harvest someone for their next meal, busos tend to keep to themselves. In some desperate locations, communities faced with famine or other natural disasters might even seek out busos' aid, offering victims in exchange for knowledge or magical assistance that might save their communities from slow and terrible deaths through starvation.

A buso's single eye sometimes leads to them being compared to cyclopes. However, both types of creatures deny any common ancestry, and they first appeared independently in entirely different parts of the world with substantially divergent abilities. For their part, busos believe that their ancestors' deeds gave rise to their single eyes. When faced with a famine that threatened their existence, these ancestors each cut out one of their eyes as an offering to the malevolent spirits of the forest, imploring for their salvation. Busos say that these spirits, whom they call the busaw, gave them their knowledge of agriculture, power over plants, and craving for sentient flesh. Henceforth, they revered the busaw as gods and called themselves buso: those who worship the busaw.
Gurglegut (Level 12).blurb:
独眼怪雄性变种
Variant male buso

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但构造相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Command Onidoshi.name: 命令术 鬼徒武士 Command Onidoshi
Command Onidoshi.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 咕噜肚向D1区域内的一个山鬼吠叫出一道命令。该恶鬼可以使用反应动作来尝试对一个相邻敌人进行一次近战打击。

Frequency once per round

Effect Gurglegut barks out a command to a single mountain oni in area D1. That oni can use a reaction to attempt a melee Strike against an adjacent foe.

Spit Fire.name: 喷火 Spit Fire
Spit Fire.description:
频率 每天一次

效果咕噜肚饮下他米酒壶中的内容（消耗壶中一口），然后将其喷吐到他弩上一支弩矢的燃烧尖端上，令一阵火焰爆发充满 @Template[cone|distance:20]，对区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免）。

Frequency once per day

Effect Gurglegut drinks the contents of his jug of rice wine (consuming one of the gulps contained in his jug), then spews it out across the flaming tip of a bolt in his crossbow, filling a @Template[cone|distance:20] with a blast of fire that inflicts @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] save) to all creatures in the area.

prototypeToken.name: 狂热者邹斗 Zoudou the Zealous

Zoudou the Zealous.name: 狂热者邹斗 Zoudou the Zealous
Zoudou the Zealous.publicNotes:
这些无脸妖已经精通伪装的艺术。

无脸鬼从背后看起来像是普通的人类，甚至可能像是你认识的某个人，直到他们转过身来，露出一张没有五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

虽然普通无脸鬼通常残忍，并以惊吓或折磨类人生物为乐，但并非所有无脸鬼都沉溺于邪恶。中立的无脸妖往往是爱恶作剧的家伙，会用自己的能力来欺骗和戏弄别人；而罕见的善良无脸妖则会用自己的能力来向自己钦佩的人致敬与表达崇拜，同时把自己的时间投入到磨炼艺术或制作方面的技能上。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸妖的起源有许多理论——从变形能力失控的化狸，到被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，再到自然诞生的妖怪。还有一些人甚至推测，这种状态是一种像兽化症那样能够传播的诅咒。大多数无脸妖都不记得自己的起源，而且他们通常更感兴趣的是假扮成另一个截然不同的人。

These noppera-bos have mastered the art of disguise.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但听觉极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫任何需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上是将手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也可以用这种方式从消耗中获益，例如药水或炼金灵药。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Identity Crisis.name: 身份危机 Identity Crisis
Identity Crisis.description:
频率 每天一次

触发 邹斗成功对一个邻近生物施展窃取面容

效果 当邹斗窃取该生物的面容时，她通过心灵感应牵动该生物的身份认同与自我意识。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:20]意志豁免。若失败，该生物会质疑自己的身份，并在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。若大失败，则其减速1，持续1分钟。

Frequency once per day

Trigger Zoudou successfully Steals the Face of an adjacent creature

Effect As Zoudou Steals the creature's Face, she telepathically draws at the creature's sense of identity and self. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, the creature questions their own identity and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. On a critical failure, they're slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Oath of Anonymity.name: 无面誓约 Oath of Anonymity
Oath of Anonymity.description:
当邹斗有脸时，她无法施放神圣预备法术。

When Zoudou has a face, she can't cast divine prepared spells.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}状态，他们就会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}状态。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无脸鬼变成一个它们在过去24小时内接触过的小型或中型类人生物的版本，并获得目标生物的面孔和声音。当处于变形状态时，无脸鬼在对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值，并失去其无面能力和列出的免疫。无脸鬼可以通过再次使用该能力变回原状。

The noppera-bo changes into a version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours, and gains the target creature's face and voice. While transformed, the noppera-bo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature and loses its no face ability and listed immunities. The noppera-bo can change back by using this ability again.

Regain Anonymity.name: 重归无面 Regain Anonymity
Regain Anonymity.description:
需求 邹斗有一张面孔

效果 邹斗使她正戴着的面孔如流淌的蜡一般融化，并获得 [[/r 3d6 #Temp HP]] 临时生命值。她在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Regain Anonymity]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次使用重归无面。

Requirements Zoudou has a face

Effect Zoudou causes the face she's wearing to melt away like running wax and gains [[/r 3d6 #Temp HP]] temporary Hit Points. She can't Regain Anonymity again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Regain Anonymity]]{1d4 rounds}.

Silent Casting.name: 静默施法 Silent Casting
Silent Casting.description:
当邹斗处于无面状态时，她可以用一个额外的操作成分替代一个专注成分。

When Zoudou is faceless, she can substitute an additional manipulate component for a concentrate component.

Steal Face.name: 窃取面容 Steal Face
Steal Face.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 邹斗处于无脸状态

效果 邹斗以30尺内的一个生物为目标。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 无脸鬼获得目标的脸。目标的脸会消失，直到其下一回合结束。在此之前，它处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，无法说话、无法摄食，且无法闻气味。目标还必须屏住呼吸，否则将开始窒息。

大失败 同失败，但该效果不会自动结束。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重新尝试一次豁免，且每次此类尝试时，难度等级都会累计降低1。

Frequency once per day

Requirements Zoudou is faceless

Effect Zoudou targets one creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of its next turn.

Failure The noppera-bo gains the target's face. The target's face vanishes until the end of its next turn. Until then, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, can't speak or ingest, and can't smell. The target must also hold its breath or begin to suffocate.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect doesn't end automatically. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such attempt.

prototypeToken.name: 苦迦菩提的蜈蚣 Kugaptee's Centipede

Kugaptee's Centipede.name: 苦迦菩提的蜈蚣 Kugaptee's Centipede
Kugaptee's Centipede.publicNotes:
这些体型巨大的独居蜈蚣占据着广阔无边的狩猎场。

These colossal, solitary centipedes claim vast hunting grounds.
Kugaptee's Centipede.blurb:
变种泰坦蜈蚣
Variant titan centipede

Impaling Critical.name: 穿刺大成功 Impaling Critical
Impaling Critical.description:
当苦迦菩提的蜈蚣用它的颚骨造成重击时，目标会被带倒刺的棘刺与刚毛痛苦地刺穿，受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] 伤害，并在流血伤害持续期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

When Kugaptee's centipede scores a critical hit with his mandibles, the target is painfully pierced with barbed spines and bristles, taking @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage and becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for as long as the bleed damage continues.

Trample.name: 践踏 Trample
Trample.description:
超大型或更小，足，@Check[反射|dc:28|基础]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Attributes.Glossary.践踏]

Huge or smaller, foot, @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Undulate.name: 起伏 Undulate
Undulate.description:
苦迦菩提的蜈蚣进行至多等同于其速度的魅影野猪行走，或进行步骤。在此次移动期间，他可以穿过狭窄至 10 英尺的空间，而无需 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{挤压}。

Kugaptee's centipede Strides up to his Speed or Steps. During this movement, he can pass through spaces as narrow as 10 feet without @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing}.

Void Venom.name: 虚空毒液 Void Venom
Void Venom.description:
豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[void]]伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d8[void]]伤害、呆滞 2，且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d10[void]]伤害、呆滞 2，且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d8[void]] damage, stupefied 2, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d10[void]] damage, stupefied 2, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些抛射物是弓弩使用的弹药。支箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行时通过一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有一个金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Defensive Training.name: 防御训练 Defensive Training
Defensive Training.description:
佣兵执法者在其回合开始时获得一个额外的反应动作，但只能将此反应动作用于护盾格挡。

The mercenary enforcer gains an additional reaction at the start of their turn but can only use this reaction to Shield Block.

Fearful of Ghosts.name: 惧怕幽灵 Fearful of Ghosts
Fearful of Ghosts.description:
所有这些关于闹鬼废墟的议论都让唐入的佣兵打手们紧张不安。在任何一场对抗 PC 的战斗开始时，只要唐入的怖惧点数阈值至少为 2，一名佣兵执法者就必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:20] 意志豁免，否则便会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。一旦唐入的怖惧点数阈值达到 7 或更高，佣兵执法者在变得惊惧时还会同时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

All this talk about haunted ruins has the mercenary enforcers at Karahai on edge. At the start of any combat against the PCs while Karahai's Terror Point threshold is at least 2, a mercenary enforcer must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). Once Karahai's Terror Point threshold is 7 or higher, a mercenary enforcer also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} whenever they become frightened.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
佣兵执法者对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态的生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。

A mercenary enforcer deals 1d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Haunting Presence.name: 萦绕之灵 Haunting Presence
Haunting Presence.disable:
@Check[宗教|dc:16]以驱除该作祟，或点亮长明灯（会自动解除这些作祟）

@Check[religion|dc:16] to exorcise the haunt, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables these haunts)
Haunting Presence.hazarddescription:
幽灵般的声音或幽影般的幻象移动着，惊吓或分散街上行人的注意力。

Ghostly sounds or glimpses of apparitions move to startle or distract those who walk the streets.
Haunting Presence.stealthdetails:
注意到一种令人不安的感觉

to notice an unsettling sensation

Ghostly Menace.name: 幽魂威胁 Ghostly Menace
Ghostly Menace.description:
触发 发生一次作祟遭遇

效果 苦迦菩提以一种骇人的方式显露其存在——突然响起的痛苦尖啸、红色蝴蝶的爆炸性迸发、瞬间压倒一切的腐朽气息，或诸如此类。一名随机玩家角色受到 @Damage[(2d6+3)[心灵]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:19|basic] 基础意志豁免），随后萦绕之灵消失，只留下心灵创痕与精神创伤。

Trigger A haunt encounter occurs

Effect Kugaptee's presence makes itself known in a frightening way—a sudden shriek of agony, an explosive burst of red butterflies, a momentarily overwhelming air of decay, or the like. A random PC takes @Damage[(2d6+3)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:19|basic] save), and then the haunting presence vanishes, leaving behind nothing but mental scars and trauma.

Corpse Sugi.name: 尸杉 Corpse Sugi
Corpse Sugi.publicNotes:
尸根是腐臭的亡灵树木，会长出鲜红的剧毒果实，并向周围植物散播荒疫，将健康的树木转化为新的尸根。这些狡猾的杀手通过它们的根系汲取生物的生命，在受害者进入触及范围之前，它们会伪装成枯死的树木。

尸根最常由因超自然荒疫而死亡的树木腐臭外壳形成，因此在锐木森林和菲耶拉尼森林中是常见威胁。最强大的尸根通常是被用作圣祠和献祭祭坛的古代树木；它们的根系吸收了那些在其枝下被判献祭者的血液、血肉与怖惧。其中一些古代尸根，至今仍能命令那些无意间创造了它们的异教崇拜团体的敬重与奉献。

Corpseroots are rotten, undead trees that grow bright-red poisonous fruit and spread blight to surrounding plants, transforming healthy trees into new corpseroots. These cunning killers drain the life from creatures through their root systems, posing as dead trees until their victims come within reach.

Corpseroots most commonly form from rotten husks of trees that died from supernatural blights, making them common threats in the Fangwood and Fierani forests. The most powerful are ancient trees used as shrines and sacrificial altars, their roots absorbing the blood, flesh, and terror of those condemned under their boughs. Some of these ancient corpseroots still command the respect and devotion of the cults that inadvertently created them.

Sugi Tree.name: 杉树 Sugi Tree
Sugi Tree.description:
当不处于危险中时，尸杉会花费1分钟将根扎入大地，使自己扎根在原地。处于扎根且无法移动状态时，生物必须主动进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}，并在一次@Check[perception|dc:38]检定中成功，才能侦测出尸杉的真实本质。

When it isn't in danger, the corpse sugi spends 1 minute rooting to the earth, becoming planted in place. While the corpse sugi is planted and immobile, creatures must actively @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:38] Check to detect the Corpse Sugi's true nature.

Axe Vulnerability.name: 斧类弱点 Axe Vulnerability
Axe Vulnerability.description:
尸杉受到斧头造成的额外 10 点伤害。

The corpse sugi takes 10 additional damage from axes.

Thoughtblight.name: 思枯病 Thoughtblight
Thoughtblight.description:
30尺。非宁多鲁的有知性活物若进入尸杉的灵光，或在其灵光内开始自己的回合，其心智便会被残忍与痛苦的侵入性思维所侵扰，且必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}状态（若为大失败，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}）。该状态在该生物离开灵光后仍会持续1分钟。豁免骰成功的生物会暂时免疫思枯病1分钟。

30 feet. The mind of a non-nindoru sapient living creature that enters or starts their turn in the corpse sugi's aura becomes infested with invasive thoughts of cruelty and anguish, and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). This condition persists for 1 minute after the creature leaves the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is temporarily immune to thoughtblight for 1 minute.

Take Root.name: 扎根 Take Root
Take Root.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 尸杉擒抱或束缚了一个生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

效果 尸杉将其根系埋入该生物体内，造成 @Damage[(1d6+13)[piercing]] 伤害并汲取目标的生命力（@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic] 强韧豁免）。若失败，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（若其已经处于 drained，则该值增加 1），且尸杉恢复 10 HP。若这会使一个生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}，则该生物死亡。

Frequency once per round

Requirements The corpse sugi has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The corpse sugi buries its roots into the creature, dealing @Damage[(1d6+13)[piercing]] damage and draining the target's life force (@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic] save). On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or increases the value by 1 if already drained), and the corpse sugi regains 10 HP. If this would make a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}, the creature dies.
